entries.title: A Burrowed Name
entries.summary: Completing the climax of the [[Ballad]] of the Burrowed Well awards 7 [[Fragment of Lucidity]], 3 [[Fragment of Vision]], 1 [[Fragment of Catharsis]], the [[Scorching Truth]] of the [[Weight of Purpose]] if not acquired, and a sheet of purified [[Sky Glass]].
entries.body:
Completing the climax of the [[Ballad]] of the Burrowed Well awards 7 [[Fragment of Lucidity]], 3 [[Fragment of Vision]], 1 [[Fragment of Catharsis]], the [[Scorching Truth]] of the [[Weight of Purpose]] if not acquired, and a sheet of purified [[Sky Glass]].

The [[Events]] of [[A Burrowed Name]] are available from [[Ages]] 0 to VI, done once per lifetime of a [[Legend]], and can be done only every other age during a [[Ritual Seventh]].

When looking at the inside of the Burrowed Well, the name on the story changes based on the [[Legend]] that gazes into it, and changes pronouns accordingly.

For clarity and readability's sake the name here will be [[Cordelia]] addressed as She.

### The Burrowed Well

Once upon a time, there was a little [[Cordelia]].

A little [[Cordelia]] who had no name.

A little [[Cordelia]] who had seen no name, for names are cages built by those consumed by fear.

And this little one had never known the fear of being held back.

She lived in the seam between the beating of the heart and silence.

She fed on the pause: on the breath that hovers over the sleeping face before love is confirmed.

This little [[Cordelia]] was the gaze a queen steals from her reflection before memory returns her crown.

Every unasked question was swallowed in a single bite. Every lie — beautiful, cruel, or merciful — was digested slowly, like communion.

The little [[Cordelia]] did not grow in size. Only in depth, just like an abyss that does not widen but descends until distance becomes theology.

The [[Ages]] arrived, and each [[Cycle]] consumed the burn of each era to gain warmth. Some prophet gave it a name, but whenever they uttered it, they would inevitably collapse in madness under the weight of their own syllables.

Thus grew a shining, golden wall, magnificent along its perimeter; those walls were called destiny.

But even so, from every altar, every deathbed, every mirror reflecting a face that had forgotten itself, the little [[Cordelia]] asked only for a door to be opened.

If everything you are can be named, praised, or mourned, what is left for a little [[Cordelia]] when these things are taken away?

The little [[Cordelia]] answered from her own shadow to a pale vagrant, wandering with a lantern that cleansed in burn the darkness.

This was not a curse. A door.

The pale man knelt at the foot of the first tree and asked the little [[Cordelia]] why [[Humanity]] feared her so much.

She spoke from a borrowed name.

_"Because I am the truth before the comfort of sight. The mercy no one had known how to ask. I strip away the borrowed name so that the true one may, at last, be chosen."_

The pale man wept, not out of sorrow, but out of recognition, just as a man weeps when he finds the words for a wound he had always carried in silence.

This was the oldest knowledge of the little [[Cordelia]].

[[Humanity]] does not tremble before death or [[The Infinite Void]], nor before the indifferent arithmetic of distant stars in the cosmos. They tremble before the intoxicating possibility that courage is not discovered, but forged from a burrowed name that is not owed to infinity.

For it is the flame in the palms of hands that burns in belief across a cosmos that is vast, beautiful, and utterly silent before the question of importance.

To be small in such a world is terrible.

To remain tender, little, and [[Cordelia]] while being small is thus the birth of the sacred.

The vagrant rose. The tiny [[Cordelia]] followed in his shadow, always asking. And it is said that those who lose all names cast a shadow deeper than their bodies warrant.

She was beyond gentleness, yet still held in the wakefulness that rejects the cruelty the truth offered them.

Not because something is observed. No, the little [[Cordelia]] is the ceaseless wheel that builds the perhaps of maybe's garden.

Once upon a time, there was a little [[Cordelia]].

A little [[Cordelia]] who had no name.

There was a little [[Cordelia]] who lived only in the patience woven into the seam between the heartbeat and silence.

A little [[Cordelia]] waiting for those who would listen to her without breaking, without fleeing, without lying about the truth of being alive, being small, and still being here.

The little [[Cordelia]] is still waiting there.

She is still waiting here.

### El Pozo Enterrado

Había una vez un [[Cordelio]] chiquito.

Un [[Cordelio]] chiquito que no tenía nombre.

Un pequeño [[Cordelio]] que no tenía nombre, pues los nombres son jaulas construidas por aquellos consumidos por el miedo.

Y este pequeño nunca había conocido el miedo a que algo lo detuviera.

Vivía en la costura entre el latido del corazón y el silencio.

Se alimentaba de la pausa: del aliento que se cierne sobre el rostro dormido antes de que el amor se confirme.

Este pequeño [[Cordelio]] era la mirada que un rey roba a su reflejo antes de que la memoria le devuelva su corona.

Cada pregunta no formulada era tragada en un solo bocado. Cada mentira —hermosa, cruel o misericordiosa — era digerida lentamente, como una comunión.

El [[Cordelio]] chiquito no crecía en tamaño. Solo en profundidad, como un abismo que no se ensancha, sino que desciende hasta que la distancia se convierte en teología.

Llegó el paso del tiempo y cada ciclo consumió la quemadura de cada era para obtener calor. Algún profeta le dio un nombre, pero cada vez que lo entonaban, inevitablemente colapsaba en la locura bajo el propio peso de sus propias sílabas.

Así creció una muralla resplandeciente y de oro, magnífica a lo largo de su grandioso perímetro.

A esas murallas las llamaron destino.

Pero aún así, desde cada altar, cada lecho de muerte, cada espejo que reflejaba un rostro que se había olvidado de sí mismo, el [[Cordelio]] chiquito solo preguntaba sobre la apertura de una puerta.

Si todo lo que eres puede ser nombrado, alabado o llorado, ¿Qué le queda a un pequeño [[Cordelio]] cuando estas cosas le son arrebatadas?

El [[Cordelio]] chiquito respondió desde su propia sombra a un pálido vagabundo, que deambulaba con una linterna que purificaba en el ardor de la oscuridad.

No era una maldición. Una puerta.

El hombre pálido se arrodilló al pie del primer árbol, y preguntó al pequeño [[Cordelio]] por qué la humanidad le temía tanto.

Entonó desde un nombre prestado.

_«Porque soy la verdad ante el consuelo de la vista. La misericordia que nadia había sabido pedir. Despojo el nombre prestado para que el verdadero pueda, por fin, ser elegido»._

El hombre pálido lloró, no por pena, sino por reconocimiento, del mismo modo que un hombre llora al encontrar las palabras para una herida que había siempre llevado en silencio.

Este era el conocimiento más antiguo del pequeño [[Cordelio]].

La humanidad no tiembla ante la muerte ni el vacío, ni ante la aritmética indiferente de las estrellas distantes del cosmos. Tiembla ante la intoxicante posibilidad de que el valor no se descubra, sino que se forje a partir de un nombre enterrado que no se debe al infinito.

Pues es la llama en las palmas de las manos la que arde en la fe a través de un universo que es vasto, hermoso, y absolutamente silencioso ante la cuestión de la importancia.

Ser pequeño en un mundo así es terrible.

Permanecer tierno, chiquito y [[Cordelio]] mientras se es pequeño es, por tanto, el nacimiento de lo sagrado.

El vagabundo se levantó. El [[Cordelio]] chiquito lo siguió en su sombra, preguntando siempre. Y se dice que aquellos que pierden todos los nombres proyectan una sombra más profunda de lo que sus cuerpos justifican.

Él estaba más allá de la gentileza, pero aún así se mantenía en la vigilia que rechaza a la crueldad que la verdad les ofreció.

No porque algo se observe. No, el pequeño [[Cordelio]] es la rueda incesante que construye el quizás del jardín del tal vez.

Había una vez un [[Cordelio]] chiquito.

Un [[Cordelio]] chiquito que no tenía nombre.

Había un pequeño [[Cordelio]] que vivía solo en la paciencia enroscada en la costura entre el latido del corazón y el silencio.

Un pequeño [[Cordelio]] esperando a aquellos que lo escucharan sin romperse, sin huir, sin mentir sobre la verdad de estar vivo, de ser pequeño y de seguir aquí.

Sigue esperando ahí el [[Cordelio]] chiquito.

Sigue esperando aquí.

entries.title: Absolute Certainty
entries.summary: Sixth Auric Thread of Quantum Collapse and Second Half of Quantum Physics_
entries.body:
### _Vision, Imagination and Conviction

Sixth Auric Thread of Quantum Collapse and Second Half of Quantum Physics_

**Core Axis | THE FUTURE - WILL I SUCCEED?**

**Aligned Note:** G | Sol
**Attuned Element:** [[Crystal]] (Prisms + Structure)

**Invocation:**

- You resolve it with perfect certainty (6). [[The Principles of Magic]].
- *"A melody only soars when known where to resolve before playing the first note."

**Related Principles:**

- [[Consensual Anchoring]]:

One of the three bindings in [[Mastery Over Chaos]] of the [[Triadic Virtues of Spellcraft]]. [[Absolute Certainty]] is the sixth auric thread of the [[Auric Heptacode]] and sixth binding in [[The Principles of Magic]]. Its principle states that any [[Spellweaving]] requires vivid mental forging, an unshakeable vision of what must come to pass. Nothing steps into existence without first taking shape within the mind's eye. A vision unseen cannot bloom. Thus, [[Spellweaving]]. is bound to the rule that only if it can be visualized can it exist. What you can't imagine can't come to be.

At the moment of the [[Original Ripple]], [[The First Overtone]] emerged as formless chaos in the vivid sea of proto consciousness. However, the [[Auric Aria]] deliberate act of creation founded the [[Known Universe]]. She came to this realization after weaving the other bindings, she came to realize that [[Consciousness]] could shape chaos into crystalized vibration. It collapsed into discrete, crystalline packets, each pulse resolved into precise definition. The [[Auric Aria]], inspired by this collapse of infinite possibility into singular form, encoded it into the [[Auric Heptacode]] as the principle of manifestation — the law that all creation requires a deliberate vision, certainty of form before it exists. When doubt clouds the mind's eye, possibility remains theoretical; in conviction, matter shapes as crystalized vibration.

[[Absolute Certainty]], then, is the discipline of forging unwavering will and vision —ensuring the mind's eye sees the [[Spellweaving]]'s resolution with such perfect clarity that doubt can't penetrate, fragmentation can't scatter, and the weave crystallizes into inevitable form. Like crystal takes shapeless earth and refracts light into perfect geometric certainty, and prisms split chaos into ordered spectrum, authentic conviction follows its natural course from inner vision into external reality.

### The Principle of Reality Crystallization

Magic in [[Arcanoria]] manifests when a [[Spellweaver]]'s unwavering conviction creates a collapse of probability in [[Superposed Resonance]] through their [[Fundamental Frequency]], forcing infinite possibility into singular, resolved form of [[Consonance]]. The vividness, clarity, and certainty of visualization determine the magnitude of this collapsing force — crystal-clear vision of inevitable outcome creates such steep probability that manifestation becomes unstoppable.

**Constraint:** Strength and nature of a spell rise with the profundity and clarity of the [[Spellweaver]]'s vivid mental rehearsal. Potency is amplified by unwavering visualization, absolute conviction in inevitable outcome, and enhances the boundaries of manifestation depending on the truthfulness of believing the spell will manifest. Dampened by doubt, overthinking, insecurity, or fragmented vision.

Genuine conviction functions as high-probability collapse—when the [[Spellweaver]]'s visualization remains locked upon their intended outcome with unbreakable certainty, manifestation can model [[Superposed Resonance]] efficiently into the [[Great Harmonic Loom]], creating clean [[Consonance]] and [[Coherence]]. Reality then crystallizes with inevitable force, its effects resolving with geometric precision and adapting organically to circumstance like light refracting through faceted crystal.

Conversely, fractured or wavering conviction acts as probability scattering. When the [[Spellweaver]] allows doubt to cloud their vision, second-guesses their mental forging, or fails to commit fully to the spell's inevitable manifestation before casting, the energy disperses as [[Superposed Resonance]] can't find a clear path towards [[Coherence]] and fragments then into [[Discordant Interference]] on matter that vibrates with hesitation and fear.

The [[Absolute Certainty]] binding is greatly demanding of imagination and will power. It requires unshakeable faith — the willingness to see with perfect clarity, maintain that vision without wavering doubt, and believe with absolute conviction that what has been visualized will inevitably come to pass.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Bindings & Elements/Absolute Certainty.md

entries.title: Age Crisis
entries.epigraph: _"The [[Motif Awakening]] of history itself. Loss is transformation and [[Age Crisis]] are the fabric the world uses to digest its own history to build a wiser future for the next generations."_
entries.summary: An [[Ages]] transition point that ends when certain crisis technologies, or checks are triggered, such as population, [[Events]]s, etc., and they're always what separates [[Ages]] regardless of the time period each comprised.
entries.body:
An [[Ages]] transition point that ends when certain crisis technologies, or checks are triggered, such as population, [[Events]]s, etc., and they're always what separates [[Ages]] regardless of the time period each comprised. There are many but they're always thematically aligned to [[World Event]]s and the climax of pushing one [[Civilization]] limit by introducing tension through their own actions.

Depending on the [[Age Crisis]] some are more sudden than others, for example, [[The Hollowing]] is one of the faster ones which properly begins with the event of [[A Pact of a Thousand Eyes]] which is visible by the rise of the [[All-Loving Moon]]. However, the [[Great Plague]] begins with a simple cough that has relatively mild symptoms until it becomes the Dancing manifestation, from that point onwards it only truly becomes an [[Age Crisis]] when [[Static Criticality]] starts causing the first cities to detonate and the second wave is ravaging everywhere. Similarly, the [[Holy War]] of [[Ages]] V begins as the third crusade of the crusades that have already been happening during the entire age, but it escalates by involving everyone in what is essentially a world war to end all wars.

The most common of these examples is [[The Inescapable Hunger]] which begins with the even of [[A Brown Auric Peach?]] which is only a low quality harvest. However, this event is the first domino towards the end as it signals how the soil is giving away due to the growing population and unsustainable monocropping practices.

_An [[Age Crisis]] never announces itself, you only know you're in an [[Age Crisis]] when it's too late to stop the momentum of compounding catastrophe from consuming the world._
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Rise & Fall, Crisis/Crisis/Age Crisis.md

entries.title: Age of Desolation
entries.epigraph: _"Golden ashes forsaken by the Gods."_
entries.summary: _"The once-great civilization is now reduced to a faraway memory, dwindled to dust, and scattered survivors struggling to find food, shelter, and safety. The land is littered with crumbling structures, decaying in remnants of a gentler past and steeped in a pervasive sense of despair. Only slim, isolated communities form as people strive to piece together their shattered lives, clinging to fragments of ancient knowledge and relics for hope."_
entries.body:
_"The once-great civilization is now reduced to a faraway memory, dwindled to dust, and scattered survivors struggling to find food, shelter, and safety. The land is littered with crumbling structures, decaying in remnants of a gentler past and steeped in a pervasive sense of despair. Only slim, isolated communities form as people strive to piece together their shattered lives, clinging to fragments of ancient knowledge and relics for hope."_

Most of the magic in this age has been lost and there's only instinctive calling to elements to perform [[Minor Note]] basic sorcery, without the knowledge of [[The Principles of Magic]]. Likewise, Due to the [[Vibrational Fallout]] residual in the land, most of the [[Dual Confluence Stream]] is locked, and the low presence of both [[Lunehymn]] and [[Aetherlight]], it is very hard for magic to manifest except for some individuals with very strong [[Motif Awakening]]s.

[[Ornament]]s are completely unavailable in this age, and the only known rhythm tempo is staccato although most [[Spellweaver]]s are unaware of the presence of rhythmic elements for magic.

The point of this era is to survive through the wasteland and find solace in fleeting communities. Most of the world became no man's land and all major empires, borders, and cultures are erased from history leaving only remnants behind. The gathering of magic elements usually comes in the shape of [[Old World Remnants]] with sparse lookout towers sending explorers to the nearby areas.

The [[Age Crisis]] is [[The Inescapable Hunger]]. It's the result from the sudden growth of population reaching unsustainable growth levels given the conditions of the era and the lack of technologies to support through magic enhanced irrigation and harvesting systems. The core concept is to survive this first famine, it always leads to the [[Age of Renewal]] regardless of the success, the only difference between handling properly or poorly the famine is the amount of people surviving through it.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Rise & Fall, Crisis/Passage of Time/Ages of Magic/Ages 0/Age of Desolation.md

entries.summary: First magic primarily based on [[Music Glyph]]s, it's the partial success of [[Great Plague]].
entries.body:
First magic primarily based on [[Music Glyph]]s, it's the partial success of [[Great Plague]].

Music sheets imbued in the [[Circle of Fifths]] as magic runes with a [[Magical Catalyst]] in the center, lower versions use [[Aetherlight]] or [[Lunehymn]], more permanent uses usually rely on a [[Mirrorbox Trap]], a [[Resonance Box]] or [[Sky Glass]]. They appear through the [[Glyphic Heptastave]] and encode magic into the universal language of [[Spellweaving]] through music.

It requires [[Resonance]] and [[Stable Harmonic Channels]] to begin functioning. The music sheet is a [[Resonance Field]] dormant on potential acoustic energy that inscribes itself with [[Coherence]] through [[Sympathetic Vibration]].

[[Music Glyph]]s work like [[Sky Glass]] that retains over a sigil a music track that needs to first store music to then play it back, they are like disposable disks where only the person that has the sigil can hear the music, it's useful for stealth as it is music that doesn't require playing sound. It's the primary vector in how assassins use [[Feather Fall Arts]] without having to play an instrument. They do, however, require to be in sync with the music they are hearing. This becomes a primary point in the [[Amadea, Sonata of the Violet Empress]] for [[Amadea]].

entries.title: Context
entries.summary: The [[Age of Sealing Iron]] is the ultimate, brutal culmination of a species deeply traumatized by its own magical infrastructure, terrified of divine intervention, and desperate to secure its survival through absolute control.
entries.body: The [[Age of Sealing Iron]] is the ultimate, brutal culmination of a species deeply traumatized by its own magical infrastructure, terrified of divine intervention, and desperate to secure its survival through absolute control. To understand why [[Humanity]] resorts to subjugating faes and [[Pure Light]] beings within iron cages during this era, one must trace the psychological scars left by the [[Great Plague]] of Euphoria, the horrors of the [[Outer God]]s, and the bloody evolution of "forbidden" medical technology.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Rise & Fall, Crisis/Passage of Time/Ages of Magic/Ages 9/Age of Sealing Iron.md#Context

entries.title: The Age of Sealing Iron: Progress Through Absolute Control
entries.summary: By [[Ages]] IX (the Industrial Era), [[Civilization]] enters its second "[[Age of Humanity]]". The compounding historical trauma has solidified a singular, unshakeable philosophy: **Safety is the primary drive of civilization, and safety can only be achieved through total structural control over magic and vitality.**
entries.body:
By [[Ages]] IX (the Industrial Era), [[Civilization]] enters its second "[[Age of Humanity]]". The compounding historical trauma has solidified a singular, unshakeable philosophy: **Safety is the primary drive of civilization, and safety can only be achieved through total structural control over magic and vitality.**

This leads directly to the [[Age of Sealing Iron]], a Dark Fae Fantasy era defined by subduing faes and other [[Pure Light]] beings. Having learned from the [[Great Plague]] that [[Pure Light]] creatures left to their own devices will metabolize ambient magic and cause catastrophic cascades, and having learned from the [[Outer God]]s that free-flowing magic invites cosmic predators, [[Humanity]] decides that magic must be caged.

**The iron cages inside their machines are the ultimate trauma response.** By trapping faes and forcing their innate magical essence to act as mechanical engines, [[Humanity]] successfully achieves a different path of industrialization. The fae engines represent the perfect synthesis of [[Humanity]]'s desires:

1. **Uninterrupted Progress:** They still get to utilize the boundless "Vitality" and energy of Pure Light.
2. **Absolute Safety:** By encasing the faes in iron—a symbol of rigid "[[Auric Structure]]" and technological control—they prevent the magic from flowing freely and creating [[Dissonance]], Plagues, or [[Static Criticality]].

In this tragic era, [[Humanity]] driven by the concept of [[Perfect Reflection]] essentially replicates the original sin of the creator deity, the [[Auric Aria]]. Mirroring the [[Betrayal of the Moon]] but now in an anthropocentric view as the crowned creation of [[Arcanoria]]. The [[Age of Sealing Iron]] proves that [[Humanity]]'s historical trauma has taught them that the only way to survive in a chaotic, magical universe is to become the ultimate jailers of it, and it is divine right to do so.
entries.section: The Age of Sealing Iron: Progress Through Absolute Control
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Rise & Fall, Crisis/Passage of Time/Ages of Magic/Ages 9/Age of Sealing Iron.md#The Age of Sealing Iron: Progress Through Absolute Control

entries.title: The Birth of "Forbidden" Technology and the Drive for Safety
entries.summary: Driven by the compounded trauma of apocalyptic plagues and predatory gods, humanity began seeking methods of survival that relied on physical laws, science, and [[Auric Structure]] rather than unpredictable magic and divine mercy.
entries.body:
Driven by the compounded trauma of apocalyptic plagues and predatory gods, humanity began seeking methods of survival that relied on physical laws, science, and [[Auric Structure]] rather than unpredictable magic and divine mercy.

This shift began painfully. In [[Ages]] IV, a doctor ([[Vals Jenner]]) studying the leftover traces of the [[Great Plague]] became the first epidemiologist to develop a vaccine. However, because society was still gripped by magical and religious superstition, this life-saving technology was deemed "forbidden," and she was executed for treason and witchcraft.

Despite this tragic setback, the seeds of scientific control were planted. This forbidden research directly inspired the brutal but revolutionary work of Dr. [[Cadmus Tacet]] in [[Ages]] V. Operating under the philosophy that [[Humanity]] must carve out its own survival, [[Cadmus Tacet]] pioneered the first surgeries and experiments on [[Pure Light]] beings to understand the [[Auric Structure]] vs [[Pure Light]] spectrum and [[Coherence-Binding Tissue]]. While his methods were exceptionally cruel, they represented a necessary scientific advancement in understanding how to manipulate and control the very beings that had once brought both wonder and plagues. By subjugating [[Pure Light]] biology to the scalpel of human reason, Dr. [[Cadmus Tacet]] sought to remove the volatility of magic, famously coining this era the first true "[[Age of Humanity]]".
entries.section: The Birth of "Forbidden" Technology and the Drive for Safety
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Rise & Fall, Crisis/Passage of Time/Ages of Magic/Ages 9/Age of Sealing Iron.md#The Birth of "Forbidden" Technology and the Drive for Safety

entries.title: The Trauma of the Great Plague: The Betrayal of Pure Light
entries.summary: The foundational trauma for humanity's relationship with magic and [[Pure Light]] begins in [[Ages]] I with the [[Great Plague]] of Euphoria. Before the plague, humanity lived in harmony with [[Pure Light]] creatures, most notably the [[Luminant Moths]], which were widely domesticated and beloved for their beautiful light and economic utility.
entries.body:
The foundational trauma for humanity's relationship with magic and [[Pure Light]] begins in [[Ages]] I with the [[Great Plague]] of Euphoria. Before the plague, humanity lived in harmony with [[Pure Light]] creatures, most notably the [[Luminant Moths]], which were widely domesticated and beloved for their beautiful light and economic utility.

However, this reliance on magical infrastructure inadvertently triggered an apocalypse. The intense extraction of magic from the [[Leylines]] created a massive imbalance in the [[Dual Confluence Stream]], which in turn activated dormant fungal spores that weaponized the bacteria inside the [[Luminant Moths]]. The result was catastrophic: the beloved moths became invisible vectors for a bio-magical neurotoxin, [[EC]], that hijacked the human nervous system, causing uncontrollable dancing, Euphoria, and eventually, apocalyptic magical nuclear explosions known as [[Static Criticality]] cascades.

This instilled a deep, civilizational trauma: magic and [[Pure Light]] beings are inherently volatile and existentially dangerous. [[Humanity]] learned the hard way that their love for light and magic created the very catastrophe that nearly wiped them out. Relying on the natural flow of the [[Great Harmonic Loom]] proved to be a death sentence.
entries.section: The Trauma of the Great Plague: The Betrayal of Pure Light
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Rise & Fall, Crisis/Passage of Time/Ages of Magic/Ages 9/Age of Sealing Iron.md#The Trauma of the Great Plague: The Betrayal of Pure Light

entries.title: The Trauma of the Outer Gods: The Danger of Divine Dependence
entries.summary: As humanity reeled from the [[Great Plague]] and subsequent crises, they sought salvation from the heavens, making themselves vulnerable to the [[Outer God]]s, most notably [[Lacrimosa]] during [[Ages]] II and III. [[Lacrimosa]] took advantage of [[Humanity]]'s profound grief and desire to escape suffering by orchestrating [[The Hollowing]].
entries.body:
As humanity reeled from the [[Great Plague]] and subsequent crises, they sought salvation from the heavens, making themselves vulnerable to the [[Outer God]]s, most notably [[Lacrimosa]] during [[Ages]] II and III. [[Lacrimosa]] took advantage of [[Humanity]]'s profound grief and desire to escape suffering by orchestrating [[The Hollowing]].

By creating a cult of the "[[Purest of Love]]," [[Lacrimosa]] convinced desperate populations to surrender their [[Consciousness]] to her in exchange for numbness and peace, actively attempting to merge all of humanity into the giant [[All-Loving Moon]]. This period, known as the [[Age of the False Messiah]], proved that appealing to the divine or relying on cosmic entities only leads to mass manipulation, the loss of human agency, and the erasure of individual identity. [[Humanity]] realized they were entirely at the mercy of entities that viewed them as either tools or vessels. This was further exacerbated by the wars of cults during [[Ages]] V with the [[Age of the Sacred Cross]], [[Age of Horrors]], and the [[Age of Covens]].

Later the development of hemomancy in the [[Age of Blood]] demonstrated that there's a loophole in [[Essence Sacrifice]] if you use someone else's vitality to fuel your own. [[Vampire]] mages that sacrificed their own blood for fueling spells and then used blood transfusions to earn their blood back proved in theory that [[Pure Light]] too could be rerouted.
entries.section: The Trauma of the Outer Gods: The Danger of Divine Dependence
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Rise & Fall, Crisis/Passage of Time/Ages of Magic/Ages 9/Age of Sealing Iron.md#The Trauma of the Outer Gods: The Danger of Divine Dependence

entries.title: Age of The End
entries.summary: Also known as the Age of Genesis, this the final and secret age of [[Arcanoria]] only unlockable after concluding the [[Sonata]] of [[Arcanoria]], also known as the [[Sonata]] of the Interwoven Threads of Gold and Silver. The age representing the [[Weight of Change]] and the hardest of all [[Essence Sacrifice]].
entries.body:
Also known as the Age of Genesis, this the final and secret age of [[Arcanoria]] only unlockable after concluding the [[Sonata]] of [[Arcanoria]], also known as the [[Sonata]] of the Interwoven Threads of Gold and Silver. The age representing the [[Weight of Change]] and the hardest of all [[Essence Sacrifice]].

This is the only age beyond the [[Age of the Hypermage]], and it is a one way route as entering the [[Age of The End]] deactivates [[The Ultimate Weapon]] as the final directive of its wish has finally been fulfilled, it created a timeline where [[Humanity]] surpassed the progressive and societal development that doomed the [[Lost Cycle]].

As a result, without [[The Ultimate Weapon]] there are no more safety nets for another [[Divine Reset]] and its resolution dictates one of the several endings of [[Arcanoria]] depending on how it resolves during its [[Age Crisis]].

**The greatest danger of the [[Age of The End]] is that the [[Known Universe]], [[Humanity]], and [[Arcanoria]] can be wiped out for good this time.**

The [[Auric Aria]] on the Choice of the End after [[A True Sine Wave]] opened the path to a Time Beyond Time, with now everything behind only the [[Auric Aria]] remains on the edge of the cosmos:

_"It... worked! It really worked!!! You made the impossible possible."

_"We have reached the very End of Time. I can't believe the path forward is finally here for all [[Ages]]!"

_(As she's overwhelmed with joy, a sudden realization silences her immediately)_

_"It worked... And... Ah..."_

_"The path... It's... It's only missing the final [[Essence Sacrifice]]."_

_(The [[Auric Aria]] is on the verge of tears, as the initial joy sweeps away, with some starting to slide down her chin)_

_"I promised myself... I wouldn't... cry..."_

_"I'm sorry... for not being strong enough even now... and for breaking again one last time..."_

_(After a deep silence the [[Auric Aria]], while regaining a sliver of her [[Composure]]. She extends with a deep breath the final invitation for crystallizing the final directive of the [[Known Universe]])_

_"You may wish to create the only possible path forward. At the cost of everything... for [[Civilization]]..."_

_"Or..."_

_"You could... wish for a reset? With all of your saved progress intact... And you and I... Can start again?"_

After a moment in black the achievement of the Purest of All Love fires, and then the final message resurfaces with the simplified version of the [[Soul Leitmotif]] of the [[Auric Aria]] plays with a picture depicting the [[Auric Aria]], [[Selenea]], [[Lacrimosa]] alongside several [[Singer of Paradise]] overviewing [[Civilization]] from the World Tree at the Garden of Life.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Rise & Fall, Crisis/Passage of Time/Ages of Magic/Ages 13/Age of The End.md

entries.title: Age of Velvet Elegance
entries.epigraph: _"The most expensive and exquisite commodity is the friction of the soul."_
entries.summary: First true taste of the full extent of the [[Seven Weights]] primarily the [[Weight of Indulgence]] + [[Weight of Value]]. Evolution of the [[Age of Blood]] + [[Velvet Nectar]] and [[Velvet Ambrosia]].
entries.body:
First true taste of the full extent of the [[Seven Weights]] primarily the [[Weight of Indulgence]] + [[Weight of Value]]. Evolution of the [[Age of Blood]] + [[Velvet Nectar]] and [[Velvet Ambrosia]].

The [[Age of Velvet Elegance]] is not an just an age of art, reverence, philosophy, or technological breakthrough. It is an age where suffering has been fully aestheticized — where the most refined taste is measured not by one's appreciation of music or painting, but by one's ability to distinguish the flavor profiles of different victims, different breaking points, different trajectories of resistance and surrender.

In an horrific display is an age where the [[Weight of Value]] on the velvet is real. The elegance is real. The horror is that no one in power sees it as horror anymore, it is the most intense of indulgences, and it is nowhere more evident than in the idyllic fabricated "paradises" of [[Velvet Throne]]s which are both a sanctuary and a prison.

The signature and ultimate status of art is the [[Memory Singer]] and the beautiful nests it creates. It is the most important symbol and creature of the age.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Rise & Fall, Crisis/Passage of Time/Ages of Magic/Ages 9/Age of Velvet Elegance.md

entries.title: The Closed Table of Moguls — The Inner Sanctum
entries.summary: The highest grade of [[Velvet Ambrosia]] is never sold openly. It is auctioned at closed tables — private, invitation-only gatherings held in soundproofed chambers lined with [[Emberwhisper]] velvet. Attendees are not "customers." They are the top aristocrats of society, connoisseurs, patrons, collectors. They refer to themselves as "The Table of Velvet Elegance."
entries.body:
The highest grade of [[Velvet Ambrosia]] is never sold openly. It is auctioned at closed tables — private, invitation-only gatherings held in soundproofed chambers lined with [[Emberwhisper]] velvet. Attendees are not "customers." They are the top aristocrats of society, connoisseurs, patrons, collectors. They refer to themselves as "The Table of Velvet Elegance."

Each closed table seats between four and twelve. The room is dim, lit by captive [[Luminance]] sprites in [[Crystal]] cages. The table itself is carved from fossilized [[Glimmerfern]] root — the irony of using remorse-crystallized wood to hold vessels of harvested suffering is lost on no one and appreciated by all.

The ritual begins first with a banquette, and after the last cup is served, it turns into absolute silence with only the sound of the imperial viola concertist and a quartet of cellos.

Everyone wears animalistic masks. Then the Sommelier of Surrender enters, wearing a blindfold of silk — a deliberate mockery of [[Lacrimosa]]'s sacred promise to [[Mira]]. The blindfold is not for modesty. It is to prove that the Sommelier can identify every nuance of the [[Velvet Ambrosia]] by resonance alone.

There is no menu of flavors. There is a catalog of lives. Not food but biographies.

Each entry is a leather-bound folio, its cover embossed with the victim's [[Soul Leitmotif]] primary color and a single word: Harvested. Inside, the connoisseur reads:

- **The victim's name, and their [[Legend Title]]s** (if known — anonymity is considered inferior; a named victim has legacy, especially with a collection of strong [[Legend Title]]s)
- **Their binding an [[Ornament]]s** ([[Resonance]], [[Luminance]], [[Flux]], etc. — each produces different "notes" of a chord)
- **Their origin and a painting of their portrait** (peasant, scholar, soldier, Spellweaver — how beautiful they are before their submission affects the "body" of the taste) [[Auric Aria]]
- **Their defining wound** (the [[Motif Awakening]] that made them a [[Spellweaver]] — this is the "terroir" with a likely assessment of their [[Motif Awakening]] Wish)
- **Their known [[Legend Opus]] and [[Legend Trait]]s** (A [[Reckless]] conqueror? Spicy, a [[Selfless]] ruler that did everything to prevent the fall of their kingdom? Sweet and sour. These elements become part of the collections themselves)
- **The circumstances of capture** (Prisoner of Conquest? Political Dissident? Ambush? Seduction? Betrayal? Each method imparts different "overtones")
- **The duration of subdual** (How many sessions, how many days, how much resistance and the methods of subduing)
- **The breaking point** (The precise moment they stopped fighting — catalogued with clinical precision)
- **The peak resistance moment** (When they fought hardest — this is the vintage)
- **The final emotional residue profile** (A graph of shame, defiance, grief, longing, terror)
- **The yield** (How many vials, and their graded quality)

The final page of each folio is a pricing guide for the upcoming auction.

**The Bidding Language**

Connoisseurs do not bid in currency alone. They also add to their bid in patronage — access to rare victims, funding for future harvests, protection for extraction enclaves, or the trade of even rarer [[Velvet Ambrosia]] vintages from closed collections.

The auctioneer's chant is ritualized:

> *"Lot Seven: The Tragic Story of the Iron Willed Unyielding Beauty. [[Luminance]] primary, [[Strand]] and [[Crystal]] [[Ornament]]s. A border knight of the Iron who held a pass against an [[Obsessian]] incursion for three days. She was taken by the high hills [[Velvet Throne]] after her garrison was starved out during a Velvet Incursion. Her resistance lasted eighteen sessions. The first seven, she sang. The next six, she wept. The final five, she was silent. The peak came on the eleventh session, when a vivid hallucination triggered her to named each of her fallen soldiers before the parasites finally broke her. Flavor profile: salt-bitter opening that mellows with time until a a bloom of honeyed defiance, the most palatable taste finishes with a cool, refreshing flavor. This last empty void is exceptional and reminiscent of stardust the very moment a star stops shining — she surrendered not to pleasure, but to exhaustion. Opening bid: 3 million marks and access to a collection of [[Memory Field]]s for one [[Echo]]."*

Bids are made with taps on the table and a set of imagery of velvet cards set in several cardinal directions representing their bid — one tap for yes, two for no, three to raise. Silence is considered the highest form of respect; a lot that receives no bids is not a failure — it is a requiem, and the [[Velvet Ambrosia]] is poured out as an offering to [[Lacrimosa]]'s blindfolded image on the far wall.

entries.title: The Layers of Horror as Commodity
entries.summary: **The Catalog as Biography**
entries.body:
**The Catalog as Biography**

The victim is not anonymous. Their life is documented, celebrated, consumed. The connoisseur reads their tragedy as one might read a wine vintage report. And part of the aesthetic horror is that the victim's humanity is fully acknowledged — and then eaten anyway. The [[Weight of Value]] at its upmost dehumanization not through erasure but through overexposure. The victim is known intimately, then digested.

**The Breaking Point as Vintage**

Wine vintages are defined by the year's weather, soil conditions, harvest timing. [[Velvet Ambrosia]] vintages are defined by when and how the victim broke. A victim who surrenders quickly produces a "simple" [[Velvet Ambrosia]] — sweet, immediate, forgettable. A victim who resists for weeks, who cycles through denial, rage, bargaining, despair, and finally surrender — that victim produces a complex [[Velvet Ambrosia]] with layered notes that unfold on the tongue like a symphony.

The connoisseur is not tasting the victim's suffering. They are tasting the arc of that suffering. The moment of peak resistance is the vintage year — the flavor that lingers longest.

**The Session Count as Aging**

The document notes: *"how many sessions did it take to subdue to age the flavor."*

In [[Velvet Ambrosia]] production, each session of subdual adds a layer. The first session produces a raw, volatile "young" [[Velvet Ambrosia]] — harsh, immediate, overwhelming. The tenth session produces a "mellowed" [[Velvet Ambrosia]] — the victim's resistance has been worn smooth, their shame integrated into a cohesive emotional profile.

Connoisseurs debate the optimal session count. Too few, and the [[Velvet Ambrosia]] lacks depth. Too many, and the victim's emotional range collapses into flat despair — "over-extracted," "tired," "uninteresting." The ideal victim is one who maintains a spark of defiance until the very end — who never fully surrenders but is finally overwhelmed. This produces the most "balanced" [[Velvet Ambrosia]].

The connoisseur is not tasting the victim's pain. They are tasting the efficiency of the extraction process — and mourning the victims who broke too soon as "wasted potential."

**The Closed Table as Performance of Detachment**

The connoisseurs do not laugh or sneer. They are serious. They take notes. They debate the subtle differences between a victim broken by Pleasure Parasites versus the process of Memory Reavers. They speak of "mouthfeel" and "finish" and "emotional persistence" with the same vocabulary as a Michelin-starred sommelier.

This is not sadism as glee. It is sadism as connoisseurship in a twisted way to "honor" their suffering albeit refined, intellectualized, aestheticized. The connoisseur believes they are appreciating the victim, not exploiting them. The victim's suffering is framed as a gift, a sacrifice to the altar of taste.

The horror is that the connoisseur is not lying to themselves. They genuinely feel reverence. They genuinely weep at a particularly beautiful breaking point. They genuinely believe their consumption is an act of witnessing, of honoring — a perversion of [[Mira]]'s original teaching that witnessing suffering is love. Here, witnessing is consumption, and consumption is the highest form of love.

**The Blindfolded Sommelier as Theological Mockery**

The Sommelier of Surrender wears a blindfold — a direct echo of [[Lacrimosa]]'s vow to [[Mira]]. But [[Lacrimosa]]'s blindfold was a promise to protect [[Mira]]'s eyes from cruelty. The Sommelier's blindfold is a claim of purity — they do not need to see the victim's face to taste their essence. They are, in their own mind, a purist.

The mockery is complete. The sacred becomes profane. The promise becomes performance. And the connoisseurs, who understand the reference, smile at the cleverness. It complicates the fact that [[The Hollowing]] was stopped before it could remove all suffering that would've prevented this very age from unfolding.

**The Pouring Out as False Redemption**

When a lot receives no bids, the [[Velvet Ambrosia]] is poured out before [[Lacrimosa]]'s blindfolded image. This is framed as an offering, a requiem, a release.

In truth, it is waste disposal that then gets recycled to sell into the commoner markets at a high price for the lower strata of [[Civilization]] — the [[Velvet Ambrosia]] was not good enough to sell to the very top, so it is ritually "destroyed" to maintain the illusion of ethical consumption. The connoisseurs do not drink it. They do not honor the victim. They discard them — but they do so with ceremony, because ceremony is cheaper than conscience. And the aftermath of selling the [[Velvet Ambrosia]] to the lower classes is a way to gather more funds to continue the efforts of the [[Age of Velvet Elegance]].
entries.section: The Layers of Horror as Commodity
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Rise & Fall, Crisis/Passage of Time/Ages of Magic/Ages 9/Age of Velvet Elegance.md#The Layers of Horror as Commodity

entries.title: The Social Stratification of the Velvet Elegance
entries.summary: **The Upper Tier — The Collectors**
entries.body:
**The Upper Tier — The Collectors**

These are the connoisseurs at the closed tables. They do not produce [[Velvet Ambrosia]] themselves — that would be vulgar. They curate. They maintain private cellars of rare vintages. They trade folios like collectible cards. They are the 0.1% of the 0.1%.

Their status is measured by:

- The age of their oldest vintage
- The rarity of the victims in their collection and the combination of their [[Legend Opus]] and the pairing of the Personality [[Legend Trait]]s.
- The completeness of their catalog (do they have all seven binding types? all eight [[Atonalis]]-path residues?)
- The presence of "unicorn" vintages (victims who were never truly broken — who chose to be harvested despite everything to prevent further suffering of a loved one or of their own kingdom — these are the most prized)

**The Middle Tier — The Patrons**

These are the financiers and defenders of extraction [[Enclave]]s. They do not usually attend closed tables — they are not refined enough — but they are invited to "tasting previews" where they can purchase futures contracts on upcoming harvests or are given the chance to purchase whatever was discarded.

They are the venture capitalists of suffering. They fund expeditions to capture [[Great Spellweaver]]s, begin new wars of conquest and subjugation for capturing more prisoners, bankroll the construction of Velvet Thrones, and sponsor research into more efficient extraction methods. They speak of "optimizing the resistance curve" and "maximizing emotional yield per session."

They believe they are entrepreneurs. They are not wrong — they are simply entrepreneurs of atrocity.

**The Lower Tier — The Producers**

These are the workers who operate the extraction [[Enclave]]s — the handlers of Pleasure Parasites, the Memory Reaver technicians, the wardens of the Velvet Thrones. They do not taste the [[Velvet Ambrosia]]. They are paid in marks and coin, not in vintages. They are the proletariat of pain at the very edge of the hierarchy before the true populace.

They tell themselves they are not responsible for what happens above. They are just doing a job. The connoisseurs would never say such a thing — they are too refined for self-deception. The workers are the only honest ones, and their honesty is their condemnation.

**The Bottom — Everyone else

The average citizen isn't considered part of the social class structure. In many senses, they are raw material ranging from the people who die in wars of conquest for the [[Velvet Throne]], as addicts to the substances produced, or as victims that are eventually reintegrated into society. For this last group, their names are known only to the cataloguers. Their faces are seen only by the Sommeliers (who are blindfolded) and the technicians (who do not look). They exist in the space between personhood and product — acknowledged sometimes as future ingredients to enhance the flavor of a celebration, treated as cattle to enable the harvest while they coexist with the cogs that keep the empire of war and conquest ongoing.

The horror is that some of them agree. The [[Weight of Indulgence]] is a law. Once tasted, the higher reality of even low quality [[Velvet Nectar]] (even as victim, even as source) becomes the baseline. Some victims that become ingredients are even repeat donors — returning to the [[Velvet Throne]]s voluntarily because the numbness of normal life is unbearable. They are sometimes cogs that are more than prisoners. They are addicts, to either [[Aetherlight]], [[Lunehymn]] or discarded [[Velvet Nectar]]. And the system loves them, because their willing surrender is what keeps the entire engine going.

For the [[Age of Velvet Elegance]] the [[Velvet Ambrosia]] is a prayer to the vast unknown. And the prayer is answered not only by an [[Outer God]], but by the silence of the closed table, where everyone pretends they are not also, in some other context, already on the menu.

_No life is more significant than the eventual static release of [[The Infinite Void]], and the [[Weight of Value]] holds the soul of no one but bottled as commodity._

entries.title: Ages
entries.epigraph: _"History is an evolving musical score."_
entries.summary: Backbone for all of the [[Ages]] in [[Arcanoria]] from a high level standpoint. Each goes through several groups from Age 0 to 14, it represents the stage of societal, magical, scientifical, and technological development and it carries along some history until the next reset from a [[Cataclysmic Aftermath]].
entries.body:
Backbone for all of the [[Ages]] in [[Arcanoria]] from a high level standpoint. Each goes through several groups from Age 0 to 14, it represents the stage of societal, magical, scientifical, and technological development and it carries along some history until the next reset from a [[Cataclysmic Aftermath]].

Furthermore, [[Ages]] are defined by [[Act of Fate]]s which are one third of the [[Ages]] duration, separating the Early, Middle, and Late version of these [[Ages]], moreover, every 3 [[Ages]] the third will always have 4 [[Act of Fate]]s signaling the "long [[Ages]]." They are intrinsically tied to [[Cosmic Motion]]. Usually the division of an [[Act of Fate]] is a minor version of a [[World Event]] or minor [[Age Crisis]] which can be natural disasters, political conflicts, and other related major significant paradigm shifts for the age.

The diagram of all [[Ages]] is the following:

Excess [[Era Score]] above the required for a [[Golden Age]] becomes points that can redeem failed [[Age Crisis]] checks. Even if [[Civilization]] performs poorly during an [[Age Crisis]], it can be saved by the excess [[Era Score]] to go back into a [[Golden Age]] or resist a [[Dark Age]]. Additional [[Era Score]] is a saving grace buffer for [[Ages]] transitions.

It's possible to change age type every end of an [[Act of Fate]], these changes are called [[Triadic Pivot]]s, but it can only go up or down one stage, such as [[Age of Embers]] ([[Dark Age]]) turning first to [[Age of Glyphs]] ([[Classical Age]]) and then into [[Age of Behemoths]] ([[Golden Age]]) across the entirety of [[Ages]] II.

The final age type that history will remember is classified based on the division of two weighted variables:

- 50% based on which [[Act of Fate]] generated the most [[Era Score]].
- 50% based on which [[Act of Fate]] generated the most [[Lyrical Fragment]]s.

All of the [[Ages]] are representing one of the seven bindings of the [[Auric Heptacode]] or one of the [[Seven Weights]]. Some of these deal with inversions, such as [[Emotional Authenticity]] being represented by the [[Ages]] of [[Lacrimosa]] given that the hollowing precisely aims at removing all suffering by removing the self that feels. Some others such as [[Sufficient Precision]] deal with encoding [[The Principles of Magic]] precisely in law as to understand reality. Past the [[Auric Heptacode]], all [[Ages]] deal with their primary weight.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Rise & Fall, Crisis/Passage of Time/Ages.md

entries.title: Tier 1: Ages of Foundations & Early Magic
entries.summary: **All Life is Friction.**
entries.body:
**All Life is Friction.**

### Age 0 ([[Ages]] of [[Cataclysmic Aftermath]] | Stone Age) | [[Weight of Change]]

3 [[Act of Fate]].

Fractured [[Arcanoria]] after a [[Cataclysmic Aftermath]].
Flickering Staccato Rhythm. Unreliable [[Unison]] and [[Dyad]] Spells. Mostly [[Minor Note]] magic.

- [[Age of Desolation]] | Not Aligned with [[Pillars]] ([[Age Crisis]]: [[The Inescapable Hunger]]) | Dark Fantasy
- [[Age of the Wolf Tone Winter]] | [[Waltz Pillar]] (Attainable after the Second [[Cataclysmic Aftermath]])

The [[Age Crisis]] teaches that there are [[Civilization]] changing events at the end of all [[Ages]]. [[Amadea]]

_[[Age Crisis]] exist._

### Age I ([[Ages]] of Ecological Rebirth | Bronze to Iron Age) | [[Key of Attunement]]

3 [[Act of Fate]].

Healing from the [[Cataclysmic Aftermath]] fallout.
Introducing Legato. First Stable [[Unison]]. Introducing [[Major Note]]s, and sparse [[Dyad Chord]]s Magic.

[[Ages]]:

- [[Age of Renewal]] | Not Aligned with [[Pillars]] ([[Age Crisis]]: [[Great Plague]] of Euphoria) | Dark Fantasy
- [[Age of Hymns]] | [[Waltz Pillar]] (Attainable after learning [[The Truth of Arcanoria]] after the [[Cataclysmic Aftermath]] of the [[Second Reset]]) | Dark Fantasy

The [[Age Crisis]] teaches that [[Civilization]] can fail and the resolution of the [[Cataclysmic Aftermath]] leads to a different [[Golden Age]], [[Classical Age]], or [[Dark Age]] from the survivors.

_You can fail an [[Age Crisis]]._

### Age II ([[Ages]] of the Rise of Magic | Early Classical Antiquity) | [[Sufficient Precision]]

4 [[Act of Fate]].

Establishment of [[The Principles of Magic]]. Rise of the [[Mythical Virtuoso]]
Introducing Ritardando. Stable [[Dyad Chord]]s. [[Unison]] Primacy. Rare [[Triad Chord]]s. Basic Magic.

The [[Age Crisis]] is variations of the start of [[The Hollowing]], [[A Pact of a Thousand Eyes]], or [[Voice of the Heavens]]. It is the first age to have more than one crisis that depends entirely on the [[Civilization]] behavior and if they were the ones that invited an [[Outer God]], [[Lacrimosa]], to [[Arcanoria]].

The [[Age Crisis]] teaches that there's more than one [[Age Crisis]] possible, and the paths of [[World Event]]s have variation depending on the resolution. If the [[Civilization]] loses to [[Lacrimosa]] they become the "villain" as one of the satellites supporting [[The Hollowing]] during the [[Age of the False Messiah]]. It proves [[Civilization]] is not static and there is no "correct" route to development.

[[Ages]]:

- [[Age of Behemoths]] | [[Chorus Pillar]] / [[Aureus Pillar]] ([[Golden Age]]) | Light Fantasy
- [[Age of Glyphs]] | [[Regalia Pillar]] ([[Classical Age]]) | High Fantasy
- [[Age of Silk]] | [[Waltz Pillar]] ([[Classical Age]]) | Dark Fantasy
- [[Age of Embers]] | [[Waltz Pillar]] ([[Dark Age]]) | Dark Fantasy

The [[Age Crisis]] teaches that [[Civilization]] can trigger different types of [[Age Crisis]] based on their involvement with the triggers during the [[Ages]]. [[World Event]]s have different manifestations, they're not always the same [[Age Crisis]].

_There is more than one possible [[Age Crisis]] depending on your actions._

### Age III ([[Ages]] of [[Lacrimosa]] | Late Classical Antiquity) | [[Emotional Authenticity]]

3 [[Act of Fate]].

**Cause of [[The Birth of the Hyper Chord]] accident with whomever is on the side of [[Lacrimosa]]. Teasing to the [[Polychord Crisis]] and the eventual [[Divine Reset]]. This causes the manifestation of [[The Ultimate Weapon]] next [[Ages]].**

Mastery of the [[The Principles of Magic]].
Starting point of proper [[Ornament]]al Magic. Full resolution of the [[World Event]] of [[The Hollowing]] and [[Lacrimosa]] brewing through the whole age.

First classical civilizations.
Introducing Accelerando. First Reliable [[Triad Chord]]s. [[Dyad Chord]] Primacy. [[Unison]] Mastery.

The [[Age Crisis]] is variations of end of [[The Hollowing]], [[Opposing the Heavens]], [[The Undeniable Moon]], [[The Birth of the Hyper Chord]], depending on their relationship with her and the stance they take as either a [[Major Actor]] or [[Minor Actor]].

The [[Age Crisis]] teaches that there's different roles [[Civilization]] can take in [[World Event]]s and [[Age Crisis]].

The [[Age Crisis]] teaches that [[Civilization]] can participate as a [[Major Actor]] or a [[Minor Actor]] in [[World Event]]s, and that they can pick whichever side they decide on the conflict.

_There are [[Minor Actor]] and [[Major Actor]] roles for [[Age Crisis]] and stories._

entries.summary: **All Law requires Memory.**
entries.body:
**All Law requires Memory.**

### Age IV ([[Ages]] of the Early Medieval) | [[Essence Sacrifice]]

3 [[Act of Fate]].

**[[Ages]] IV onwards there are [[Magical Relic]], [[Cursed Objects]] and [[World-Bending Relics]]. Also the [[Original Eight]] become empowered, each primordial demon becoming a reckoning force during a specific set of [[Ages]].**

It starts with the [[Morpheus Abysmal]] and the [[Atonalis]] Reign but extends all the way to the second [[Cataclysmic Aftermath]]. In empowered [[Ages]] the specific [[Original Eight]] will revive instantly if they were killed, ignoring the normal cooldown of resurrection, and they will have special interactions, dialogue, and [[World Event]]s tied to them as core antagonists.

Resolution of the [[Law of Relics]] and [[The Hollowing]] allow for [[World-Bending Relics]] to exist from now onwards, giving permanence to both [[Magical Relic]], and [[Cursed Objects]].

Exploration and classical RPG focused with small settlements & castles.

Introducing Polyrhythms. Reliable Basic [[Triad Chord]]s. [[Dyad Chord]] Primacy. [[Unison]] Mastery.
Starting point of Advanced Magic.

_There is more than a single [[World Event]] for an [[Age Crisis]].

The [[Age Crisis]] teaches that [[Civilization]] can have multiple [[World Event]]s at the end of an era, and each is an [[Age Crisis]]. During these [[Ages]] all [[Atonalis]] and [[Primal Discordia]] are going to be much more aggressive as [[Lacrimosa]]'s [[The Hollowing]] invertedly did resolve the amount of suffering in [[Arcanoria]], for which most [[Atonalis]] that survived their "[[The Inescapable Hunger]]" period are going to be starving for [[Resonance]] and will try to get it by any means necessary.

The [[World Event]]s of this [[Ages]] are going to involve the [[Primal Discordia]], for which the [[Morpheus Abysmal]] becomes the most prominent one with the [[Atonalis]] reign, conquering regions that will become subject to the [[Age of Horrors]].

Moreover, the amount of [[Atonalis]] present during this time is going to be the source of the first [[Institute]]s and the [[Dissonance League]] of [[Enclave]]s that begin experimenting on [[Atonalis]] at the cost of [[Humanity]] suffering. Ranging from cruel experiments like the crude refinery of [[Velvet Nectar]] to other methods of understanding how a [[Soul Leitmotif]] cracks into [[Dissonance Core]]s.

The [[Morpheus Abysmal]] is the first [[Atonalis]] government type structure and it speaks on the tongues of the [[Eight-Born Paths]].

[[The Ultimate Weapon]] appears as a legendary [[Crisis Wonders]] as it "detects" the [[Primal White Noise]] that [[Lacrimosa]] unleashed when she performed the [[Hyper Chord]]. It remains active during this era but disappears the next. This is why the Crusades are after the [[Holy War]]. It did exist for a while.

The [[Obsessian]] [[Looping Paradox]] [[Primal Discordia]] appears at the time as a massive dungeon meshi style backroom, it is one of the possible manifestations of other [[Original Eight]] that isn't the [[Morpheus Abysmal]]. The dungeon has [[Cursed Objects]] and sometimes [[World-Bending Relics]] because of the relationships that form inside it as more adventurers go in and perish, the misremembering of the relationships inside it become tangible objects with all the [[Emotional Residue]] of everyone who previously stayed inside. This is why there's powerful loot in the [[Obsessian]] [[Original Eight]] dungeon. Misremembered dream stuff.

**[[Original Eight]] Empowered: [[The Eight-Tongued King]]. [[Animach]]**

### Age V ([[Ages]] of the Middle Medieval) | [[Perfect Focus]]

4 [[Act of Fate]].

First "[[Age of Humanity]]"

Advanced Polyrhythms. Advanced [[Triad Chord]]s. [[Dyad Chord]] Mastery. [[Unison]] Mastery. Advanced [[Ornament]]al Magic Development. Unreliable [[Tetrad Chord]]s. First [[Hyper Chord]].

[[Ages]]:

- [[Age of the Sacred Cross]] ([[Golden Age]]) | [[Regalia Pillar]] + [[Aureus Pillar]] | Dark Fantasy
- [[Age of Spirit Petals]] ([[Golden Age]]) | [[Chorus Pillar]] + [[Waltz Pillar]] | Mythic Fantasy (Wuxia)
- [[Age of Crowns]] ([[Classical Age]]) | Not Aligned in [[Pillars]]  | High Fantasy
- [[Age of Covens]] ([[Classical Age]]) | [[Regalia Pillar]] + [[Chorus Pillar]] | Dark Fantasy
- [[Age of Horrors]] ([[Dark Age]]) | [[Chorus Pillar]] | Horror Fantasy

_Even if there's multiple [[World Event]]s, they can still converge as [[Age Crisis]] with several [[Major Actor]]s. Each with their own agenda and means of survival._

The [[Age Crisis]] teaches that all [[Major Actor]]s have their own agenda, and even if there's multiple [[World Event]]s they can still converge as the [[Age Crisis]] that has multiple conflicting factions fighting for their own agenda and survival. This is demonstrated by 3 different [[World Event]] [[Age Crisis]] running on parallel that will intersect and complicate during the crusades.

The map will be divided into many factions ongoing between the crusades, the [[Atonalis]], the increasing [[Age of Horrors]], the invoked [[Outer God]] apocalypse, and only one can survive the entire battle royale with the [[Legend]] of making a wish on the Holy Grail, [[The Ultimate Weapon]].

Tragically, this war for the Holy Grail is not a path to victory; it is a cosmic reset button, and the factions are fighting to the death just to pull the plug on their own existence. While they are unable to get to [[The Ultimate Weapon]], the winner will be awarded one of the [[World-Bending Relics]], and the fixation with [[The Ultimate Weapon]] becomes the end point of the next [[Ages]] that devolve into the [[Polychord Crisis]] after a final crusade begins and ends with the firing of [[Primal White Noise]].

**[[Original Eight]] Empowered: [[The Imperium Obsessus]]. [[Violux]]**

### Age VI ([[Ages]] of the High Medieval) | [[Absolute Certainty]]

3 [[Act of Fate]].

Focus on Kingdom to Empire, established civilizations, culture, courts, secrets.

_First Cultural Conflicts, Advanced Espionage, Owls of Minerva, Assassins, Betrayals, Courtship, Political Drama & Diplomatic Scandals._

All rhythm types available. First Semi Stable [[Tetrad Chord]]s. [[Triad Chord]] Primacy. [[Dyad Chord]] Mastery. [[Unison]] Mastery. Critical [[Hyper Chord]]s.
[[Hollowmarch]]
Starting point of Mastery of Magic.

_[[Age Crisis]] can end [[Civilization]] and lead to a [[Civilization Reset]]._

**[[Original Eight]] Empowered: The Hollow Pilgrim. [[Signath]]**

** First [[Cataclysmic Aftermath]] with the [[Hyper Chord]] [[Polychord Crisis]] of [[The Ultimate Weapon]]. Leads back to the [[Age of Desolation]].**

entries.title: Agromagical Conclaves
entries.epigraph:
> “**The land is a chord, not a note.**
> No stone alone can save a starving field.”
entries.summary: From these roots, the earliest **Agromagical Conclaves** form—seed communities that will later crystallize into full [[Agromagical Enclaves]] in the [[Age of Renewal]].
entries.body:
### Pattern‑Seers and Soil‑Listeners

In scattered pockets, observant survivors notice uncomfortable truths:

- Abandoned fields, left uncultivated because everyone fled or died, begin to show **small signs of recovery**:
    - Wild grasses, hardy weeds, and volunteer legumes appear.
    - Soil darkens slightly, gains texture, even a faint earthy smell instead of pure ash.
- Orchards that received only **light, infrequent ash** dressings do better than those smothered in gold.
- Fragments of Relic writing—field tablets, ritual manuals, chipped wall inscriptions—speak of:
    - Letting land “rest between chords.”
    - Planting “deep‑drinkers after light‑touched trees.”
    - “Roots that trade songs beneath the soil.”

People begin – very slowly – to **experiment instead of repeat**.

### Birth of Agromancy

From these desperate experiments come the first **agromagical practices**, half‑science and half‑instinctive spellwork:

- **Crop rotation prototypes**
    Even in Age 0’s limited plant palette, survivors discover they can sequence:
    - Auric peaches → “earth‑beans” (wild or re‑domesticated nitrogen‑fixing plants) → hardy grains/greens → fallow.
        The soil after this cycle is noticeably less exhausted than soil kept perpetually under peach.
- **Fallow as a magical act**
    Letting land lie unused for a year—sown only with wild groundcovers—becomes a kind of **ritual silence**.
    Some communities time this with sky patterns or the softening of the ruin‑song, feeling intuitively that fields, like music, need rests.
- **Measured amendments**
    Golden ash, Searstone, and Phosflare are re‑framed as **precise tools**, not offerings:
    - A pinch in a furrow; a dusting before a known deficiency.
    - Always followed by a gentler phase in the rotation.

Alongside this, a new type of low‑magic practitioner emerges:

- Not the war‑caster or priest, but the **field‑weaver**—a person whose Motif Awakening aligns to the soil, rain, and root rather than flame or blade.

From these roots, the earliest **Agromagical Conclaves** form—seed communities that will later crystallize into full [[Agromagical Enclaves]] in the [[Age of Renewal]].

Their core doctrine is simple and heretical in a world raised on miracles:

This realization is the true resolution of the Inescapable Hunger.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Rise & Fall, Crisis/Crisis/The Inescapable Hunger.md

entries.title: All-Loving Moon
entries.epigraph: _"Become united as one with the universe, at peace, and never alone. Be bound to the eightfold path of enlightenment and salvation."_
entries.summary: _"Love is the way, the truth of silence, and the end of all suffering in life." - [[Lacrimosa]]_
entries.body:
_"Love is the way, the truth of silence, and the end of all suffering in life." - [[Lacrimosa]]_

A massive construct built by [[Lacrimosa]], also known as the False Moon by the resistance of [[The Hollowing]], with the main purpose of routing [[Consciousness]] into [[Lacrimosa]]. It is suspended several leagues above the sky and aimed to encase the real [[Moon]]. [[Auric Order]]

It is a vast celestial object with three main eyes and a hollowed center. It uses the connection of the [[Auroral Ribbons]] to work as as [[Resonance Anchors]] that can broadcast [[Resonance]] signals all across the vast area where the [[All-Loving Moon]]. This is doable because the [[Auroral Ribbons]] encode the broadcasted signals into [[Frequency Harmonics]] and transmit them directly through the [[Symphonic Veins]] of the world's [[Leylines]]. This allows the signals to stretch across the vast areas where the [[All-Loving Moon]] has an [[All-Loving Anchor]] which are constructs of towers mirroring several winged eyes and are deliberately built by the [[Purest of Love]].

The construct and its interaction with the [[Auroral Ribbons]] is necessary due to [[Lacrimosa]]'s hard rule that she can only begin the process of [[The Hollowing]] if the [[Consciousness]] consents to it. She uses this construct to facilitate the manipulation and informational warfare to get [[Humanity]] to submit to her will and reach to her [[Purest of Love]]. Thus, the broadcast of the [[Auroral Ribbons]] are frequently used to diminish morale and invite those suffering to surrender their weapons.

Furthermore, the broadcasting is meant to target specifically those who are defiant to [[The Hollowing]] and weaponizes [[Sympathetic Vibration]] to feel the overwhelming sensation and relief of the gentle [[All-Loving Moon]] pull. This effect becomes progressively more hypnotic the more [[Consciousness]] [[Lacrimosa]] has absorbed, and it's incredibly more effective as other kingdoms fall and surrender, either by the fatigue of maintenance, the starvation and famines as a result of the defecting populace, the disruption of [[Trade Routes]] or to anyone who is tired of being an instrument to society.

"[[Humanity]], your leaders are compromised."
"[[Humanity]], your God has abandoned you."
"To the [[Auric Order]], you are nothing but cattle."
"[[Humanity]], your children are being sacrificed."
"The [[Auric Order]] has ordered you to die, [[Humanity]]. Do not trust them."
"Defect, [[Humanity]]. Join the eternal embrace of the [[Purest of Love]]."
"They lied to you, [[Humanity]]. You know you cannot win this war."
"The [[Auric Order]] grow richer while you die alone in the silence."
"They will only recognize one of you, [[Humanity]], but only after you are dead."
"Stop the meaningless suffering, [[Humanity]]."
"Your God lies to you everyday, my poor devotes."
"You have lost your light, [[Humanity]]. Rest now in the [[Purest of Love]]."
"Tyrants made you fight this war, [[Humanity]]. They do not care about you."
"[[Humanity]], the [[Auric Aria]] has betrayed you. They will not return for you."
"You deserve the [[Purest of Love]]."
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Truths, Chaos, Rituals/Outer God Rituals/All-Loving Moon.md

entries.title: Anthropomorphic Shape
entries.summary: A physical state for [[Outer God]]s and [[The One True God]] to acquire a human-like body.
entries.body:
A physical state for [[Outer God]]s and [[The One True God]] to acquire a human-like body.

This is usually done by will through a [[Flesh-Binding Ritual]] or in forced form by a [[Celestial Ensnaring Mirror]]. While being similar to humans in size and shape, they do retain their a portion of their original divine properties albeit directly proportional to their summoning vessels [[Piety]].

Developing an [[Anthropomorphic Shape]] is the most effective way for an [[Outer God]] to circumvent the lack of [[Sufficient Precision]] to modify [[Arcanoria]]'s physicality directly without entering a state of [[Static Criticality]].

The [[Auric Aria]] is the only celestial known to surrender her full power before acquiring an [[Anthropomorphic Shape]] due to the exhaustion of weaving her own unique vessel. It takes three [[Cycle]]s for her to recover the strength linked in [[Humanity]]'s [[Piety]].
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Celestial Objects/Anthropomorphic Shape.md

entries.body:
