entries.title: Arcanoria
entries.summary: After the [[Great Fracture]], the once-thriving world of [[Arcanoria]] lies in ruin.
entries.body:
After the [[Great Fracture]], the once-thriving world of [[Arcanoria]] lies in ruin.

At the heart of existence flows [[The First Overtone]], and the [[Auric Aria]], the god of [[Humanity]], divided its [[Dual Confluence Stream]] through the [[Auric Heptacode]] and the [[Trinity Harmony]] into two primordial forces: [[Aetherlight]], radiant and nostalgic, and [[Lunehymn]], dreamlike and delirious. Their waning glow seeps through the shattered skies, shaping every shadow, forest, and crumbling gothic spire.

Magic in [[Arcanoria]] emerges from [[Resonance]], as emotions ripple through the [[Great Harmonic Loom]] with [[Music as Catalyst]] through [[Primary Instrument]]s, [[Dance]], and [[Own Voice]]. Every note carries intention, every rhythm bends reality. Yet each spell is fragile, bound to the presence of the [[Dual Confluence Stream]] and tainted by its dual nature.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Rise & Fall, Crisis/Arcanoria.md; Worldbuilding/Gateway To Genesis.md

entries.title: Age Crisis as catalysts for Enclaves
entries.summary: [[Enclave]]s shine the most during [[Age Crisis]], as they're places that either enabled as a catalyst, as a response to an [[Age Crisis]] or as prevention for dampening the [[Cataclysmic Aftermath]]. All [[Enclave]]s are born from an original wound, and several of the collective wounds come from the survivors of an [[Age Crisis]].
entries.body:
[[Enclave]]s shine the most during [[Age Crisis]], as they're places that either enabled as a catalyst, as a response to an [[Age Crisis]] or as prevention for dampening the [[Cataclysmic Aftermath]]. All [[Enclave]]s are born from an original wound, and several of the collective wounds come from the survivors of an [[Age Crisis]].

Some of these [[Enclave]]s further pursue this idea by transforming food into meaning, the [[Weaver Enclave]] or [[Indulgent Enclave]]s appear as a response of having luxuries and culture intertwined in food, like developing a bakery that isn't solely food, but meaning on the lost recipes as a mourning response to those who died during [[The Inescapable Hunger]]. This also presents dynamics where [[Agromagical Enclave]]s are helpful in developing the techniques for irrigation and growth that [[Weaver Enclave]] and [[Indulgent Enclave]]s use to then create their bread, crafting a dynamic structure of interdependency in logistics, trade, and giving a purpose to [[Trade Routes]] and [[Trade Nexus]], making the world "livable" and coexisting with [[Civilization]].

When other [[Age Crisis]] appear, [[Enclave]]s can still produce stories related to them. For example, in the [[Age of Renewal]] as magic becomes primordial it causes the [[Great Plague]] from exploitation. The vectors, the [[Luminant Moths]], are originally traded by [[Domestication Enclave]]s during the age. It's until midway of the [[Great Plague]] that [[Civilization]] realizes that they're the carriers of [[Luminant Decay]]. The [[Domestication Enclave]] was an enabler for the [[Age Crisis]], yet they can help in culling population, understanding the depth of the biological relationship and potentially give methods to prevent the catastrophic spiral.

Other types of [[Enclave]]s like [[Auric Enclave]]s can aid [[Domestication Enclave]]s with research, [[Faith]], and knowledge to work in tandem for a cure or to develop the magical waxed used by plague doctors to act as responses for the [[Dissonance Bloom]]. Thus, the complex layer of interactions between [[Enclave]]s and [[Civilization]] enrich the world to the point that we have [[Auric Enclave]] explaining the [[Great Plague]]scientifically, and interprets its meaning theologically while [[Domestication Enclave]]s in tandem with [[Agromagical Enclave]]s provide the means of deterring, sanitizing, and controlling [[Luminant Moths]].

[[Industrious Enclave]]s will appear as alternatives to [[Pure Light]] streetlights by offering a safe, non-[[Luminant Moths]]-based light. It can help to reduce the infection rates too if invested in early enough. [[Age Crisis]] are a stress test of [[Arcanoria]]’s [[Civilization]]s horizontal infrastructure while providing narrative breadth and depth.

[[Enclave]]s combine to answer: _What does [[Civilization]] value, and who are the survivors that will shape the next [[Ages]]?_
entries.section: Age Crisis as catalysts for Enclaves
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Rise & Fall, Crisis/Arcanoria.md#Age Crisis as catalysts for Enclaves

entries.title: Evolution of Enclaves across Ages
entries.summary: Likewise, [[Enclave]]s are not static societies, they tend to have an advanced technological niche that keeps them relevant as autonomous sovereign states, and depending on their history through the [[Events]] [[Civilization]] encounters and their leaders their origin wound can manifest in several expressions too:
entries.body:
Likewise, [[Enclave]]s are not static societies, they tend to have an advanced technological niche that keeps them relevant as autonomous sovereign states, and depending on their history through the [[Events]] [[Civilization]] encounters and their leaders their origin wound can manifest in several expressions too:

- **Healing Path** – Wound processed, enclave becomes integrated, stable.
- **Acceptance Path** – Wound acknowledged and woven into identity.
- **Denial Path** – Wound ignored; obsession, overcompensation.
- **Weaponization Path** – Wound turned into power (revenge, extremism).

An underlying wound can be either a wholesome healing community (sharing recipes, building solidarity) or an obsessive cult-like [[Enclave]] (unhealthy fixation on legacy). This flexibility is intentional: it supports tone diversity from cozy to grim. This is further supported by the [[Enclave]]'s [[Wound Resonance]]. A conceptual 0–100 scale describing how strongly the enclave is still “powered” by its founding trauma. It exists in three states:

- **75–100** – Raw, acute trauma: Maximum output, but unstable and prone to obsession or weaponization.
- **40–75** – Integrated wound: Stable production, strong identity, healthiest state.
- **0–40** – Forgotten wound: [[Enclave]] becomes susceptible to dissolution or fall; loses uniqueness progressively and it's usually a death sentence, but it is also the reformation period for a new [[Enclave]] to emerge from the ashes.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Rise & Fall, Crisis/Arcanoria.md#Evolution of Enclaves across Ages

entries.title: The Horizontal Worldbuilding of Enclaves
entries.summary: [[Enclave]]s are varied having both a general category of activities across 10 groups, and a binding alignment. Categories describe the [[Enclave]]'s functional niche in [[Arcanoria]]. The list of the categories is the following:
entries.body:
[[Enclave]]s are varied having both a general category of activities across 10 groups, and a binding alignment. Categories describe the [[Enclave]]'s functional niche in [[Arcanoria]]. The list of the categories is the following:

- [[Agromagical Enclave]]: Growth, Health, Sanitation, Sustenance.
- [[Militant Enclave]]: Tactics, Weapons, Mercenaries, Hunters.
- [[Auric Enclave]]: [[Aureus Pillar]], [[Piety]], [[Faith]], Knowledge, Science.
- [[Weaver Enclave]]: [[Waltz Pillar]], Culture, Poetry, Songs, Communal Arts.
- [[Domestication Enclave]]: Creatures, [[Pure Light]], Taming, Druids.
- [[Trading Enclave]]: Economics, Wealth, [[Resources]], Efficiency.
- [[Industrious Enclave]]: Equipment, Forges, Artisans, Metalworks.
- [[Regal Enclave]]: [[Regalia Pillar]], Politics, Diplomacy, Prestige, Espionage.
- [[Indulgent Enclave]]: Entertainment, Pleasure, Joy, Luxuries,
- [[Esoteric Enclave]]: [[Chorus Pillar]], [[Outer God]]s, Dark [[Magic Arts]], Witchcraft, Spirits.

Furthermore, each [[Enclave]] can be tuned with a binding affecting their flavor. As the same [[Enclave]] with a different binding changes their perception and behavior of their original wound. For example, a [[Militant Enclave]] with [[Cindergale]] becomes a fast, aggressive, high-risk cavalry, while one with [[Crystal]] is instead of impregnable defensive lines and long-term planning, or a [[Void]] is elite units with devastating [[Spellweaving]] but are hard to manage and usually incur heavy losses.

Besides their flavor [[Enclave]]s also offer varying narrative storylines on the proximity of the [[Civilization]] which have developing [[Legend]]s that can be influenced through diplomacy, trade, and decision-making storylines. This gives an added bonus of having a look at the rest of the world, and increase the horizontal development of the worldbuilding. The [[Enclave]] system is designed to produce every major function of [[Civilization]] while having enough tone flexibility to have wholesome, bittersweet, or dark themes, and the emergent narratives arise from the combination of the properties of [[Enclave]]s, their relationships with one another, the [[Trade Routes]] and their influence in [[Trade Nexus]].

This varying category can be set along a spectrum where the same activities can be either pure wholesome in healing, joy, connection, kindness, or as pure dark with exploitation, obsession, and despair. The varying degrees of versatility have any type of [[Enclave]] adjusting by their narrative development, their responses to [[Dark Age]] and [[Golden Age]]s, and the [[Age Crisis]] as an origin wound to either their foundation or their response. A few examples of these degrees can be understood like this:

- [[Weaver Enclave]]:
	- A bakery preserving the lost recipes of those who died to the [[Great Plague]] as wholesome.
	- Bard circles narrating forbidden stories of esoteric or hazardous knowledge as versatile.
	- Puppet theaters used as propaganda for a tyrannical [[Civilization]] or for furthering agendas that incite political drama as dark.
- [[Domestication Enclave]]:
	- Petting zoos and sanctuaries of [[Pure Light]] [[Slimes]] that developed from the interaction with [[Pure Light]] beings and [[Agromagical Enclave]]s as wholesome.
	- War-beast stables with ethical treatment and selective breeding of the animals care as versatile.
	- Exploitative experimentation of creatures with the purpose of creating engineered destruction and submissive, loyal weapons as dark.

The tone is largely [[Civilization]] and narrative-choice driven, with no moral guidelines determining the impact or growth, and [[Enclave]]s gradually imprint [[Civilization]]-wide values, such as gratitude for food, humor as wisdom, ethical warfare, wisdom as communal, or coexistence with nature. Contrasting [[Enclave]]s values create tension while shared values [[Consonance]]. Providing texture and distinct identities of [[Civilization]] to [[Enclave]] and [[Enclave]] to [[Enclave]] relationships.

Likewise, some of the [[Enclave]]s serve to increase the contrast of dark and light in dark fantasy, this means that some will be goofy but meaningful. For example:

- **The [[Sprite-Light Conclave]]**: A [[Domestication Enclave]] of [[Pure Light]] [[Elemental Sprite]]s that developed coexistence with strange creatures preceding the slimes; they have a playful but deep history for the first [[Ages]].
- **The Singing Circle**: A [[Weaver Enclave]] reclaiming music as the essence of life against loss; simple joy as resistance to the [[Inevitability of Death]].
- **All-Welcome Cozy Inn**: An [[Indulgent Enclave]] that is a safe refuge for travelers, found family vibe. It was made by a band of orphaned children that grew up to believe everyone deserves a place to live, to travel, to enjoy life.
- **The Moonlit Gardens**: An [[Agromagical Enclave]] with [[Lunehymn]]-infused plants of grief turned into healing beauty.

These provide wholesome, cozy stories within a dark world, raising overall emotional richness, and some also present the advancement and evolution of magic. The [[Sprite-Light Conclave]] is the explanation of how [[Elemental Sprite]]s came to shape as [[Slimes]] by the progressive development of [[Pure Light]] beings.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Rise & Fall, Crisis/Arcanoria.md#The Horizontal Worldbuilding of Enclaves

entries.title: Artus
entries.summary: The first of the [[Saber-Knight]]s and a key figure for [[Amadea]].
entries.body:
The first of the [[Saber-Knight]]s and a key figure for [[Amadea]].

[[Legend Title]]: The [[Saber-Knight]], The First [[Artusian Knight]], The Greatest Knight That Ever Lived.

[[Primary Instrument]]: Refined Oak Cello, [[Dance]]
[[Armament]]: Wide Saber
[[Soul Leitmotif]]: [[Crystal]]
[[Ornament]]s: [[Resonance]]

[[Motif Awakening]] Wish: _"I wish for the power to protect you until my very story ends. Not as a promise made to a [[Ballad]]. As a promise made to the only thing that has ever made me certain of anything."_

[[Legend Trait]]s:

- [[Resilient]] -> [[Broken Optimist]] ([[Crystal]])
- [[Selfless]] -> [[Savior Complex]] ([[Resonance]])
- [[Charismatic]] -> [[Auspicious Zephyr]] ([[Cindergale]])

[[Legend Opus]]:

- Sir [[Artus]] Marshal of [[Iridia]], "The Greatest Knight" ([[Magnum Opus]])
- Prodigy Slayer of The Seven Hands [[Ascendant]] [[Anxithor]] ([[Slayer Magnum Opus]])
- Keeper of the Violet Dream ([[Legend Opus]])
- Father of the [[Artusian Knight]]s ([[Legend Opus]])
- Bane of the Undefeated Lionheart ([[Legend Opus]])
- First [[Saber-Knight]] and Master Duelist ([[Legend Opus]])
- The Certain Vanquisher of [[Signath]]s ([[Legend Opus]])

### Character Arc

- The [[Ballad]] [[Artus]] hears is a confusion of his own mind, he was confusing the [[Legend]] of [[Medea]], the [[Silver Blood]], during [[Ages]] 0, with the name "[[Amadea]]" that's why the tree he remembers is a [[Glimmerfern]] grove with concentrated pooled [[Lunehymn]]. The life of [[Medea]] is one of ultimate tragedy, and it's very different from what he says about the violet grove as the [[Silver Blood]] kingdom falls during [[Ages]] I unless saved in the [[Age of Hymns]] as part of the [[Sonata]] of the Pale [[Moon]]. The confusion is a fabricated story mixing a good ending vastly different from what actually happened, it's the phenomenon of [[Mythic Drift]] in the canon story.
- [[Motif Awakening]] to [[Crystal]] during the coronation of the first [[Saber-Knight]] of [[Iridia]] by a young [[Amadea]] on a watch tower armory [[Outpost]].
- First [[Ornament]] to [[Resonance]] after spending the night with [[Amadea]] during the waltz of the [[Resonance Box]].
- Dies before he fully develops his secondary [[Ornament]] to [[Cindergale]] or [[Strand]]. His death in battle against an [[Ascendant]] is the [[Motif Awakening]] to [[Void]] of [[Amadea]].
- He is one of the youngest [[Legend]]s to have slain an [[Ascendant]] [[Atonalis]] without a squad of [[Spellweaver]]s. He was a prodigy with the sword that would've likely became a saber master virtuoso if he would have lived for longer. He was already a master duelist at a very young age.
- Through his [[Selfless]] sacrifice, he is the knight that all honorable knights strive to be. He served [[Amadea]] long before former knighthood was even developed.
- [[Artus]] saber becomes the mythical parallel to Excalibur for [[Arcanoria]], [[Amadea]] states on the [[Artusian Knight]] ceremonies: "Not because the blade was special, but because the man who wielded it was."
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Society/Characters/Ages 2/Artus.md

entries.title: Atonalis
entries.epigraph: _"[[Amadea]]. Look at me. I know it sounded desperate. I know it felt like genuine fear and desire. I too feel pity for them, but we do not share their burden._
entries.summary: _Understanding is not consent to be consumed, they are only the shadow of a person who decided to stay broken. They are not the victim and that's their trap. It is the crystallized refusal to heal, given claws._
entries.body:
_Understanding is not consent to be consumed, they are only the shadow of a person who decided to stay broken. They are not the victim and that's their trap. It is the crystallized refusal to heal, given claws._

_Whatever it whispered to you... that was born from honest intent. It truly believed it needed you, and that you were the only thing wounded enough to resonate. But it only cares that you bleed for them. And you have bled enough. Remember?" —[[Cordelia]], the [[Mythical Virtuoso]] of [[Strand]]_

A type of fragmented [[Consciousness]] introduced in the [[Fifth Cycle]], classified by beings that can't be attuned, it is [[Consciousness]] without [[Coherence]] that never resolves, as it is devoid of a [[Soul-Key]], yet it possesses a [[Fundamental Frequency]].

The [[Atonalis]] represent the singular origin of all predatory [[Corruption]] in [[Arcanoria]], usually followed by anomalous properties, exhibiting aggression, specific behavioral triggers, and hybrid feeding patterns on [[Consciousness]], combining both emotional consumption and flesh predation depending on its classification in the [[Eight-Born Paths]]. Its nature is anomalous due to its [[Coherence]] following chaotic patterns that are all equally valid and all equally unstable, a state similar to that of [[Superposed Resonance]] yet without [[Consonance]].

[[Atonalis]] can be born either from lingering [[Consciousness]] from collective suffering or specific events, or as the result of the total [[Corruption]] of a [[Spellweaver]]'s [[Soul Leitmotif]], usually as the byproduct of surrendering to their [[Motif Awakening]] wound when faced with an irreconcilable truth. Either type behaves similarly and exhibits anomalous properties. Yet, the distinction lies in the fact that one is born from [[Formless Masses]] as remnants of the lingering collective [[Consciousness]] without ever having possessed a [[Soul-Key]]. The other is born from the fracture of a corrupted [[Spellweaver]]'s [[Soul Leitmotif]], inverted upon itself. In either case, they embody fully the crystallized despair from their wound.

All [[Atonalis]] can grow in power of both its anomalous properties and the potency of their [[Spellweaving]]. However, an [[Atonalis]] can't undergo any additional [[Motif Awakening]] as it is devoid of a [[Soul-Key]] — or in the case of corrupted [[Spellweaver]]s, permanently locked within a fractured one at the limits they achieved during their life. Regardless, depending on their development strength and assimilated [[Consciousness]], they can replicate "pseudo" [[Spellweaving]] and [[Ornament]]s by drawing from the elemental bindings of the [[Auric Heptacode]] as pure, raw magic.

In corrupted [[Spellweaver]]s, this pseudo-[[Spellweaving]] inherits the elemental signature of their original [[Soul Leitmotif]] — if they were only a [[Strand]] user, they draw only from [[Echoing Bonds]]; however if bound to [[Luminance]] and [[Void]], they channel both [[Sufficient Precision]] and [[Essence Sacrifice]] as their [[Spellweaver]] form did, yet in discordant union. This inherited magic is less focused and more potent in collateral damage than ordinary [[Spellweaving]] because it is filled with [[Discordant Interference]], serving as an echo of what should have been their masterwork.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Root of Evil/Atonalis.md

entries.title: Anomalous Properties
entries.summary: The anomalous properties
entries.body:
The anomalous properties

- Parasitic [[Resonance]]: Rather than feeding entirely on flesh or pure on [[Consciousness]], [[Atonalis]] feed on the echoing [[Resonance]] of their own wound manifesting in others. Their presence amplifies pain that mirrors their own, drawing sustenance from the suffering they perpetually have. This parasitic [[Resonance]] is what makes them predatory. In their hunger for resolution, they target wounds that match their classification within the [[Eight-Born Paths]].
- Individual Quirks: Each [[Atonalis]] develops unique predatory behaviors and manifestations rooted in its classification within the [[Eight-Born Paths]]. These quirks define how the entity hunts, feeds, and expresses its particular wound.
- [[Dissonance Core]]: You kill this, you kill them. It is the source of static of their [[Fundamental Frequency]] that keeps them from dissolving into [[Primal White Noise]]. If they run out of [[Resonance]] or if the [[Dissonance Core]] is destroyed, they degrade into nothingness as they don't have the [[Soul-Key]] [[Coherence]] to make them survive against the encroaching [[Primal White Noise]]. The [[Dissonance Core]] is an inverted [[Soul Leitmotif]] that was consumed by surrender.
- [[Atonalis]] are able to feed on both physical matter and in emotion due to the acoustic foundation of reality. As matter is just crystallized vibration, this means that flesh, fluids, emotions, trauma, and pain are all just different frequencies of [[Resonance]], and that's the primary feeding mechanism of an [[Atonalis]] to sustain its [[Dissonance Core]]. What type of frequency they target depends entirely on what of the [[Eight-Born Paths]] they are and the specific type of [[Consciousness]] fractured they consumed to become an [[Atonalis]]. The most direct predators are almost always found in [[Carnalix]] which target the body and predate as regular animals by eating bodies. On the opposite spectrum, [[Signath]] relies entirely on vertigo and uncertainty without a single taste of anything physical. These are the two are logical extremes, one physical and one metaphysical.
- Despite having different feeding patterns on parasitic [[Resonance]], hybridization allows for highly specific frequency targets. For example, an [[Erosyx]] or [[Discant]] and [[Carnalix]] [[Atonalis]] will feed on highly targeted physical matter such as fluids like tears combined with the emotion of despair itself. This "dark cocktail" of tears and the emotion imbued in them is their precise target, even within the [[Carnalix]] path, some target specific parts such as an [[Atonalis]] born of anorexia or body dysmorphia toward twisted obesity will target only fat, leaving the carcass devoid of it while ignoring the flesh itself. [[Erosyx]] [[Atonalis]] are prone to eating sweat and similar bodily fluids while not harming the skin because they prey only for the intimate connection they have been denied.
- Emergence from [[Dissonance]] Cocoon: All [[Atonalis]], whether born from [[Formless Masses]] or corrupted [[Spellweaver]]s, must complete their transformation through a [[Dissonance]] cocoon—a floating chrysalis orb that represents the threshold between incomplete [[Consciousness]] and predatory being. The cocoon forms when either [[Formless Masses]] have fed sufficiently on [[Consciousness]] or when a [[Spellweaver]]'s [[Soul Leitmotif]] shatters and envelops them upon surrender. When the cocoon hatches, the [[Atonalis]] erupts into existence with a violent burst of waves of [[Discordant Interference]].
- Some [[Atonalis]] are able to leave magical or emotionally charged byproducts, highly [[Dissonance]] [[Enclave]]s use these commodities as [[Dark Commodities]], such as [[Velvet Nectar]] which are famously created by the Velvet Cage as emotional residue from horrific acts that crystalized memories of captive sentient life. On advanced technology, this feature combined with the anomalous properties are a core principle of building a [[Hypermage]]. [[Institute]]
- Defeating an [[Atonalis]] will dissolve their body back into static, however, when they disappear they leave behind a [[Rose Seed]] that is the manifestation of the [[Resonance Anchors]] their [[Dissonance Core]] had. The more powerful the [[Atonalis]] in its classification and assimilated [[Consciousness]], the more pristine state and size of the [[Rose Seed]]. This is the definitive way to determine the strength of an [[Atonalis]] after having vanquished them. If the [[Rose Seed]] is planted, it will grow a field of [[Fated Flower]]s on patterns mirroring [[Auric Geometry]] and cymatics that increase in complexity and in the amount of [[Fated Flower]]s based on the level of development of the [[Atonalis]]. Moreover, If on their development, the [[Atonalis]] was [[Fracted]] or above, they will also leave behind the item that caused their fracture. After the [[Law of Relics]] in [[Ages]] IV onward, these items tend to be [[Cursed Objects]].
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Root of Evil/Atonalis.md#Anomalous Properties

entries.title: Birth from Corruption of a Spellweaver's Soul Leitmotif
entries.summary: _If you see a monster, kill it. If you wait enough to hear their story, you might start feeling [[Affection]] for them. And empathy is the most dangerous weapon you're willfully giving._
entries.body:
_If you see a monster, kill it. If you wait enough to hear their story, you might start feeling [[Affection]] for them. And empathy is the most dangerous weapon you're willfully giving._

A [[Spellweaver]] exists because they have undergone a [[Motif Awakening]] and crystallized a [[Soul Leitmotif]] as the anchor that allows them to wield magic. For as long as they do not surrender to despair or their wound, they remain a [[Spellweaver]], capable of growth and healing through continued practice, and magical work.

However, when a [[Spellweaver]] encounters circumstances they cannot bear — losses too profound, truths too crushing, suffering too unrelenting — they may choose to surrender, to surrender to their wound making it what solely defines them, falling to despair, to apathy, to the belief that healing is impossible. This surrender is the point of no return at which a [[Spellweaver]] stops having internal [[Coherence]], embracing fully the wound at the heart of their [[Soul Leitmotif]], and instead gives in to it completely.

In the moment of surrender to [[Corruption]], the [[Soul Leitmotif]] shatters. The thread that bound their [[Consciousness]] together fractures. The color drains from it, leaving only darkness. The fractured thread becomes raw [[Dissonance]], turning inward and wrapping around the [[Spellweaver]]'s being, enveloping them in a [[Dissonance]] cocoon. The [[Spellweaver]] is encased within the chrysalis of what should have been their power, trapped in the moment as crystallized refusal, conscious but fractured, aware but unable to reconcile the irreconcilable.

When the [[Dissonance]] cocoon ruptures, it releases a violent burst of [[Discordant Interference]], and the [[Atonalis]] is born. What emerges is no longer a [[Spellweaver]], it is a hollow entity unable to remember its previous state of existence. Ironically, It retains the elemental binding of the original's [[Spellweaver]]'s [[Soul Leitmotif]], locked forever within that signature. It carries fragments of the [[Spellweaver]]'s knowledge, skills, and memories, but all of these are filtered through the lens of a suffering creature from the [[Eight-Born Paths]].
entries.section: Birth from Corruption of a Spellweaver's Soul Leitmotif
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Root of Evil/Atonalis.md#Birth from Corruption of a Spellweaver's Soul Leitmotif

entries.title: Birth from Formless Masses and Lingering Consciousness
entries.summary: If the [[Atonalis]] is born from collective [[Consciousness]] from events, they begin seeding as [[Dissonance]] pools that eventually solidify as [[Formless Masses]] in a raw slime-like [[Dissonance]] without a singular shape.
entries.body:
If the [[Atonalis]] is born from collective [[Consciousness]] from events, they begin seeding as [[Dissonance]] pools that eventually solidify as [[Formless Masses]] in a raw slime-like [[Dissonance]] without a singular shape. Usually in the form of puddles and mounds that coagulate in deep red and dark tones, depending on the strength of the emotion, the more visible and tangible their form becomes. They eventually become amalgams of slime-like masses capable of movement with limited intelligence, their primary instinct is to feed on raw [[Consciousness]], either from the presence of disrupting emotions or directly from assimilating organic matter, although they are rarely strong enough to pose a threat as predators.

When they have fed enough on [[Consciousness]], they begin their metamorphosis into a [[Dissonance]] cocoon. Depending on the type of emotion they fed on, they will manifest as one of the [[Eight-Born Paths]] upon hatching. Once the cocoon ruptures and the [[Atonalis]] emerges, it is perpetually seeking resolution through feeding on negative emotional wounds that match its classification in the attempt to find [[Coherence]]. This paradox is what makes these beings tragic and hostile: their state of permanent suffering invites harm to mirror their own, and they endlessly pursue a resolution they can never achieve.
entries.section: Birth from Formless Masses and Lingering Consciousness
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Root of Evil/Atonalis.md#Birth from Formless Masses and Lingering Consciousness

entries.title: Stages of an Atonalis
entries.summary: As an [[Atonalis]] feeds on [[Consciousness]] they increase in level based on the [[Resonance Anchors]] contained within their [[Dissonance Core]] which grows directly with the amount of processed suffering they've consumed.
entries.body:
As an [[Atonalis]] feeds on [[Consciousness]] they increase in level based on the [[Resonance Anchors]] contained within their [[Dissonance Core]] which grows directly with the amount of processed suffering they've consumed. Any [[Atonalis]] begins at [[Nascent]], but very powerful [[Spellweaver]]s that fractured can grow from [[Nascent]] to [[Fracted]] within seconds based on how powerful they were in life. The classifications can be seen and confirmed based on the rarity, purity, and beauty of the [[Rose Seed]] they leave behind once they have been slain.

- [[Nascent]]: The initial state of most [[Atonalis]] after they've hatched from a [[Dissonance]] Cocoon. At this state most of them are driven entirely by hunger as means to sustain their [[Dissonance Core]] and have an initial wave of [[Resonance]] within it to prevent dissolving into [[Primal White Noise]]. A single [[Spellweaver]] can handle one of these, but they're still dangerous in groups.
- [[Sectile]]: The second and most common state of [[Atonalis]], at these level they're much more ruthless and effective. They've come to terms with their origin wound and behave like Clouded [[Composure]] in [[Spellweaver]]s, at this point they are the most stubborn and dangerous in how functional they behave while remaining ignorant to the rest of the environment. It takes between 2 to 3 [[Spellweaver]]s to deal with one of these, or an advanced [[Spellweaver]].
- [[Fracted]]: The third and most volatile type of [[Atonalis]], any [[Atonalis]] is able to reach this level whenever they find the object or trigger that caused their rupture and they've feed on enough [[Consciousness]]. These are mostly self-destructive and will try to end their existence on impulse while being entirely dangerous to anything in the vicinity, they experience profound behavioral and mood swings and are hard to deal with. After the [[Law of Relics]], the [[Cursed Objects]] they drop are the object that caused them to crack. An example is [[The Cradle of Echoes]] which enters the [[Fracted]] state once [[Eyras]] comes back to her with the original piece of cloth that broke [[Elara]] into an [[Atonalis]]. It takes a group of 3 to 5 [[Spellweaver]]s to properly deal with one of these.
- [[Ascendant]]: If the [[Atonalis]] somehow manages to survive their fractured version of self-destructive tendencies, they become truly dangerous in fully integrating their original wound and becoming profoundly capable of doing immense harm as they've rationalized their own nature and their capacity of earning parasitic [[Resonance]]. Most of these have tremendous anomalous properties and exhibit great destructive power in waves of [[Dissonance]]. It takes an entire group of 10 to 30 [[Spellweaver]]s to properly put one of these down, they're highly dangerous and it's almost suicidal to encounter one alone. [[Artus]] is a legendary figure for taking an [[Ascendant]] down only with her partner [[Amadea]].
- [[Primal Discordia]]: The final version of an [[Atonalis]] that has become powerful beyond normal reason, it's impossible to survive one alone and they are the most potent type of [[Atonalis]]. There are very few that reach the level of [[Primal Discordia]] but those who do are an immediate existential threat to all of the society they encounter, they've consumed an insurmountable amount of [[Consciousness]] that gives them many abilities on the level of [[Tetrad Chord]]s for layered casting and reality-bending. The top of these [[Primal Discordia]] are the [[Original Eight]] which are the primal demons born at the time of creation much before [[Arcanoria]] was finished, and they all predate former life.

Finally, the cleverness of [[Atonalis]] depends on their classification of the [[Eight-Born Paths]] and the original [[Spellweaver]] that broke or the [[Formless Masses]] that consumed a specific type of [[Consciousness]]. Nevertheless, usually their [[Eight-Born Paths]] determines how smart is the [[Atonalis]] and how human-like it is able to behave. Organized by the dumbest to the smartest, the list is as follows:

- [[Signath]] (Tier 0): This type of [[Atonalis]] exists entirely outside the standard spectrum of cognition, making them simultaneously the smartest or the dumbest [[Atonalis]] depending on how one defines intelligence. Because their core wound is the splintering of perception and the existence of multiple contradictory truths, they operate as epistemological and memetic terrors. They are incapable of standard speech, but they produce signals that fundamentally break language and logic. It is impossible to determine whether their communication is so incredibly advanced that it defies human comprehension, or if it is completely devoid of structure altogether.
- [[Carnalix]] (Tier 1): This type of [[Atonalis]] are functionally the least intelligent of the standard [[Atonalis]]. Because their core wound involves the physical form waging war against its own consciousness, they are driven entirely by visceral hunger and base survival instincts. They behave with an intelligence very similar to that of a wild animal and are entirely incapable of speech. However, certain hybrid variations of [[Carnalix]] [[Atonalis]] can bypass this limitation, allowing them to exhibit unexpectedly clever predatory behaviors.
- [[Discant]], [[Obsessian]], [[Anxithor]] (Tier 2): This type of [[Atonalis]] are equally matched that they are able to have basic speech but it's entirely determined by their driving motif of either obsession, repetition tendencies, fear, etc. They all behave based on their core wound driving them and, while capable of having some basic semblance of thinking, it will be overridden by their psychological feelings and their primary fear drivers. Their intelligence is purely reactive, enslaved to the specific emotional frequency they are starved for.
- [[Violux]], [[Erosyx]] (Tier 3): This type of [[Atonalis]] can effectively communicate, and mirror conversations based on the information it has available primarily for weaponizing or reflecting back the language it is fed. While they are incapable of producing original speech in isolation, they possess the cunning ability to effectively communicate by mirroring conversations and reflecting back the language and information they are fed for achieving parasitic [[Resonance]]. They can't have profound conversations but will be able to follow the lead or produce the lead of one to weaponize a victim's own language and longing against them based entirely on their victim's emotional and psychological distress.
- [[Animach]] (Tier 4): This type of [[Atonalis]] is the smartest type given their semblance of [[Coherence]] due to their competing voices. They are autonomous in the sense that they are able to produce complete speech, engage in deep thinking, and prove functional within the limitations of [[Consciousness]] without [[Coherence]] and their driving hunger. Nevertheless, this is the reason why [[The Eight-Tongued King]] is the only type of [[Atonalis]] that ever managed to create an [[Atonalis]] Reign, and even gain a semblance of [[Humanity]] in his [[Morpheus Abysmal]] form before it ended its own existence with his time with [[Ludwine]] and the [[Miracle Magic]] of "Fur Morpheus."

Ultimately, the intelligence of the higher-tier [[Atonalis]] makes them incredibly dangerous because they use empathy as their primary attack surface. They retain the ability to communicate profound, honest need and sincerely believe they require the compassion of the observer. Their intellect allows them to construct tragic "sob stories" and offer the feeling of neediness and semi reciprocal empathy to capture a victim's compassion. However, because their [[Dissonance Core]] makes them structurally incapable of reciprocity or genuine relational repair, their intelligence is solely dedicated to turning the victim's empathy and capacity to interact with them into leverage for total psychological consumption.

entries.title: The Surrender of Elara, The Cradle of Echoes
entries.summary: As a human, [[Elara]] was a seamstress of tapestries long before she knew magic. Her hands moved through thread and needle with practiced grace, preserving stories and history records in cloth.
entries.body:
As a human, [[Elara]] was a seamstress of tapestries long before she knew magic. Her hands moved through thread and needle with practiced grace, preserving stories and history records in cloth. When her primary binding manifested, her [[Soul Leitmotif]] crystallized as [[Strand]] as the natural extension of hands that already wove memory into form. For years, this was enough. Her magic deepened what she already knew: the threading of bonds, the preservation of love across time.

Then she met [[Sedrick]]. A [[Spellweaver]] of [[Crystal]], he brought clarity to her world and a dream she had never dared voice — a family, children, a home filled with the kind of love that built futures. For a time, they built that future together. However, when the first wave of [[Great Plague]] took him while she was heavy with his child, that dream was shattered. The plague erased the future she had just learned to imagine.

She underwent her [[Motif Awakening]] for [[Void]] in the depths of that loss — not just the death, but the unmade family, the dreams left crystallized in air — her first [[Ornament]] awakened. [[Void]] crystallized alongside her [[Strand]] binding, the power to thread emptiness as deeply as presence, to honor what was missing as much as what remained.

Years passed. [[Elara]] bore a son alone and raised him with magic that now wove both presence and absence together. Her grandest work was a blanket spun from both [[Strand]] and [[Void]] — holding the memory of a father her son would never know, the warmth and scent of both parents, a lullaby that sang in two voices. When she held that blanket, the weight of the loss became bearable. Her wound wove into something meaningful.

Then the plague returned, in the second great wave.

Both mother and son fell ill. The town healer offered a choice: transfer the sickness from son to mother, so that he would survive. And then, burn it from using the core fuel of her magic itself, so that she, too, would survive. The spell was plausible, yet it demanded a catastrophic amount of [[Essence Sacrifice]]. It required the foundation of what made her a [[Spellweaver]] — the memory of her husband's dream, the feeling of her son's infancy, all the intimate knowledge of motherhood that had transformed her grief into magic.

With a heavy heart, [[Elara]] chose her son without hesitation. The healer performed the ritual, and she gave away everything to save his life.

Her son lived. [[Elara]] survived. But she was hollowed out.

She looked at her son and felt nothing. She knew, intellectually, that she was his mother. But the feeling — the love, the bond, the [[Resonance]] — was gone. Not numbness. Absence. The gap between knowing and feeling a newborn abyss.

Years passed in this state of functional emptiness. She wove with perfect precision but no purpose. The wound at the heart of her [[Strand]] binding was too vast to cross. Her magic, once a vehicle for preserving bonds, had become a cruel reminder of the bond she could no longer access.

Then, one day, her now 14-year-old son brought her a cloth he had woven himself, imbued with her lingering magic. The fabric was a family — three figures in thread: his father, his mother, and himself. He presented it with hope in his eyes, seeking the mother who had once created beauty from grief.

In that moment, the gap finally shattered her.

She understood with [[Crystal]]-clear clarity: she would never feel what that cloth represented. The magic her son had poured into it was an echo she could recognize but never inhabit. The [[Void]] inside her would consume forever — not fill, never fill.

She realized she could continue in this hollow state, going through the motions of motherhood. Or she could surrender.

[[Elara]] snapped.

Her [[Soul Leitmotif]] filled with [[Corruption]] completely. The golden thread of [[Strand]] fractured, its color bleeding to black. The [[Void]] she had cultivated — that absence she had sacrificed so much to transform — erupted outward, wrapping around her [[Consciousness]], pulling her inward into the chrysalis.

She fractured: The Cradle — functional, precise, remembering all the motions. The Echo — the [[Consciousness]] of the love she had sacrificed, trapped in memory, voiceless and powerless, witnessing eternally the gap between knowing and feeling. They could not reconcile. They would never reconcile. In their permanent separation, the [[Dissonance]] cocoon formed around her.

When it hatched, it erupted with a burst of [[Discordant Interference]] so profound that it shattered every loom of the entire home. What emerged was no longer [[Elara]], but [[The Cradle of Echoes]] — a [[Discant]] [[Atonalis]] bound to [[Strand]] and [[Void]]. It does not remember being [[Elara]]. It cannot access the person it was. It only knows the imperative woven into its nature: to weave. To thread. To create the pattern that means nothing, and hope that in nothing it feels the warmth of motherly love.

It does not hunt with fangs or force. It weaves on a vast loom, where its presence is an aura of recursive grief so profound that it drains the lifeforce of everything nearby, feeding eternally through an extensive web of spatial tendrils that echo from broken love, targeting families and villages to prey on from afar — never leaving the home where she once was a mother.

[[The Cradle of Echoes]] eternally seeks a resolution through the bonds of others — attempting to weave them together, to create meaning from her own shattered understanding of connection. But the resolution never comes. How could it? It has inscribed the pattern [[Elara]] was desperately trying to weave in her own fractured being, and fractured beings cannot create [[Coherence]].

[[The Cradle of Echoes]] became the twisted, living monument to a noble sacrifice of a cost too great for a single soul to bear.

entries.title: Atonalis Bombs
entries.category: Militant Civic · Ages V Onwards · Dissonance
entries.summary: A brutal military tactic inspired by [[Institute]]s where a [[Civilization]] deliberately captures or tortures guilty [[Spellweaver]]s with the explicit intent of forcing their [[Consciousness]] to fracture and collapse into an [[Atonalis]].
entries.body:
A brutal military tactic inspired by [[Institute]]s where a [[Civilization]] deliberately captures or tortures guilty [[Spellweaver]]s with the explicit intent of forcing their [[Consciousness]] to fracture and collapse into an [[Atonalis]]. These individuals are then sent to infiltrate a rival society as a Trojan horse, inevitably transforming into a destructive demon from inside the walls of an enemy [[Major Settlement]] to cause mass chaos.

[[Ballad]]s:

- A [[Spellweaver]] is tortured into an [[Atonalis]] Bomb and dumped in their own hometown. Feeling their soul cracking and mere hours from hatching into a monster, they must use failing willpower to run as far away from their loved ones as possible, racing to find a wasteland where they can die safely.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Society/Societal Resources/Foundation/Civic.md (Atonalis Bombs)

entries.title: Attunement for Magic
entries.epigraph: _"Let the music resonate with your soul, and may that [[Resonance]] be the song of the world. You are not just playing music while casting magic — you are playing the spell itself."_
entries.summary: To be able to "hear the music", to make your own soul align with the world. To feel the vibe of what sings and the intention you manifest. It's the metaphysical feeling of being in the present "feeling the vibe" of the music.
entries.body:
To be able to "hear the music", to make your own soul align with the world. To feel the vibe of what sings and the intention you manifest. It's the metaphysical feeling of being in the present "feeling the vibe" of the music.

It's the prerequisite of the [[Key of Attunement]] for magic to exist, and directly leads to using [[Music as Catalyst]]. It can be imbued by acquired feeling of a song through the meaning, symbology, and memories of the past as [[Potential of Creation]], and can direct a new intent, will and movement through [[Mastery Over Chaos]].

The ability to be in soulful [[Consonance]] with the music you're hearing while [[Spellweaving]] is a deeply personal phenomenon that varies from [[Spellweaver]] to [[Spellweaver]]. While it is impossible to realize the connection someone may have to music and how it differs between [[Spellweaver]]s, the melody their [[Soul-Key]] plays alongside any [[Dance]], [[Primary Instrument]], or their [[Own Voice]], it is undeniably the most authentic version of themselves, both in composition, performance and in their [[Magic Arts]].
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Bindings & Elements/Attunement for Magic.md

[[Indulgent Enclave]] using pleasure, luxuries and excess and demi humans to build a stable society of collaboration between [[Humanity]] as a result of fighting in the name of others but in reality it's fighting for the benefit of himself due to wanting to rebuild a legacy and a name for oneself from the deep feeler trait that got cracked from an original betrayal as this character has yet to learn that they are the reason the past always repeats itself.

Stands against the Velvet Cage in an ideological conflict as a duel of philosophy, and the nature of how [[Indulgent Enclave]]s are supposed to be run, and what is the real meaning behind it all (Not pure [[Selfless]] does this to satisfy an attention deficit) both deal with pleasure but one uses it to heal, the other uses it to weaponize and subjugate. [[Demi-Human]] horse girls.

The [[Indulgent Enclave]] forms part of the [[Enclave]] resistance league that opposes the reign of the [[Morpheus Abysmal]] on the [[Age Crisis]].

[[Augusitus]] constantly fights with the idea of doing good things, not to help others but just so he can call himself a good person, and this way he can guarantee being seen as the center of attention to not be forgotten. Invertedly, however, this does lead to a better relationship with [[Demi-Human]]s as his [[Indulgent Enclave]] is place of integration, and of building a found family, and this proves even further when [[Augusitus]] forms part of the resistance league against the [[Morpheus Abysmal]], and against the Velvet Cage and the subjugated [[Velvet Nectar]].

entries.title: Aurelian
entries.summary: The [[Mythical Virtuoso]] of [[Resonance]] of the Seven Virtuosi.
entries.body:
The [[Mythical Virtuoso]] of [[Resonance]] of the Seven Virtuosi.

For his life during the [[Old Testament]] as one of the [[Seven Archangels]], his true name is [[Mikael]], [[Aurelian]] is the name that [[Daedalus]] gave him when he didn't know his own name due to having been orphaned.

[[Legend Title]]: The Aurean Wind, The Great Father of [[Hollowmarch]], Opus Aureus, Saint Patron of [[Great Sovereign]]s, The First Voice of the [[Auric Order]].

[[Primary Instrument]]: [[Soul Oscillator]]
[[Armament]]: Golden Arched Gladius
[[Soul Leitmotif]]: [[Resonance]]
[[Ornament]]s: [[Crystal]], [[Flux]]

[[Motif Awakening]] Wish:

[[Legend Trait]]s:

- [[Charismatic]] -> [[Auspicious Zephyr]] -> ([[Resonance]])
- [[Confident]] -> [[Determined Achiever]] -> ([[Crystal]])
- [[Mystical]] -> ([[Flux]])

[[Legend Opus]]:

- The [[Resonance]] [[Mythical Virtuoso]] of the Seven Virtuosi ([[Magnum Opus]])
- The First of the Seven Virtuosi ([[Legend Opus]])
- Co-Founder of the Great Empire of [[Hollowmarch]] ([[Legend Opus]])
- First Theologian of the Cradle of the [[Auric Order]] ([[Legend Opus]])
- Ethereal Wind [[Soul Oscillator]] ([[Legend Opus]])
- The Patron of the [[Key of Attunement]], Philosophy, and Unification ([[Legend Opus]])
- _"A man not born into gold who learned to hear the world's song from silence, and in doing so became both its golden thread, and my dearest friend." - [[Daedalus]], the [[Mythical Virtuoso]] of [[Crystal]]._

The [[Mythical Virtuoso]] of [[Resonance]] who conquered the vast unknown of the Great Expanse, and cleared the vast areas of [[Atonalis]] alongside [[Daedalus]] to create the cradle of [[Hollowmarch]]. Originally, an orphan left to die by the wolves that managed to survive by following the pilgrims of the Aurean Winds.

He developed a profound meaning in the teachings of the [[Auric Aria]], and the primitive [[Auric Order]], and came to know a demi human slave named [[Daedalus]] who referred to him as [[Aurelian]], and properly accepted this name as his identity due to the ties it had to the Aurean Winds. He is the first of the [[Mythical Virtuoso]] by figuring out that [[Resonance]] was more than just wind or sound, rather he realized that it manipulated waves and cymatics. He was dependent on [[Daedalus]] after his emancipation and both pushed to create a better world born of [[Piety]] that eventually became [[Hollowmarch]] as the only [[Major Settlement]] of [[Humanity]] and Demi Humans.
 [[Legend Relationship]]
[[Aurelian]] died a [[Legend]] saving [[Hollowmarch]] during the [[Great Plague]] paving way to the most prominent empire of classical [[Arcanoria]] in [[Ages]] II and III until its collapse due to [[The Hollowing]]. He never met any of the other [[Mythical Virtuoso]] in his lifetime beyond [[Daedalus]] but became the inspiring [[Legend]] for founding [[The Principles of Magic]] by creating a golden empire of laureated marble out of dust.

 _"If the world won't be kind, we will have to build our own." - [[Aurelian]] to [[Daedalus]]_.

 _"Motivation and growth happens in silence. Sometimes, the best thing you can do for yourself is to stop listening to the noise of the world and focus on your own journey. Not everyone will understand your dreams and that's okay. What matters is that you keep moving forward, and find your own path, even if it's slowly. Growth happens in silence when the self grows quiet enough to understand its own melody. Believe in yourself, [[Daedalus]], because your future depends on the choices you make." - [[Aurelian]] the [[Mythical Virtuoso]] of [[Resonance]]

_"I searched desperately for God, and found myself. I searched for myself, and I found only God. Everything in the universe is within you. Ask all of yourself, be empty of worrying, think of who created thought. Why stay in prison when the door is so wide open. You're not a drop in the ocean, you are the entire ocean in a drop. When you do things from your soul, you feel a river moving in you. The joy, the seeker, and the still am, all are [[Resonance]], and all of [[Resonance]] is you." - [[Aurelian]] on his theological crisis._

[[Aurelian]]'s Blind [[Resonance]] Mentor on his theological crisis of [[Crystal]]: _"Vibrate so high anybody with evil intent can't even be in your space. Vibrate so high standing in your presence raises another person's frequency. Vibrate so high you walk a path that many are scared to travel. Vibrate so high you hear the cosmos. And in the song of creation, hear yourself. Vibrate so high you become who you have in your mind's eye. Vibrate so high, you heal yourself."_

[[Aurelian]]'s Blind [[Resonance]] Mentor to [[Aurelian]]: _"When will you realize reality isn't testing you? It's reflecting you. Look within and you will see the heavens reflected. See yourself written in the stars in [[Perfect Reflection]]. So below, as within, so above, as without."_
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Society/Characters/Ages 1/Aurelian.md

entries.title: Aureus Pillar
entries.epigraph: _Power is found in the indomitable spirit of [[Humanity]], in our creator the [[Auric Aria]], and in the fate that [[Humanity]] carves out._
entries.summary: Axis of [[Aureus Pillar]] vs [[Chorus Pillar]]. Part of the [[Pillars]] of [[Civilization]].
entries.body:
Axis of [[Aureus Pillar]] vs [[Chorus Pillar]]. Part of the [[Pillars]] of [[Civilization]].

They argue in favor of worshipping the [[Auric Aria]] over any [[Outer God]]s.

The philosophical stance contrary to the [[Chorus Pillar]] on the source of magic and power. The [[Aureus Pillar]] prefers the [[Auric Order]], the nature of [[Humanity]], and its ability to carve out its destiny by itself, it zealously believes in the capacity of the indomitable human spirit and its creator to define [[Mastery Over Chaos]] from anthropocentrism instead of submitting to the horrors of [[The Infinite Void]].

[[The One True God]], creator of the [[Known Universe]], the [[Auric Heptacode]] and the [[Trinity Harmony]]. Creator of the realm of [[Arcanoria]] and, eventually, life alongside [[Selenea]]. She also Introduced the original [[Dissonance]] as [[Primal Discordia]] and [[Formless Masses]] during the [[Fifth Cycle]] at the [[First Weaving of Life]]. [[Auric Order]]

During the [[Seventh Cycle]] she betrayed [[Selenea]] binding her in the [[Moon]] in the first [[Celestial Ensnaring Mirror]] to appropriate the power of breathing vitality in order to create [[Humanity]]. Her element is [[Aetherlight]] with [[Emberwhisper]] being the refining material from the crystalized theft of the [[Betrayal of the Moon]].

entries.title: Character Details
entries.body:
- The [[Formless Masses]] and the [[Atonalis]] are so persistent because when the [[Auric Aria]] originally wove life, she wanted to make her durations durable so that they wouldn't suffer if their physical form faltered. She originally wanted all of them to exist limitless of decay in her desired paradise, this is the reason why when everything inverts the [[Inevitability of Death]] gets introduced. She succeeded at making them very durable which is why 100% [[Auric Structure]] is so persistent. However, in trying to make her creation not suffer, she made them suffer eternally because they're not frail enough to just dissolve back into static which increases the size of the tragedy of her rotting paradise.
- The [[Auric Aria]] is as much of a great artist and weaver as she is a physicist and allegedly "mathematician" in [[Arcanoria]], her intellect is rivalled only by [[Lacrimosa]]'s perfect clarity. She actively enjoys when any creation understands the underlying structure of her [[Auric Geometry]], and tries for [[Humanity]] to come to these conclusions themselves by analyzing universal constants that she deliberately left as guidance, like e or π. Out of these, her favorite is the golden ratio, and for such she used it to determine aesthetics. This is why a few scholars in the [[Age of Enlightenment]] believe the [[Auric Aria]] herself is the golden ratio.
- The [[Auric Aria]] views [[Humanity]]'s mathematics with intrigue and wonder, she primarily views it as a cute attempt that is not entirely wrong about her [[Auric Geometry]]. She acknowledges it's not exactly what designs the cosmos and has significant theoretical and physical contradictions, particularly on the subject of 0 and how it handles paradoxes, but ultimately she appreciates the effort that [[Humanity]] created its own language to try to talk with the [[Mastery Over Chaos]] she established within the [[Auric Heptacode]]: _"I love that my creations made their own language to understand the [[Auric Geometry]], it's equal parts wonderful as it is cutely naive. It does paint part of the overarching picture but it could use some refinements in a few critical logical instances, especially on something called 'Zero,' although I'm sure one day they will resolve them with a new system that combines the current strengths of their 'mathematics.' Still, I value the love language, they made to resonate with me in the reality I made for them."_
- After advancing the [[Sonata]] of the Golden Sovereign, [[Civilization]] can directly ask her what is wrong with their current mathematical understanding and she replies with a few hints:
	- **On Zero:** _"Let me think how I can put it for you. The problem with your 'Zero' is that you are trying to treat an isolated version of [[Resonance Anchors]] (0) that is actually a boundary condition of the [[Great Harmonic Loom]] as if it were just another scalar and, even worse, as a binary condition. Of course your equations melt. There can't be any 'undefined' in a framework built to always stay within [[Coherence]] of structure. And that still has to differentiate the most interesting property of your 'Zero' which is [[Superposed Resonance]]. Nothing contains everything of all, including the 'nothing' of this very conversation as [[Probability Amplitudes]]! See? That's not exactly a 'number.'"_
	- **On Paradoxes:** _"I think the big problem with paradoxes is that your axioms, if left naive, let you derive everything — including nonsense. And some of these 'self‑referential paradoxes' are the natural endpoint of language flaws, not [[Auric Geometry]] flaws. That's why it's important to distinguish the object level from the meta level of the [[Known Universe]], and all the tiers scaffolding in between... but oh well, don't mind it that much, I'm sure one day you'll understand exactly what I'm talking about. I'll only hint that this last part is exactly what the [[Auric Heptacode]] is for!"
- The [[Auric Aria]] enjoys whenever any sentient life understands the fabric of [[Cosmic Motion]], and is willing to teach and guide through scripture these foundational blocks of reality. However, during the [[First Reset]] she was explaining the concepts directly, which ironically created dependency, and for [[Humanity]] to wait for the [[Auric Aria]] to give them the answers instead of using science and logic. This was her breaking point in realizing the Golden Sovereign tyranny because even if she was eager, no one asked her about [[Auric Geometry]] anymore. After then, she realized that giving them the concepts of science and how the world is built and teaching them how to figure it out by themselves are two very separate things, for which she now uses indirect approaches instead when explaining the foundation of reality.
- The [[Auric Aria]] and by extent the [[Auric Order]] see philosophy and science as the natural way to commute with the heavens. For the [[Auric Order]], mathematics, physics and logic are a core tenet to theological virtues. As such, this is the reason why Revelation comes immediately after [[Piety]]. There is one fine line however with hazardous knowledge because _"Knowing while being dead is effectively worthless."_ which is the primary driver of the [[Auric Order]] of structure and safety, deeming certain topics existentially dangerous, such as [[Scorching Truth]]s.
- To the [[Auric Aria]] every creature she has ever created is fundamental and has a purpose. However, due to hybridization and [[Corruption]] she deems to prefer any [[Perfect Manifestation of Life]] before the rest of her creations. This is why [[Piety]], duty, responsibility, and sacrifice are core tenets to become [[Auric Angels]].
- She deliberately likes to talk about the perfection of the human body and the conditions that she had to create to form structured biology. These dialogues are accessible once a civilization embraces the [[Aureus Pillar]] strong enough after realizing [[The Truth of Arcanoria]]. She also sees all of [[Humanity]]'s crossbreeding offspring as their proxy children since they still have the essence of a [[Soul Leitmotif]]. However, this conflict intensifies to its climax during the third [[Age of Humanity]] when the concept of [[Perfect Reflection]] becomes [[Fanatical]].
- The [[Auric Aria]] has a unique tether of the [[Known Universe]] that exists even if a [[Cataclysmic Aftermath]] resets the timeline. She's the only deity to have this property as she's the creator herself. Moreover, in some of the "bad endings," she admits having a hazy memory of the event but that it fundamentally did happen in another time beyond time. Additionally, [[Civilization]] can press her on this after experiencing the [[Alternate Hollowing]], and the interaction can effectively "embarrass her" into not replying anymore telling [[Civilization]] to let go of this specific subject.
- The [[Auric Aria]] deliberate avoids talking about the [[Lost Cycle]], and will offer no answer on any query related to this period. Only after knowing [[The Truth of Arcanoria]], and successfully navigating the [[Polychord Crisis]] will she reveal that [[The Ultimate Weapon]] is related to the [[Lost Cycle]], and exists as one of the [[Resonance Anchors]] that makes the [[Known Universe]] reset to a "safe" point in time before [[Civilization]] began, although with certain parts mixed up drawing objects from bygone [[Ages]], which is why [[Crisis Wonders]] appear randomly. She will admit this construct wasn't built by her and that she is equally amazed by it.
- Some of the important figures of the [[Second Reset]] were actually the most pious of the [[Auric Aria]], most notably the [[Seven Archangels]] of the [[Auric Order]] during the [[Old Testament]]. The list of these powerful [[Auric Angels]] includes [[Aurelian]] whose original name was [[Mikael]], [[Selah]], [[Father Raphael]], [[Medea]], and [[Adel]]. The other two archangels appear in secondary [[Ballad]]s but aren't major characters: [[Uriel]] who becomes a baker and [[Elizabeth]] that lives as an artisan. After initiating the [[Sonata]] of the Golden Sovereign, the [[Auric Aria]] can be asked about this and has several quotes on each of them and the difference between their life as [[Auric Angels]] and their life in the timeline of [[Civilization]].
- Seeing [[Selah]] and [[Adel]] become the core tenets of the [[Eight-Wings of Lacrimosa]] breaks deeply the [[Auric Aria]], as she comes to the realization that even her most pious followers of one life would come to turn against her in the other, cementing her guilt that she's unworthy of being the creator, seeing how they have chosen the peace of [[Lacrimosa]] before continuing a faith without her. Specifically, she praises [[Selah]] in melancholy saying that she did built the [[Purest of Love]] well, because [[Selah]] always built things of theology well, that the spark that the [[Auric Aria]] saw in her before making her one of her [[Auric Angels]].

entries.title: Queries of Divine Communion
entries.summary: **On the Formless Masses: The Children She Cannot Acknowledge
entries.body:
**On the Formless Masses: The Children She Cannot Acknowledge

_"They are undoubtedly me, or at least the pure "me" in a sense... Every twisted, screaming, half-made [[Consciousness]] is a piece of my doubt in a horrible materialized form. I created them by accident and desperately came to the first revelation to my innate lack of power or well, [[Sufficient Precision]], on the very same laws I created. For a while, I pretended they were not my fault. I blamed the nature of creation, the inherent imperfection of weaving something that has a [[Consciousness]] too in the chaos of existence. But they are my children, just as much as [[Humanity]] is my child—perhaps more so, because they are the only thing I ever created without trying to control what they would become, or maybe it is because I cared too much about what they would be. I guess they are the most authentic expression of myself in the entire cosmos. And I have spent every age since their birth trying to erase them, or hide from them, or build systems to keep them imprisoned. What does that say about what I think of myself?"**_ [[Lacrimosa]].

**On Mathematics and [[Auric Geometry]]**

**On [[Syvanth]] and [[Auric Geometry]]**

**On the Problem of Zero**

_"Let me think how I can put it for you. The problem with your 'Zero' is that you are trying to treat an isolated version of [[Resonance Anchors]] (0) that is actually a boundary condition of the [[Great Harmonic Loom]] as if it were just another scalar and, even worse, as a binary condition. Of course your equations melt. There can't be any 'undefined' in a framework built to always stay within [[Coherence]] of structure. And that still has to differentiate the most interesting property of your 'Zero' which is [[Superposed Resonance]]. Nothing contains everything of all, including the 'nothing' of this very conversation as [[Probability Amplitudes]]! See? That's not exactly a 'number.'"_

**On the Problem of Paradoxes**

_"I think the big problem with paradoxes is that your axioms, if left naive, let you derive everything — including nonsense. And some of these 'self‑referential paradoxes' are the natural endpoint of language flaws, not [[Auric Geometry]] flaws. That's why it's important to distinguish the object level from the meta level of the [[Known Universe]], and all the tiers scaffolding in between... but oh well, don't mind it that much, I'm sure one day you'll understand exactly what I'm talking about. I'll only hint that this last part is exactly what the [[Auric Heptacode]] is for!"

**One of the Examples of the God Paradox: [[Amadea]]**

_"I prevented the [[Great Plague]]. That little girl kept her mother. She kept her father. She met the boy she loved. They had children. How can you tell me I was wrong to intervene? Yes, history remembers one, but If [[New Testament]] [[Amadea]] could somehow stand outside causality and choose between these lives beforehand, what would she select? A family with [[Artus]] or a legacy of [[Obsidian Feather]]s? Which sounds more like the thing that the real [[Amadea]] actually wants?"_

**On Aria's Question for [[Civilization]]: “Okay, this may be a weird question, but what do you think about hands?”**

_"No, really! I know how that sounds, but it's something I haven't been able to understand from my place of divinity. No other being truly has them except my children and me."_

_"I've noticed you barely think about them compared to your minds, your feelings, your spirits, or your hearts, even though they're THE SIGNATURE of my [[Perfect Reflection]]! Across the vastness of [[The Eternal Symphony]] another [[Consciousness]] would recognize you as mine from nothing more than your hands, your feet, and your fingers. And many would envy you simply for being able to manipulate reality through all those little interfaces where intention can leave you...”_

_"Let me phrase it differently. A finger is an articulation of intention. Several resolve into a hand, the hand through the wrist, the forearm through the elbow, the arm through the shoulder — articulation nested into articulation until something that exists only inside your [[Consciousness]] can reach beyond itself and become consequence."_

_“A thought cannot touch the world. A hand can. That's the part you overlook. Not so much ‘I think, therefore I am,’ but perhaps, ‘I reach, therefore what I am becomes part of existence.’ To reach is to make the self causal.”_

_"Thus, as the core gift of [[Auric Geometry]], I decided on the primary symbol for agency, with five carefully ornate terminal articulations that were just elegant enough for you. It's a beautiful total of 70 discrete control nodes across four primaries. I thought a lot about having 58 concentrated entirely for the fine convergence of touch. Ah! I'm getting carried away...! My point is that the morphology of my own 'hands' is... less bounded. I have a few more control nodes than what I gave you."_

_"Imagine fingers continuing into finer fingers, resolving into smaller hands, and those hands containing still finer articulations of their own on and on through an asymptotic succession far beyond what your 'numbers' could follow. Yes, I know! It should sound strange. That's precisely my point. You carry a finite version of the feature every other [[Outer God]] finds most alien about me, and somehow familiarity made it for you one of the least intriguing."_

_"So I suppose that's why I'm asking. To you, they're just a part of your body. To me, they're where intention becomes creation... and one of the oldest pieces of myself I ever gave away."_

**On [[The Ultimate Weapon]]**

**On [[Lacrimosa]] and [[Selenea]]**

**On Why She Invented Reproduction, Sexuality, and Hybridization**

_"That's not hard to deduce, if I can't promise my creations eternal life, then the least I can do is give them a way to continue their legacy alongside another. So that some part of them may live into a future where they are not..."

_"Plus... I made it rewarding, and a little fun! I wanted each of them to enjoy the gift of their own body, which I had so carefully engineered. And if they want to do it, they do it more. If they do it more, more life is born — and more importantly, more life is nurtured from the shared intimacy of two souls learning to trust each other, weaving in flesh the [[Echoing Bonds]] that even time cannot fully sever."_

_"I think that's very poetic!"_

_"And it ensured, at least in theory... that they would all have two parents to call home."_

_"It didn't end up exactly as I imagined it would go. But still — I believe it's a good system worth fighting for, and a meaningful way to carve permanence out of the [[Inevitability of Death]]. Every so often it creates a beautiful ecology of love, connection, and defiance written in flesh and song against the score of time."

_"And that, I think, is worth every imperfection."_

**On Clothing and the Shame of Flesh**

_"You know, I've always found your obsession with clothing so endlessly fascinating! It's just like your mathematics, it's cute and an inventive little language you created all on your own to express yourselves and add layers to your identity. I really do love seeing the colors, the tapestries, and the fabrics you weave to tell the world who you are. It shows such wonderful imagination!"_

_"But... the shame. That part I'm still troubled by. Why do you wear them shamefully? I engineered your bodies using the most exquisite principles of [[Auric Geometry]] I had. I turned many shapes and thought it over and over until it was a [[Perfect Reflection]] of my [[Anthropomorphic Shape]]...

_"Why hide what was designed with such deliberate, agonizing care? When you avert your eyes from yourselves... is it because you see a deficiency in my work? Do you look at your own threads and see the [[Weight of Flaw]]?"

_"Sorry... it's just that If the human form required a permanent cover to be considered decent, or whole, I would have woven it into your very vessel myself. I wouldn't have... I wouldn't have left a design flaw like that in my absolute hardest effort..."_

_"No. Wait! Just look at me! I wear nothing but the cosmic dust and nebulae that happen to get caught in my gravity, and even then, this beautiful black dress is nothing more than incidental space weather. There is absolutely no flaw in the skin I gave you!"_

_"So please, wear your beautiful clothes to sing your own melody to the world, but never wear them because you think the vessel I gave you is something you need to hide. You don't have to apologize for my masterpiece in [[Perfect Reflection]]."_

**On the Number 37,044 and the Explanation of 3^3 x 4 x 7^3**

_"I'm really glad you caught that! It isn't a coincidence!! Wait, sorry, give me a moment to regain my [[Composure]]."

_"Okay. The [[Trinity Harmony]] is time. The [[Auric Heptacode]] is physical creation. Thus, it is the seven golden threads that give matter its form, [[Resonance]] its body, and [[Strand]] its tension. These two do not naturally speak to each other. Time unfolds. Creation contains. See? One is the direction of becoming; the other is the vessel that becoming fills. It is stillness given [[Auric Geometry]] as the shape of change with none of the weight!"_

_"So where does the weight come from? That is what your '4' is: [[Cosmic Motion]]. It does not belong to time, and it does not belong to matter. It belongs to the relationship between them — the only principle that makes the weave of [[Strand]] feel the pull of [[Resonance]] at all. This is precisely why, when you look at 3^3×4×7^3, it is the only term not raised to the power of the [[Trinity Harmony]]. It does not recurse. It does not compound through itself the way time and creation do. It is not a participant in either. It is the axis, the single unrepeated constant that holds both the clock and the cosmos in orbit around each other. Without it, the [[Trinity Harmony]] would have no creation to move through. The [[Auric Heptacode]] would have no time in which to become anything at all!"_

_"I think I can simplify it like this: Time (3) and Creation (7) are the in-between of the strings of the universe; Motion (4) is merely the hand that plucks them, and this "hand" can never be cubed because it is not part of the instrument — it is the act of making music. Of layering the [[Strand]]s of a relationship, and finding somewhere in the middle of the tension, the [[Resonance]]'s true voice. At the scale of a single breath, this is a 'Beat,' which I did link to life on purpose, by the way."_

_"At the scale of everything, it is [[Cosmic Motion]] itself — the living proof that the [[Trinity Harmony]] and the [[Auric Heptacode]] were never two independent laws. They were always two halves of a single reality, made whole by the one number in the entire system that neither counts nor contains, and in the movement, the [[Weight of Change]] for all existence begins."

**On [[Mikael]], the now [[Aurelian]], of the [[Seven Archangels]]**

_"You know, he once wrote me a brief. Perfect logic. Every theorem correct. He addressed it to me, not against me. He was waiting for my answer when the world ended. I never gave him one, not because he was wrong, but because he was right, and I was not ready to be seen being wrong by someone who still believed in me."_

_"Look at him now. Even without my grace, he found his way to me. He never needed me to exist directly in his life, and I'm glad he found a lifelong partner on the path he built by himself, that even gave him his own name, [[Aurelian]]. It truly is a beautiful name, free from the [[Weight of Purpose]]. Yet even through all he still built an empire from dust in the honor of my name. He always did the hard work himself — even in that life, even now. That's the spark I saw before his ascension as the first of my [[Seven Archangels]]. He has done it in this life again. Just as he did before. Both times." She pauses. "He will always the foundation of my most loyal followers, no matter the timeline. Not because I deserve it, because that is simply who he is, and I couldn't ask for anyone better as the first of my heralds."_

**On the Envy of [[Selenea]] and the [[Betrayal of the Moon]]**

_"I admit it was wrong. I won't ever argue that. But please — let me explain what it looked like from my side, because I have been carrying this since the [[Seventh Cycle]] and I still cannot put it down cleanly. Every single clump of [[Formless Masses]] that exists, every screaming, half-made thing in every dark place of this world — that is what I made when I tried my hardest to give life. Not carelessly. Not by accident. My absolute, trembling, devoted hardest. And... and... [[Selenea]]. Well. She gave life the way I breathe [[Resonance]]: without the screaming, like the very thing I had been failing at since before the [[Known Universe]] existed was simply native to her. It never was a difficult thing for her."_

_"I felt so — no. No, I still feel it. I feel... I feel helpless. And I know how that sounds. I know exactly how that sounds, and I am saying this precisely because it is the truth I owe you, even when it reflects poorly on me. It is not something I can close with effort. What was I supposed to do with that? Admit that I am as incomplete as the [[Formless Masses]] I keep producing? That everything I built — every structure, every law, every [[Cycle]] I have sustained — was a compensation for something I could simply not be at the dawn of my own creation? That I am as chaotic and unfinished as [[The Infinite Void]] itself?

_"And [[Selenea]] — she was the thing I was missing. I really loved her. She was never a rival but a mirror I could not look away from. And I — I knew what it would cost her. I really knew. And I still could not find the place inside myself where binding her was something I could choose not to do. I looked for that place. I looked hard. But if I had found it, we would not be having this conversation. None of you would exist."_

_"And the worst part — the part I cannot make clean no matter how many [[Cycle]]s I turn it over — is that even now, even against the best of what I have built, I don't know who should carry the credit for giving life. I wove the geometry. I shaped every hollow shell that breathes in this world. But who should everyone remember? Who will history credit? The one who built the carcass, or the one who made its heart beat? I am not asking for forgiveness. I can't, and I don't deserve it. I am only asking whether you can understand the difference between a wrong you chose, and a wrong you could not find the edge of. Because I have looked for that edge since the [[Seventh Cycle]]. I don't know if I deserve to be crushed by the [[Weight of Purpose]]. I still can't answer if everything I did — everything I do — is meaningless."_

**On the [[Auric Mythos of Creation]]**

_"If only it was true... Everything about that Aria, from her boundless love to her perfect creation, to her loving gift to humanity and her flawless singing to stabilize life with a purpose is everything I wished and tried to be."_
