entries.title: The Auric Tone Length as Minimum Tone
entries.summary: In real physics, the Planck length (~1.616 × 10⁻³⁵ m) emerges from combining the fundamental constants G, ℏ, and c, representing the scale below which spacetime becomes meaningless as a smooth manifold. In [[Arcanoria]], this bottom limit emerges from an entirely different, and far more elegant, principle.
entries.body:
In real physics, the Planck length (~1.616 × 10⁻³⁵ m) emerges from combining the fundamental constants G, ℏ, and c, representing the scale below which spacetime becomes meaningless as a smooth manifold. In [[Arcanoria]], this bottom limit emerges from an entirely different, and far more elegant, principle.

The [[Auric Tone Length]] is the **minimum resolvable period of the lowest stable tone** — the full revolution of the lowest frequency that can still maintain a standing [[Soliton]] without collapsing into undifferentiated [[Primal White Noise]]. Think of it as the universe having a **fundamental note**, the absolute bass of the [[Auric Heptacode]], and the minimum length is the wavelength of that note. Below it, you cannot encode distinct frequencies; waves become indistinguishable from one another, and therefore cannot carry information or identity.

For a [[Soliton]] to hold structure, its wavenumber $k$ must satisfy:

This $\ell_A$ is the [[Auric Tone Length]], which emerges not as an arbitrary constant, but the minimum spatial period at which [[Aetherlight]] self-focusing and [[Lunehymn]] dispersion can still achieve balance. Below $\ell_A$, dispersion cannot counteract focusing at any amplitude; the wave collapses into undifferentiated [[Primal White Noise]]. The full wavelength of the [[Auric Aria]]'s deepest encodable tone is:

Thus, the constant is not an arbitrary number. It is the full revolution of the lowest type of tone for frequencies to stabilize and make sense, the period encoded into reality by the [[Auric Aria]] at the moment of the [[Proto-Universe]] first sounding.

### The Descent of Frequencies

To reach the scale of the [[Soliton]]s that act as building blocks, the frequencies of the [[Dual Confluence Stream]] must split in a precise downward cascade. This is not instantaneous, it is a structured descent through the [[Auric Heptacode]]'s harmonic series architecture:

- From the **fundamental tone** down through the **harmonic series** (integer multiples: $2f$, $3f$, $4f$…)
- Then into **semitones** ($2^{1/12}$ intervals)
- Then into **microtones** ($2^{1/n}$ for large $n$)
- These divide all the way down until reaching the **minimum resolvable tone-difference** — the [[Auric Tone Length]].

Shannon entropy confirms this: the channel capacity of any medium is bounded by its bandwidth. The [[Auric Aria]] encoded a minimum bandwidth into the [[Known Universe]]. The [[Auric Tone Length]] is that bandwidth's floor.

### The [[Heptagonal Brillouin Zone]] — The Shape of Reality's Floor

The [[Auric Tone Length]] $\ell_A$ as defined above is a scalar limit, the minimum spatial period below which no [[Soliton]] can form. This is sufficient to prevent the ultraviolet catastrophe (the infinite bleed of energy into ever-smaller wavelengths). However, a scalar cutoff alone cannot explain three things the [[Great Harmonic Loom]] demonstrably does:

1. **Why frequencies descend in discrete steps** — semitones, microtones — rather than a smooth continuous slide
2. **Why [[Coherence Repulsion]] has the hard topological character of a zone boundary**, not a soft energy gradient
3. **Why [[Chern Number]]s $\mathcal{C} \in \mathbb{Z}$ are well-defined integers** — a topological invariant requires a *periodic lattice* in momentum space to exist mathematically

The resolution is that $\ell_A$ is not merely a scalar. It is the **edge length of a discrete topological lattice** — specifically, the **[[Heptagonal Brillouin Zone]] (HBZ)**, the fundamental domain of the [[Auric Heptacode]]'s seven-dimensional frequency lattice encoded into the [[Great Harmonic Loom]] at the moment of the [[Proto-Universe]]'s first sounding.

The seven primitive lattice vectors of the HBZ are set by the seven fundamental tones of the [[Auric Aria]]:

Where $\hat{e}_j$ are the seven unit vectors of the [[Auric Heptacode]] geometry. The [[Heptagonal Brillouin Zone]] is the Wigner-Seitz cell of this reciprocal lattice as the heptagonal region in seven-dimensional frequency space closest to the origin. Waves with wavevectors outside this zone are not merely attenuated rather they do not exist in the [[Great Harmonic Loom]] as distinct frequencies. They alias back into the zone or dissolve into [[Primal White Noise]].

This also completes the explanation of [[Coherence Repulsion]]. When two [[Soliton]] clusters of different [[Chern Number]]s approach, the zone-boundary of the HBZ creates a hard topological barrier between their frequency classes — not because of a continuous energy cost, but because there is no lattice path connecting one Chern class to another without passing through a singularity. Topology does not allow smooth interpolation between integers. The barrier is not a wall. It is an impossibility.

_The [[Great Harmonic Loom]] does not hold matter apart through effort. It holds matter apart because it is geometrically incapable of confusing one integer for another._

When a [[Wolf Bomb]]'s [[Phase Singularity]] is injected into a [[Soliton]] cluster, it is geometrically equivalent to **punching a hole in the [[Heptagonal Brillouin Zone]]** and breaking the lattice periodicity at a single point. The band structure collapses locally, the [[Chern Number]] becomes undefined, and the topological invariant shatters. This is the precise mechanism of the Fission detonation.

entries.title: Time Bubbles as Self-Folding Solitons
entries.summary: A [[Time Bubble]] in [[Arcanoria]] is a [[Soliton]] that has been caused to **fold upon itself**. The existence of [[Time Bubble]]s which can be of vast distances makes the real difference between atoms and particulate physics.
entries.body:
A [[Time Bubble]] in [[Arcanoria]] is a [[Soliton]] that has been caused to **fold upon itself**. The existence of [[Time Bubble]]s which can be of vast distances makes the real difference between atoms and particulate physics. A [[Time Bubble]] is a massive atom that can expand several leagues of kilometers becoming its own pocket dimension, a [[Soliton]] is the minimum unit, yes, but it doesn't mean it is the smallest and that it is reserved to that form.

A [[Time Bubble]] exists because it becomes a closed, self-referential wave structure where the [[Probability Amplitudes]] of multiple temporal states interfere constructively inside a bounded domain. This maps directly to the **Feynman path integral formalism** in quantum mechanics:

Every possible path through time contributes an amplitude. Normally these interfere and cancel except for the classical path. A [[Time Bubble]] is a configuration where **all paths within a region constructively interfere**, the [[Soliton]] loops back on itself and the interior becomes a superposition of all its own temporal states simultaneously.

The key physical insight: the self-referential folding is only stable because [[Soliton]]s are **nonlinear**. A linear wave would destructively interfere with its own reflection. A [[Soliton]], by definition, has the nonlinear self-reinforcing property that allows it to maintain its profile even when it collides with itself. This is why [[Time Bubble]]s are a type of large [[Soliton]]. The nonlinearity is the mechanism of self-containment that creates the individual pocket dimensions due to time paradoxes.

### The [[Strand Pool]] and [[Probability Amplitudes]] Folding

The [[Strand Pool]] is the deepest application of the [[Soliton]] framework. By using [[Strand]] (Echoing Bonds / Spacetime Relativity) to create a self-referential temporal loop and [[Flux]] (Analogue to Quantum Currents), a [[Strand Pool]] creates the conditions for a **Bose-Einstein condensate analog** in the [[Great Harmonic Loom]] — all the [[Probability Amplitudes]] collapse into the same "ground state frequency," achieving infinite coherent superposition within a bounded volume which allows to recover pieces of the past through [[Object Permanence]].

Each fold of the [[Strand Pool]] doubles the accessible Hilbert space of the system:

The [[Superposed Resonance]] as [[Resonance Anchors]] is not metaphor, it is the literal description of a **closed time-like curve functioning as an information multiplier**. The [[Strand Pool]] described in the [[Hypermage]] architecture uses several layers of [[Hyper Chord]]s to create a closed [[Time Bubble]] where infinite iterative folds of [[Probability Amplitudes]] multiply the effective [[Consciousness]] contained within it.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Conduits of Magic/Soliton.md#Time Bubbles as Self-Folding Solitons

entries.title: What Solitons Actually Are
entries.summary: In real physics, a [[Soliton]] is a solitary wave that maintains its shape while traveling at constant speed, arising from a precise cancellation between nonlinear effects — which tend to steepen a wave — and dispersive effects — which tend to spread it out. The **KdV equation** (Korteweg–de Vries) is the canonical example:
entries.body:
In real physics, a [[Soliton]] is a solitary wave that maintains its shape while traveling at constant speed, arising from a precise cancellation between nonlinear effects — which tend to steepen a wave — and dispersive effects — which tend to spread it out. The **KdV equation** (Korteweg–de Vries) is the canonical example:

The soliton solution is a **locked wave**, it neither grows nor collapses. It is the wave equivalent of a stable particle.

In [[Arcanoria]], this is not merely an analogy. It is the literal ontological mechanism. Matter is not composed of atoms, it is composed of [[Soliton]]s within [[Known Universe]] governed in [[Arcanoria]] through the [[Dual Confluence Stream]], the interplay of [[Aetherlight]] and [[Lunehymn]]. A physical object is a cluster of phase-locked [[Soliton]]s maintaining constructive interference against the background chaos of the [[The Infinite Void]] filtered by the [[Auric Heptacode]] which is the meta level scaffolding and geometric constraint that keeps these [[Soliton]]s from dispersing back into [[Primal White Noise]] in the [[Known Universe]].

### The [[Harmonic Equilibrium]] Condition

The governing equation of all [[Soliton]] behavior in [[Arcanoria]] is the **Driven-Dissipative Cubic-Quintic Complex Ginzburg-Landau Equation (CQCGLE)**, which describes the [[Dual Confluence Stream]] field as an open system continuously sustained by the [[Great Harmonic Loom]]:

Where:

- $\psi$ is the [[Soliton]] field amplitude
- $\hbar_A$ is [[Arcanoria]]'s reduced action quantum, set by the [[Auric Aria]]'s fundamental tone
- $m_S$ is the effective [[Soliton]] "mass" determined by the [[Auric Heptacode]] geometry
- $g_1 > 0$ is the [[Aetherlight]] self-focusing cubic coupling constant
- $g_2 > 0$ is the [[Lunehymn]] quintic defocusing saturation constant
- $\gamma_A > 0$ is the local [[Aetherlight]] gain, continuously injected from the [[Leylines]]
- $\gamma_L > 0$ is the [[Lunehymn]] linear dissipation into the [[Primal White Noise]]

This equation is not closed. It is open. Matter in [[Arcanoria]] is not a static object. It is a **dissipative process** — a standing negotiation between the creative pressure of the [[Leylines]] and the entropy of [[The Infinite Void]]. The [[Soliton]] exists because $\gamma_A$ and $\gamma_L$ are in continuous exchange; if the [[Leylines]] are severed and $\gamma_A \to 0$, matter does not explode — it *slowly un-becomes*, the [[Lunehymn]] dissipation bleeding the field amplitude away until [[Coherence]] can no longer be maintained.

A pure conservative equation would imply matter exists on its own, indifferent to the [[Great Harmonic Loom]]. The open-system form is the mathematical proof that nothing in [[Arcanoria]] is self-sufficient. Everything that exists, exists because the song of [[The First Overtone]] is still playing.

A stable [[Soliton]] requires that the gain-loss balance is maintained alongside the nonlinear potential well — the full **[[Harmonic Equilibrium]] condition**:

The stable amplitude at which matter plateaus is thus a function not only of the coupling constants but of the local [[Leylines]] health of the region:

Dying land — land whose [[Leylines]] have been over-extracted and whose $\gamma_A$ no longer reaches its equilibrium with $\gamma_L$ — has a measurably lower stable amplitude. The [[Soliton]] lattice of every object and every living body in such a region is slightly thinner. Matter is less there. This is the physics behind the slow environmental death that precedes the [[Divine Reset]] before [[The Ultimate Weapon]] manifests.

The equation whose full violation detonates a [[Wolf Bomb]] is the same equation whose partial violation unmakes a [[Civilization]] slowly and silently.

### Why Ordinary Matter Does Not Explode — The Quintic Stabilizer

The pure cubic NLS presents a critical instability: any minor upward fluctuation in [[Aetherlight]] density raises $\kappa$ above 1 and triggers finite-time blowup. If this were the complete governing equation, every object in [[Arcanoria]] would spontaneously detonate from ambient background noise, a loud emotional surge of [[Flux]], a passing storm, the [[Pulse]] of [[Leylines]]. Clearly, the [[Great Harmonic Loom]] contains a deeper stabilizing mechanism.

The full governing equation of the [[Dual Confluence Stream]] is not a pure cubic NLS but a **Cubic-Quintic NLS**, which includes a higher-order defocusing saturation term provided by the [[Lunehymn]]'s deep harmonic resistance:

Where $g_1 > 0$ is the [[Aetherlight]] self-focusing cubic coupling constant and $g_2 > 0$ is the [[Lunehymn]] quintic defocusing saturation constant. As the amplitude $|\psi|^2$ grows due to [[Aetherlight]] fluctuation, the quintic term $g_2|\psi|^4$ grows faster and pushes back — creating a natural amplitude plateau where [[Soliton]]s stabilize without detonating. The stable matter amplitude is the plateau value $|\psi_{\text{stable}}|^2$ where all three forces balance:

This plateau is robust to small perturbations. Minor fluctuations in local [[Aetherlight]] density, ambient [[Flux]] surges, emotional resonance spikes, proximity to [[Leylines]], shift the amplitude slightly but the quintic term restores equilibrium automatically. Matter in [[Arcanoria]] does not balance on a knife's edge. It rests in a potential well.

The [[Wolf Bomb]] works precisely because it forcibly overcomes this potential well — not by raising $\kappa$ slightly, but by simultaneously maximizing $g_1$ (via [[Aetherlight]] compression) and nullifying $g_2$ (via inverse-phase [[Lunehymn]] interference), stripping the quintic stabilizer entirely and leaving only the runaway cubic term. The universe does not accidentally detonate. It must be deliberately made to.

The energy cost of stripping the quintic stabilizer is the activation barrier of the [[Wolf Bomb]]. Fission type weapons must overcome it through [[Resonance]] Compression alone. Fusion type weapons overcome it more efficiently by phase-synchronizing two [[Soliton]] clusters first, so their combined amplitude clears the barrier in a single constructive step.

entries.title: Soul-Key
entries.summary: The state of the soul reflected in the [[Soul Leitmotif]]. Commands genuine intention bound to memory, agency, life, and will. It is the gift of [[Selenea]]'s [[Pure Light]] made manifest at the end of the [[Fifth Cycle]] and onwards.
entries.body:
The state of the soul reflected in the [[Soul Leitmotif]]. Commands genuine intention bound to memory, agency, life, and will. It is the gift of [[Selenea]]'s [[Pure Light]] made manifest at the end of the [[Fifth Cycle]] and onwards.

The actual art of the [[Soul-Key]] is that is the literal key which a [[Spellweaver]] uses to dictate the "home base" of their composition by requiring a tonic pitch, the root and melody of whichever element the [[Spellweaver]] is casting on a chord, and the mode which is the state of the [[Fundamental Frequency]], its intervals, and its intention.

So, the spell of this [[Soul-Key]] is on [[Cindergale]] with a minor mode (F Minor), and let's suppose this is an expert [[Spellweaver]] that is casting a complex attack with the layering of offensive and utility spells. The actual "attack" spell is a [[Dyad Chord]] and a [[Unison]], but they prepare the field to make it easier to cast complex logic without too much upkeep of [[Essence Sacrifice]] or [[Signal Loss]].

- **Purifying Fire Field:** [[Triad Chord]] of C ([[Resonance]]) + F ([[Cindergale]]) + Ab ([[Void]]) with Ritardando. Result: A wave that has fire and void properties that appears in a burst and slows down as it reaches its maximum range.
   _Narrative:_ The [[Spellweaver]] casts one large wave of shadow-infused fire that rides along an expansive field. They use this as a utility offensive spell to establish the "fierce" arena on which they will fight a duel. They create an isolated domain where the expansive shadow-flame cleanses the nearby area into flat land that has pre-built [[Stable Harmonic Channels]] due to the [[Resonance]] casted. It clears the physical environment while allowing less [[Signal Loss]] empowering the effective spell distance and lowering the cast time.
- **Abyssal Fuel:** [[Triad Chord]] of Eb ([[Flux]]) + Ab ([[Void]]) + C ([[Resonance]]) with Legato. Result: A midnight-black liquid that has vacuuming "sticky" properties which leverages the existing [[Stable Harmonic Channels]], highly flammable.
  _Narrative:_ Then, they manipulate the lingering void field to create waves beneath to rise and redirect them to the target. The idea is to create a flammable medium that is sticky enough to stay within whatever it catches. It keeps adding more precise [[Resonance Anchors]] for their next devastating "simple" [[Dyad Chord]].
- **Repeating Fire:** [[Dyad Chord]] of F ([[Cindergale]]) + Bb ([[Strand]]) with Staccato.
  Result: Sparks of fire that repeat and reverberate themselves to nearby surfaces.
  _Narrative:_ This is the actual spell, and the real genius is that catching fire requires almost no [[Essence Sacrifice]], the "hard part" which was cleaning the zone, creating [[Stable Harmonic Channels]], and adding a medium that can be flammable which acts as additional [[Resonance Anchors]]. The small sparks ignite and repeat themselves to catch on nearby mediums of whatever is caught with the sticky Abyssal Fuel and suddenly becomes a great blaze while paying almost no price for conjuring the blaze itself. _"Build the perfect medium, let the magic do the rest."
- **Defensive Casing:** [[Unison]] of G [[Crystal]] with Legato.
  Result: A [[Crystal]] barrier around the [[Spellweaver]].
  _Narrative:_ Since the fire they made is indiscriminate and will burn anything that is mixed with Abyssal Fuel, to prevent injuries the [[Spellweaver]] encases themselves for the duration of the fire, blocking the actual dangerous part "The sticky abyssal fuel" from sticking to them as well. It serves as ways to control which parts of the arena catch on fire as well, and due to all the effort building [[Resonance Anchors]] and [[Stable Harmonic Channels]] they can be set quickly.

The whole idea is that the scenario they created is an actual song, with tonality, interval, intent, and such that if played with 1 second per bar will create a score of the soundtrack itself, and the chord structure can be used too for a 4/4 layering, it makes music match perfectly the magical structure.

Likewise, the combination of notes and the cleverness of using [[Resonance Anchors]] helps unload the burden of the spell while making the actual "attack" relatively easy to cast but the compounded effects are a terrifyingly potent chamber of [[Cindergale]]. The natural tonality of [[Cindergale]] in the minor modality creates an almost sacred, mourning place of purifying fire that adds even more layers to the symbology and [[Key of Attunement]] of what the user feels: A mourning purifying fire on their own burning field.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Spellweaving/Soul-Key.md

The essence of self imbued with the primary element from [[The Principles of Magic]] that any [[Spellweaver]] has. It requires a [[Motif Awakening]] to manifest and is the primary source of [[Music as Catalyst]] for [[Spellweaving]].

It starts with the primary element imbued from the [[Motif Awakening]]. However, it can receive up to two [[Ornament]]s with enough [[Spellweaving]] mastery and new [[Motif Awakening]]s. entries.title: Consciousness bound in a Soul-Key gem
entries.summary: A [[Soul Leitmotif]] is the [[Fundamental Frequency]] gem, a physical crystallization of a [[Spellweaver]]'s [[Soul-Key]]. Their unique vibrational signature made tangible through a [[Motif Awakening]]. The gem is not merely a container of magic but the actual manifestation of their [[Consciousness]] externalized, containing both their essence, memories and soul.
entries.body:
A [[Soul Leitmotif]] is the [[Fundamental Frequency]] gem, a physical crystallization of a [[Spellweaver]]'s [[Soul-Key]]. Their unique vibrational signature made tangible through a [[Motif Awakening]]. The gem is not merely a container of magic but the actual manifestation of their [[Consciousness]] externalized, containing both their essence, memories and soul.

It is a single physical object of mutable shape that reconfigures physically between multiple forms depending on context and need. Likewise, the aesthetic visuals of the gem represents the primary binding and its [[Ornament]]s in the following configuration:

- Primary Color ([[Soul Leitmotif]]): The gem's core color matching the [[Spellweaver]]'s signature element. It defines both the icon and primary color of the [[Fundamental Frequency]] gem. This is the dominant visual identifier.
- Primary [[Ornament]] (Veinwork Color): Fine, branching veinwork runs through the gem's interior like rutile needles or mineral dendrites, manifesting in the complementary color to the primary element.
- Secondary [[Ornament]]: The casing color of the metallic framing surrounding the gem, typically silver by default.

The colors of the elements are the following:

- [[Resonance]]: Bright green to teal luminescence.
- [[Luminance]]: Pure white-to-pale-yellow glow.
- [[Flux]]: Deep, shifting varieties of blue.
- [[Void]]: Purple and shadow with black undertones.
- [[Cindergale]]: Warm orange to crimson ember-glow.
- [[Crystal]]: Pink, prismatic radiance that splits light into rainbow fractals.
- [[Strand]]: Braided gold that seems to move across the surface.
entries.section: Consciousness bound in a Soul-Key gem

entries.title: Dark Arts
entries.summary: [[Flesh-Casing Ritual]]: The dark version of making a [[Familiar]] but from oneself to encase fully within the gem. The [[Spellweaver]] is able to withstand fatal physical damage so long as their [[Soul Leitmotif]] remains intact.
entries.body:
[[Flesh-Casing Ritual]]: The dark version of making a [[Familiar]] but from oneself to encase fully within the gem. The [[Spellweaver]] is able to withstand fatal physical damage so long as their [[Soul Leitmotif]] remains intact. It becomes not just the externalization of [[Consciousness]] but rather the [[Spellweaver]] essence entirely. If the [[Soul Leitmotif]] is broken or damaged, it is fatal for the [[Spellweaver]] regardless of their physical state.

The body becomes only a container, but if the body moves away more than 30 meters from the [[Soul Leitmotif]] it causes the body to cease functioning and, unless an external actor returns them within the [[Soul-Key]] [[Resonance]] distance, it usually ends in comatose or permanent death as the body naturally rots just as if it was regular rigor mortis.

[[Flesh-Binding Ritual]]: A similar concept of binding oneself but instead of using the [[Soul-Key]] in a [[Soul Leitmotif]] to transfer a state of physicality into formless or [[Consciousness]] it instead does the opposite, giving flesh to anything beyond the [[Known Universe]]. It is the only method that invites [[Outer God]]s to [[Arcanoria]] by using sacrifice as the means of gaining an [[Anthropomorphic Shape]].
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Spellweaving/Soul Leitmotif.md#Dark Arts

entries.summary: When you bind with your [[Soul-Key]] a [[Primary Instrument]] of sufficient emotional value. It allows to create a copy of any tangible instrument that can be activated to conjure magic through [[Music as Catalyst]] without having to carry it.
entries.body:
When you bind with your [[Soul-Key]] a [[Primary Instrument]] of sufficient emotional value. It allows to create a copy of any tangible instrument that can be activated to conjure magic through [[Music as Catalyst]] without having to carry it.

It is exceptionally useful for both combat and utility but it requires that the [[Spellweaver]] has unlocked at least one [[Ornament]].

The storage is found withing the [[Soul Leitmotif]] as part of the [[Spellweaver]]s own [[Consciousness]] that's why it has to be meaningful enough for it to attune to oneself.

entries.title: The Three States of a Soul Leitmotif
entries.summary: The [[Fundamental Frequency]] gem exists in three distinct operational states, each reflecting a different level of magical engagement, emotional intensity, and deployment context. Understanding these states is crucial to comprehending how [[Arcanoria]]'s magic functions — from intimate, daily practice to catastrophic, reality-altering bursts of power.
entries.body:
The [[Fundamental Frequency]] gem exists in three distinct operational states, each reflecting a different level of magical engagement, emotional intensity, and deployment context. Understanding these states is crucial to comprehending how [[Arcanoria]]'s magic functions — from intimate, daily practice to catastrophic, reality-altering bursts of power.

**Dormant State (The Resting Egg) | [[Consciousness]] as Magic

Dormant [[Soul Leitmotif]]: [[Flux]].
[[Ornament]]s: [[Resonance]], [[Crystal]].

Dormant [[Soul Leitmotif]]: [[Luminance]].
[[Ornament]]s: [[Flux]], [[Strand]].

The dormant state is a [[Soul Leitmotif]]'s true resting condition, it's the baseline existence usually kept in a sacred space or shrine, in this state it is something treasured and protected rather than openly worn.

It's physical state resembles a teardrop-shaped ovoid approximately 5-10 cm in length encased in metallic framing matching the secondary [[Ornament]], pulsing gently with the [[Spellweaver]]'s [[Fundamental Frequency]] in a rhythm reminiscent of their heartbeat. Dormant gems are usually kept in sacred spaces, personal shrines, altars, or in intimate possessions. They serve as spiritual anchors treasured as extensions of the self. A dormant gem can't be lost, they appear next to their [[Spellweaver]]s once they pass a certain threshold of distance.

**Wearable State (The Accessory) | Control as Mastery

Wearable [[Soul Leitmotif]]: [[Void]] as a spherical pendant on a choker.
[[Ornament]]s: [[Strand]], [[Flux]].

The most common state of a [[Soul Leitmotif]] as this is the active configuration that a [[Spellweaver]] integrates into their outfit, making it a catalyst for [[Spellweaving]]. It's the state during normal life and combat preparation.

The metallic casing flows like mercury, reshaping around the gem as it elongates, flattens, or reconfigures. The casing reforms and bonds molecularly to clothing, fabric or a chosen jewelry piece. The gem becomes part of the outfit rather than merely attached to it.

**Wearable Forms:** The gem can take numerous configurations depending on cultural tradition and tactical need. All forms maintain the same color encoding (primary color core, complementary-color veins, casing-color framing):

- Head/Face: Circlet, tiara, hairpin, ear cuff, eyepiece/monocle.
- Neck/Chest: Pendant, choker, brooch, collar clasp.
- Arms/Hands: Ring, bracelet, arm band, glove ornament.
- Torso/Waist: Belt buckle, sash ornament, corset centerpiece.
- Legs/Feet: Anklet, thigh band, boot ornament.

Likewise, the wearable state is maintained during combat or high-stress situations signaling specific properties because:

- It maintains constant [[Consonance]] with the [[Great Harmonic Loom]].
- It allows quick access to [[Major Note]]s without pausing for meditation.
- It's visible and intimidating — potential threats recognize the glowing gem as a magical threat.

If the [[Spellweaver]]'s emotional state becomes inauthentic or conflicted during [[Spellweaving]], the gem flickers or dims as a warning that one of [[The Principles of Magic]] is degrading. This prevents spell completion and is the visual cue that invites [[Discordant Interference]].

As for endurance, most [[Spellweaver]]s can maintain a wearable state indefinitely. However, the intensity of the spells and the magical fatigue manifest physically as the gem to becomes hot to the touch and its glow erratic. At this point, the [[Spellweaver]] must transition back to dormant state to allow recharge, if they still refuse to stop they're likely to pass out from the strain they're putting in their [[Consciousness]]. Recovery time usually takes 1-2 hours of rest but it can be increased by the magical fatigue debt of [[Spellweaving]] beyond exhaustion.

**[[Awakened State]] (The Critical Manifestation) | Emotion as Fuel

[[Awakened State]] [[Soul Leitmotif]]: [[Flux]] sympathetic rings from a [[Crystal]] construct.
Orbiting [[Ornament]]s: [[Crystal]], [[Luminance]] in polyhedron geometry and arcs of light.

[[Awakened State]] [[Soul Leitmotif]]: [[Luminance]] searing light star-like core cocoon.
Orbiting [[Ornament]]s: [[Flux]], [[Strand]] with tidal currents flowing in time bending.

The last and most powerful state of the [[Soul Leitmotif]] occurs only during the [[Catalytic Abyss of Emotion]]. This is the gem's most powerful and most terrifying state. It only occurs when a [[Spellweaver]]'s feeling reaches such intensity that it breaks through the [[Great Harmonic Loom]]'s normal amplitude limits, creating waves that cascade through multiple threads simultaneously.

This state requires an authentic catalyst, no amount of forced or acted emotion can trigger an [[Awakened State]]. This is why it is rare and most [[Spellweaver]]'s never experience it, but those who do are forever changed by it. It is different from a [[Motif Awakening]] because it can only occur after a [[Spellweaver]] has unlocked both of their [[Ornament]]s and has mastery over their primary binding. It follow a similar logic for activation yet instead of triggering a new [[Motif Awakening]] and giving a purpose, it is a visceral present state that creates an impossible state of [[Superposed Resonance]] where the gem responds catastrophically, regardless of its current form. Its atomic structure becomes unstable as it cannot contain the flow of emotion happening.

The sequence of activation is the following:

1. Veinwork Ignition (0.3 - 3.5 seconds): The [[Soul Leitmotif]] veins erupt with luminescent fury. Barely visible inclusions become the lightning-bright channels of pure elemental energy burning from the gem's interior, branching fractally as power seeks every pathway.
2. Gem Expansion and Rupture (3.5-5 seconds): The gem undergoes catastrophic transformation, growing 3-5x its original size as it ruptures from its contained form. It becomes a raw, jagged levitating elemental matter, pulsing with searing intensity that changes shape based on the primary binding element of the original [[Soul Leitmotif]].
3. Elemental Outburst (5-7 seconds): The awakened gem erupts a massive elemental aura, creating visible environmental effects and a field of distortion around the [[Spellweaver]] based on their element.
4. Spell Manifestation and Cascading Collateral Damage (7+ seconds):
5. Collapse and Aftermath (On ending of [[Awakened State]]):

entries.body:
A keyed instrument that is both a piano and synthesizer-like [[Primary Instrument]] born entirely from [[Resonance]]. It can evolve to develop functions based on the personal journey of the [[Spellweaver]]. Its default sound is that of a piano.

It is a projection of oneself through the [[Soul Leitmotif]]. It allows to create vibration in the same score sheet of [[The Eternal Symphony]], and creates unique sounds based on the [[Spellweaver]]'s [[Fundamental Frequency]].

It manifests for those who are the most "lost" on their identity and how they sound, while it is primarily for [[Resonance]] [[Spellweaver]]s, other [[Spellweaver]]s like [[Luminance]] or [[Flux]] can easily manifest it if they're a Stage Performer that doesn't know their true voice yet.

Historically, it predates the real invention of keyed instruments such as keyboards, pianos, harpsichords, as the instrument from the score of [[The Eternal Symphony]] itself which is noted in the pentagram and treble clef. For the early [[Ages]] it serves as a [[Primary Instrument]] and replacement to the lack of pianos, keyboards, and synthesizers while drawing from the own [[Soul Leitmotif]] of the [[Spellweaver]]. Any [[Spellweaver]] able to manifest one is highly valued.

It usually manifests an ethereal keyboard but on advanced [[Ornament]]al [[Spellweaver]]s it can appear as a large grand piano able to change the sounds based on the users' [[Soul-Key]]. It depends entirely on the ability of the [[Spellweaver]] to achieve [[Attunement for Magic]] as the sound they are playing is the literal manifestation of their own's [[Soul-Key]]'s [[Resonance]].

### [[Soul Oscillator]] Users

- [[Vanessa of Iridia]]
- [[Luminaire]] (The Grand Ivory Queen)

entries.title: Spellweaving
entries.summary: Magic come true according to [[The Principles of Magic]]. it's called [[Spellweaving]] because it involves weaving the threads of reality into a composition that then manifests into the divinity of the stars. [[The Registers of Magic]]
entries.body:
Magic come true according to [[The Principles of Magic]]. it's called [[Spellweaving]] because it involves weaving the threads of reality into a composition that then manifests into the divinity of the stars. [[The Registers of Magic]]

Thus [[Spellweaving]] is the willful, deliberate manipulation of the world's inherent [[Resonance]] In the art of being heard, maintaining an ordered relationship against the encroaching entropy of [[Primal White Noise]].

The pipeline is:

 - Intent -> Bending the Strings of Reality -> These Threads become the Pentagram of a Musical Score Sheet -> The Magic Becomes the Threads Connecting the Stars of the Sky as [[Lyrical Fragment]]s and [[Constellation]]s.

Any [[Spellweaver]] requires a [[Soul Leitmotif]] to cast magic.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Spellweaving/Spellweaving.md

entries.title: 1. Magic Always Has a Cost
entries.summary: _[[Spellweaving]] draws transforms power from [[Consciousness]]._
entries.body:
_[[Spellweaving]] draws transforms power from [[Consciousness]]._

The act of weaving music into magic is a transaction of everything that makes the song of the [[Soul-Key]] governed by the subjective [[Weight of Value]].

This entire principle of transaction for fuel as energy, memories, emotions, lifespan, blood, etc. is governed by the principle of [[Essence Sacrifice]], where the stronger the [[Resonance]] of the fuel and the intent of the spell, the most powerful it will be.

However, paying prices of [[Miracle Magic]] requires a heavy cost to rewrite fate itself. There are many means to decrease the prices from practice, to understanding [[The Principles of Magic]], to feeling the music of your soul through the [[Key of Attunement]], to offloading the power of the spell through [[Emotional Authenticity]]. However, the act of singing against the [[Void]] costs in the dynamics and energy of your existence.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Spellweaving/Spellweaving.md#1. Magic Always Has a Cost

entries.title: 10. Magic Can Become Addictive
entries.summary: As [[Spellweaving]] is a fundamental tool that can allow access to several layers of life, it is too subject to the [[Weight of Indulgence]] in several shapes:
entries.body:
As [[Spellweaving]] is a fundamental tool that can allow access to several layers of life, it is too subject to the [[Weight of Indulgence]] in several shapes:

- Magic is power, and power is addictive, it can transform anyone just like political power does, and it is intrinsically tied to both in most [[Regalia Pillar]] societies, particularly, when a large part of the populace is being used as [[Consensual Anchoring]] [[Resonance Anchors]] to increase the power of a single soloist, which is the basis of certain tyrannical rules in [[Fanatical]] [[Regalia Pillar]] societies that use the [[Coherence]] of their populace as means to increase the volume of their own [[Fundamental Frequency]].
- Aside from the [[Regalia Pillar]], the [[Motif Awakening]] can be a pivotal point for many [[Spellweaver]]s in [[Civilization]]s whose [[Civic]]s tend to aesthetize it as part of the coming of age, such as in the Duels of Severance, or in the case of [[Void]] users who use it to signal that this is proof of their loss, like [[Pollux]].
- [[Lunehymn]] and [[Aetherlight]] both have powerful effects on [[Consciousness]] and they can become addictive potent drugs due to the side effects they induce on continued use on their concentrated and radiant forms respectively. Moreover, in other substances such as [[Velvet Nectar]], they become ontologically addictive due to the ability transfer that rewards harvesting skills from other people rather than learning on your own.
- The commodification during industrialization makes every [[Dark Age]] start relying on cruel methods of using [[Spellweaving]] as power, it is seen in both axis as the [[Age of Velvet Elegance]], and in the [[Age of Sealing Iron]] despite being completely contrary [[Pillars]]. This tendency goes further in the [[Age of Chimeras]], and even to the [[Age of False Moons]].

There are some other instances and applications but they are all tied to the [[Weight of Indulgence]], and in some minor degree to the [[Weight of Value]], [[Weight of Change]], and [[Weight of Flaw]].
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Spellweaving/Spellweaving.md#10. Magic Can Become Addictive

entries.title: 11. Dead Magic Zones Exist
entries.summary: As [[Arcanoria]] stratifies by the [[Vibrational Density]] of the [[Great Harmonic Loom]], there are certain areas that are  dead zones that subject all [[Spellweaver]]s to be treated as mortals. These come from two primary sources:
entries.body:
As [[Arcanoria]] stratifies by the [[Vibrational Density]] of the [[Great Harmonic Loom]], there are certain areas that are  dead zones that subject all [[Spellweaver]]s to be treated as mortals. These come from two primary sources:

- Natural Dead Zones: Like the [[Crescent Mist Peaks]] in its lower levels or these can be naturally made by advanced [[Vibrational Fallout]]. Other [[Atonalis Nest]]s are considered to be dead zones given the low [[Coherence]]. Similar [[Landmark]]s can exhibit dampening properties.
- Manufactured Dead Zones: Depending on the type it can be from [[Events]] like divine discharge such as [[The Silent Expanse]] after the [[Eighth Cycle]], backfire of [[Hyper Chord]]s, as seen with [[The Grand Fusillade]] in [[Ages]] V, or through the [[Wolf Bomb]]s with the lingering regions filled with the [[Wolf Tone]] and necrotic [[Symphonic Veins]].
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Spellweaving/Spellweaving.md#11. Dead Magic Zones Exist

entries.title: 12. Magic Reveals Character
entries.summary: [[Spellweaving]] is fundamentally attached to the subjective experience of existence starting by which [[Armament]] and [[Primary Instrument]] does a [[Legend]] even use to survive and cast magic.
entries.body:
[[Spellweaving]] is fundamentally attached to the subjective experience of existence starting by which [[Armament]] and [[Primary Instrument]] does a [[Legend]] even use to survive and cast magic.

From there, it stratifies into many categories like the entire [[Stellar Legacy Score]] which considers from [[Legend Trait]]s that define origin, wound, [[Motif Awakening]] wish, personality traits and [[Spellweaving]] mastery that evolve organically based on [[Lyrical Fragment]]s, accumulated [[Legend Opus]], [[Legend Title]]s, and everything else that constitutes a [[Constellation]], their [[Stellar Covenant]]s, and [[Syncretism]] that reflects the relationship between its individuals, mortals, and [[Spellweaver]] [[Civilization]]s.

Similarly, since the music is tied as a [[Magical Catalyst]], the expression, composition, and performance of each piece of music tied to the [[Soul Sheet Music]] of a [[Legend]], they have different effects, just like how expression changes based on who plays a piece, the magic differs in strength, potency, side effects, etc., as personal nuance is added to the expression of the [[Soul Leitmotif]].

Finally, the [[Soul Leitmotif]] is the ultimate expression of the [[Legend]] as it functions as a mood ring, a bio feedback monitor, a [[Composure]] meter, and a personal biography with [[Ornament]]s and its primary binding signaling the attunement to one of [[The Principles of Magic]].

In a world where psychology, theology, magic, emotion, and physics are all united, the expression of the soul against entropy is the key for transformation through the [[Triadic Virtues of Spellcraft]] that determine as much character in life as a [[Legend]] as they do for a [[Constellation]] dictating the [[World Truth]]s of the next set of [[Legend]]s.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Spellweaving/Spellweaving.md#12. Magic Reveals Character

entries.title: 13. "Ancient" Outer Magic is Fundamentally Different
entries.summary: Ancient magic is commonly referred to as [[Outer Magic]] due to its ties with [[Outer God]]s, it tends to predate [[Arcanoria]] given the nature of [[The Infinite Void]]. It all depends on when was the [[Outer God]] born, but it unequivocally follows the same patterns:
entries.body:
Ancient magic is commonly referred to as [[Outer Magic]] due to its ties with [[Outer God]]s, it tends to predate [[Arcanoria]] given the nature of [[The Infinite Void]]. It all depends on when was the [[Outer God]] born, but it unequivocally follows the same patterns:

- As It relies on [[Outer God]]s, it tends to be reality warping and unpredictable with situations that are heavier, stranger, and harder to control while having existential threats and cosmic horrors that can twist the normal laws of physics, and the homeostasis of harmony in [[Arcanoria]].
- These events require a host for its [[Flesh-Binding Ritual]], and begin using [[Piety]] as [[Resonance Anchors]] and [[Consensual Anchoring]] of [[Humanity]] that can transform into a [[Flesh-Exalting Transcendence]] unleashing the apocalypse of whichever horror was invoked. The principle that allows the [[Regalia Pillar]] to increase the potency of an individual [[Spellweaver]] due to population is the same principle that allows an [[Outer God]] to incarnate and gather power through [[Piety]].

Moreover, there are several theological debates on this subject of what classifies as [[Outer Magic]] due to [[Selenea]] and the [[Auric Aria]]. This extends because both the influence of [[Selenea]] and the [[Auric Aria]] exhibit the same properties as [[Outer Magic]] given their divine nature:

- Particularly on the case of [[Selenea]], the moments she meets [[Civilization]] through the Selenic Set of [[World-Bending Relics]], she unleashes the Daydreaming Sky from her overwhelming joy. She may be lonely, but she is still an [[Outer God]] with unpredictable consequences that become entropy, chaos and loss of [[Coherence]], which is one of the main issues to solve during the [[Sonata]] of the Pale [[Moon]].

Traditionally, the [[Auric Aria]]'s power instead of being grouped with the powers cosmic horrors of [[Outer God]]s, her abilities are exclusively revered as [[Auric Magic]] or Divine [[Spellweaving]]. Stating otherwise is profoundly insulting to the [[Auric Order]].
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Spellweaving/Spellweaving.md#13. "Ancient" Outer Magic is Fundamentally Different

entries.title: 2. Certain Spellweaving is Forbidden Magic or Taboo
entries.summary: _The [[Great Harmonic Loom]] doesn't have a [[Consciousness]], only the caster does._
entries.body:
_The [[Great Harmonic Loom]] doesn't have a [[Consciousness]], only the caster does._

[[Civic]]s and acceptance of [[Spellweaving]] depends on an axis of [[Consonance]] and [[Dissonance]]. There are many practices that are considered forbidden or taboo by most [[Civilization]]s which tend to filter anything that is overly dangerous, destructive, indiscriminate, unpredictable, gruesome, cruel, or otherwise unsustainable.

The entire lists of [[Forbidden Magic]] is vast given the flexibility of [[Spellweaving]] but it primarily considers anything that is heavily dissonant and amoral. [[The Registers of Magic]] contains all types of magic divided by Tessituras and the [[Dissonance]] application of various types of magic. There is no "evil element" there only is the harmful application of intent of any branch of magic. All types of magic can be [[Forbidden Magic]] under the right conditions and with the intent of subjugation.

Consent is usually the dividing line between [[Dissonance]] and [[Consonance]], for a vaccine, the difference between a poison and a cure is dosage and what is contained within the needle to what purpose, not the needle itself.
entries.section: 2. Certain Spellweaving is Forbidden Magic or Taboo
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Spellweaving/Spellweaving.md#2. Certain Spellweaving is Forbidden Magic or Taboo

entries.title: 3. Magic Cannot Create Something from Nothing
entries.summary: As seen with the principle of [[Essence Sacrifice]], [[Spellweaving]] can transform, manipulate, or transfer, but not truly create.
entries.body:
As seen with the principle of [[Essence Sacrifice]], [[Spellweaving]] can transform, manipulate, or transfer, but not truly create.

This is the real difference of the permanence of magic within objects between normal [[Spellweaving]] and the [[Law of Relics]] on [[Ages]] IV onwards. Still, these [[Magical Relic]]s can only be obtained after [[Lacrimosa]]'s [[The Hollowing]] has been resolved, and the only type of permanence in objects lies as physicalized relationships that can become [[Magical Relic]]s and [[Cursed Objects]] depending on consent, [[Coherence]], and [[Dissonance]]. It transforms [[Echoing Bonds]] through their memory imprint and [[Emotional Residue]] rather than creating from nothing.
entries.section: 3. Magic Cannot Create Something from Nothing
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Spellweaving/Spellweaving.md#3. Magic Cannot Create Something from Nothing

entries.title: 4. Emotional Instability Affects Spellweaving
entries.summary: This section is fundamental as [[The Principles of Magic]] are governed by [[Consciousness]], psychology, and the bindings of states, the primary ones related to emotion are [[Emotional Authenticity]] which translates the gradient of impact from an object, [[Key of Attunement]] as identity and personal alignment, and [[Perfect Focus]] which requires maintaining peace of mind amidst the chaos of the ongoing storm.
entries.body:
This section is fundamental as [[The Principles of Magic]] are governed by [[Consciousness]], psychology, and the bindings of states, the primary ones related to emotion are [[Emotional Authenticity]] which translates the gradient of impact from an object, [[Key of Attunement]] as identity and personal alignment, and [[Perfect Focus]] which requires maintaining peace of mind amidst the chaos of the ongoing storm.

All types of [[Spellweaving]] in [[The Principles of Magic]] require their set of constrains for functioning, which sublimates psychology and emotion into matter. This also affects deities like the [[Auric Aria]] which created [[Aetherlight]], [[Sky Glass]], [[Rose Seed]]s, [[Emberwhisper]], and [[Glimmerfern]] from emotion. [[Selenea]] [[Lunehymn]], and [[Luceatfilum]] and the [[Auroral Ribbons]] with [[Lacrimosa]].

No deity, mortal, [[Pure Light]] being or otherwise existence can bypass the emotional imprint that governs existence as [[Consciousness]] predates matter.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Spellweaving/Spellweaving.md#4. Emotional Instability Affects Spellweaving

entries.title: 5. Magic Leaves Traces Behind
entries.summary: Powerful spells, and emotions leave imprints of [[Emotional Residue]] which are combination of [[Flux]] and [[Strand]] that tend to be detected as [[Strand Pool]]s of many types. These traces are the basis and founding blocks for [[Detective Magic]]. These properties exhibit the following complex characteristics:
entries.body:
Powerful spells, and emotions leave imprints of [[Emotional Residue]] which are combination of [[Flux]] and [[Strand]] that tend to be detected as [[Strand Pool]]s of many types. These traces are the basis and founding blocks for [[Detective Magic]]. These properties exhibit the following complex characteristics:

- The [[Strand Pool]]s born from [[Emotional Residue]] scale proportionally to the intensity of how many lives were affected and the intensity of the emotions felt. This is the principle of how psychology becomes geology as these [[Strand Pool]]s can sublimate into [[Memory Field]]s on very strong [[Emotional Residue]].
- As the [[Emotional Residue]] are [[Strand Pool]]s there are some that can collapse into a massive [[Soliton]] that sometimes becomes a [[Time Bubble]] which is both dangerous and a perfect preservation of a paradox stuck in the past.
- [[Emotional Residue]] is the main trace left behind on any [[Spellweaving]], which makes spells have a trace beneath depending on the type of fuel and emotion it was using governed by the binding of [[Emotional Authenticity]] and [[Essence Sacrifice]].
- The [[Echoing Bonds]] of a spell allow for detecting the traces that lead back to the original [[Spellweaver]]. It can be amplified through objects that carry [[Echoing Bonds]] such as belongings that meant something to that person, personal gifts, etc. This expands to [[Magical Relic]]s and [[Cursed Objects]] on [[Ages]] IV. The detection of [[Emotional Residue]] is the basis for [[Detective Magic]] and following trails. The technique was pioneered by [[Cordelia]] when following [[Amadea]] through the [[Waltz of Wandering Love]] that established [[Echoing Bonds]] between both of them.
- [[Emotional Residue]] has a complex relationship with [[Pure Light]] beings given their vitality and emotional nature, some of these creatures can track precisely [[Emotional Residue]] and sometimes they even digest the [[Strand Pool]]s as seen with the [[Memory Singer]]s. However, this also became the basis of [[Velvet Nectar]] on its most macabre and twisted applications.
- [[Pure Light]] beings that detect or heavily rely in [[Emotional Residue]] are considered as [[Spiritual Tracer]]s given their relationship to [[Strand]] and [[Echoing Bonds]]. The higher [[Pure Light]] over [[Auric Structure]] the more potent they are as a [[Spiritual Tracer]], but of course this comes at the disadvantages of not being adaptable.
- Some [[Atonalis]] also weaponize this principle for their own parasitic [[Resonance]] and tracking which victims have a wound frequency that mirrors their own.
- [[Emotional Residue]] can be analyzed through highly sophisticated lenses of a "time microscope" that can read even the smallest imprint of [[Strand Pool]]s. This is the counter measure to [[Illusory Magic]] to detect the exact state of the [[Emotional Authenticity]] left regardless of what [[Luminance]] may visibly signal.
- Divine [[Emotional Residue]] is the most potent type of [[Emotional Residue]], as seen with the [[Auric Aria]] whose actions in the [[First Reset]] make the ideas of everything that happened in the [[Old Testament]] bleed through the first [[Prophet]]s of the [[Auric Order]]. Keeping core ideas such as the [[Seven Dark Fates]], the [[Ark of Genesis]], [[Paradise Lost]], the lost [[Library of Heaven's Tower]], and other similar ideas such as the concept of demons, who are mistakenly grouped with [[Atonalis]] and fallen [[Auric Angels]], and the concept of the day of judgement in the split of heaven above vs hell below through the [[Celestial Vault]]. This is the reason why the [[Auroral Ribbons]] purified on the [[Cataclysmic Aftermath]] of the [[Great Fracture]] in the climax of the [[Polychord Crisis]], and allowed [[Lacrimosa]] to begin receiving signals from [[Arcanoria]] across [[The Infinite Void]].
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Spellweaving/Spellweaving.md#5. Magic Leaves Traces Behind

entries.title: 6. Overuse of Magic Causes Physical Damage
entries.summary: This is the aftermath of [[Essence Sacrifice]], once the transaction has been done, the overuse of sacrificial energy of one's own [[Consciousness]] pays its toll, whether as physical exhaustion, damage, weakened senses, trembling hands, etc.
entries.body:
This is the aftermath of [[Essence Sacrifice]], once the transaction has been done, the overuse of sacrificial energy of one's own [[Consciousness]] pays its toll, whether as physical exhaustion, damage, weakened senses, trembling hands, etc.

On the economy of [[Essence Sacrifice]] there are a few things to note:

- If a [[Spellweaver]] physically passes out after using too much of their stamina for sustaining magic, their [[Soul Leitmotif]] reverts from [[Awakened State]] or Wearable state back into its Dormant State, and will cause the [[Spellweaver]] to rest forcefully until they can sustain their own [[Coherence]] again.
- On the extreme uses of fuel with hemomancy, not having a [[Flesh-Casing Ritual]] proves fatal most of the time as the bodily decay causes the internal biology to rupture due to blood loss, blood transfusion, etc.
- Other types of fuel like memories, and foundational [[Miracle Magic]], come at a heavy cost that tends to create walking tragedies as seen with [[Elara]], [[Eyras]], and  [[The Cradle of Echoes]]. The hardest part about performing any [[Miracle Magic]] against fate is surviving the aftermath of the whiplash of [[Coherence]].

A [[Spellweaver]] engaging in self destructive behavior is heavily taboo, and they tend to be labelled as "Spiraling Fuel [[Spellweaver]]s." The strategy to surviving a fight with one of these kamikazes is endurance. Since the loop is unsustainable, a candle burning too bright will eventually run out of fuel, the only condition is to survive before, and given that their [[Spellweaving]] is heavily amplified by everything they are destroying, they are usually going to overpower a pure magical fight.

The optimal way to deal with one of these [[Spellweaver]]s is to wait for them to self-destruct, and only engage after they have burned down all of their identity, being taken either by the [[Atonalis]] they're leaving behind, or by the exhaustion of the [[Coherence]] whiplash they will suffer in the moments after the spiral cascade is over.
entries.section: 6. Overuse of Magic Causes Physical Damage
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Spellweaving/Spellweaving.md#6. Overuse of Magic Causes Physical Damage

entries.title: 7. Magic Requires Sufficient Precision
entries.summary: Mistakes, lack of [[Perfect Focus]], vague intent or faulty [[Absolute Certainty]] can completely alter a spell, failing into [[Discordant Interference]] which can fail in the best cases, and backfire completely in the worst.
entries.body:
Mistakes, lack of [[Perfect Focus]], vague intent or faulty [[Absolute Certainty]] can completely alter a spell, failing into [[Discordant Interference]] which can fail in the best cases, and backfire completely in the worst.

[[Spellweaving]] is inherently dangerous given the flexibility it has to alter the physical space. The information and purity of the [[Frequency Harmonics]] embedded within any [[Spellweaving]] depends on the quality of the [[Sufficient Precision]] and [[Luminance]] binding, and the mastery between a terrible [[Spellweaver]] and a master lies in their ability to use through creativity and their personal strengths each of [[The Principles of Magic]]. Leaning towards the ones they master the best, and leaving the offload or simpler work to those who they are the least advanced in.

[[Spellweaving]] is as much of a science field of physics, philosophy, and mathematics of sound engineering in the study of magic, as it is an artistic performance of feeling the song of your own soul and playing it to the uttermost truth of your emotional gradient and subjective appreciation of beauty and personal history. It combines the awe of soft magic with the systemic rules, practice, and mastery of hard magic.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Spellweaving/Spellweaving.md#7. Magic Requires Sufficient Precision

entries.title: 8. Some Places Suppress Magic
entries.summary: [[Arcanoria]] and the [[Great Harmonic Loom]] are both a living infrastructure ecosystem that uses [[Coherence]] as its primary metric to determine harmony, [[Consonance]] and [[Dissonance]]. The atmosphere is layered by [[Vibrational Density]], and [[Leylines]] which act as the nervous system and lifeline of [[Arcanoria]].
entries.body:
[[Arcanoria]] and the [[Great Harmonic Loom]] are both a living infrastructure ecosystem that uses [[Coherence]] as its primary metric to determine harmony, [[Consonance]] and [[Dissonance]]. The atmosphere is layered by [[Vibrational Density]], and [[Leylines]] which act as the nervous system and lifeline of [[Arcanoria]].

As zones function through [[Vibrational Density]] and zones of [[Coherence]], the geology of a region determines stability and [[City Development]] for [[Civilization]]s.

High [[Coherence]] zones and [[Leylines]] act as the magical pathways for [[Stable Harmonic Channels]] that allow for magic to run free with little to no [[Signal Loss]]. These are primordial for [[Trade Nexus]], natural harbors, and [[Trade Nodes]] while allowing for [[Pure Light]] beings to exist within the environment. Moreover, this environmental regulation is governed by the [[Dual Confluence Stream]] that runs through the entire living system of the planet.

However, there are some other zones of low [[Coherence]] present [[Dissonance]] where magic is much less effective, less powerful, and actively harmful, particularly in areas of [[Vibrational Fallout]] where [[Chaotic Resonant Cascade]]s can make the [[Discordant Interference]] of [[Spellweaving]] unpredictable and dangerous.

The entire mesocosm of political conflicts depend on this shifting environment that is also regulated by the [[Grand Thread Rings]] that shift every [[Age Transition]], requiring [[Resonance Stabilizer]]s to keep the [[Coherence]] of a region by changing the flow of the local [[Leylines]]. Sites of exceptional [[Coherence]] are [[Sacred Site]]s, and other key [[Landmark]]s. The most interesting place of [[Arcanoria]] with this phenomenon is the [[Crescent Mist Peaks]] that feature the complete spectrum.

After [[Ages]] IV, [[Luceatfilum]] exists in the transition zones of [[Coherence]] gradients.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Spellweaving/Spellweaving.md#8. Some Places Suppress Magic

entries.title: 9. Magic Reacts Differently Under Certain Conditions
entries.summary: Magic is subject to [[Cosmic Motion]], [[Cycle]]s, [[Echo]]es, [[Phase]]s, and other environmental changes such as the moving [[Grand Thread Rings]] of the [[Great Harmonic Loom]]. Each establishes periods of high magical affinity, such as the [[Ritual Seventh]], the [[Rite]]s of each day, and the [[Echo of Crescendo]] as the climax of magical [[Resonance]].
entries.body:
Magic is subject to [[Cosmic Motion]], [[Cycle]]s, [[Echo]]es, [[Phase]]s, and other environmental changes such as the moving [[Grand Thread Rings]] of the [[Great Harmonic Loom]]. Each establishes periods of high magical affinity, such as the [[Ritual Seventh]], the [[Rite]]s of each day, and the [[Echo of Crescendo]] as the climax of magical [[Resonance]].

Moreover, some elements of the classical alchemy can react to the application of magic which makes them useful as tools and also imbued with [[Civic]], culture, and theological value. Primarily, this is seen in [[Lunehymn]] and its concentrated variations with reacting properties it has on [[Resonance]] which makes them perfect clocks for tracking the [[Pulse]]s of the [[Leylines]].

The [[Crescent Mist Peaks]] is one of the [[Landmark]]s that best display this changing behavior:

- [[Sky Glass]] exhibits similar properties in changing with the environment, functioning fundamentally different in the [[Crescent Mist Peaks]] as it does everywhere else.
- The crescent mist of [[Lunehymn]] that rises through the inverse waterfalls is functionally different in carrying narcosis and [[Emotional Residue]] at a much higher concentration than it would do elsewhere.
- The affinity of magic and the tides of the [[Crescent Mist Peaks]] change, with the [[Echo of Crescendo]] being the best time to attempt pilgrimage on the mountain.
- The [[Lunar Abyss]] is one of the chambers with the most reflective properties that change and attune based on the [[Rite]] of the day and the [[Lunar Calendar]].

Magic changing is one of the most foundational pillars of [[Civilization]] building, [[Rite]]s, [[Civic]]s, major [[Events]], ability to commune with [[Outer God]]s, the presence of some [[Atonalis]] and [[Primal Discordia]] such as [[The Amber Wonderland]], and the individual perception of their own magic shifting in frequencies through the [[Pulse]]s and [[Bar]]s of each day, [[Seventh]], [[Cycle]], and [[Act of Fate]].
entries.section: 9. Magic Reacts Differently Under Certain Conditions
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Spellweaving/Spellweaving.md#9. Magic Reacts Differently Under Certain Conditions

entries.title: Spiraling Conscription
entries.category: Militant Civic · Ages IV Onwards · Dissonance
entries.summary: Inspired by [[Institute]]s, [[Civilization]] utilizes [[Spellweaver]]s who have critically low [[Composure]] as state-sanctioned expedition units.
entries.body:
Inspired by [[Institute]]s, [[Civilization]] utilizes [[Spellweaver]]s who have critically low [[Composure]] as state-sanctioned expedition units. These already half-broken individuals are deliberately deployed into highly hazardous areas, such as [[Vibrational Fallout]] zones and the outer territories of wild magic, gambling on whether the [[Spellweaver]] will break toward an [[Atonalis]] demon or push through the trauma. _"They are already half-broken. The question is whether they break toward the [[Atonalis]] or through it."_

[[Ballad]]s:

- A squad of four highly traumatized conscripts are dropped into wild magic. Instead of breaking, they form an intense level of [[Echoing Bonds]], triggering secondary [[Motif Awakening]]s that make them powerful enough to return to the capital and overthrow the generals who sent them to die.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Society/Societal Resources/Foundation/Civic.md (Spiraling Conscription)

entries.title: Stable Harmonic Channels
entries.epigraph: _Fiber Optics for Magic!_
entries.summary: The pathways of [[Spellweaving]] for [[Frequency Harmonics]] where magic travels, any type of magic requires [[Stable Harmonic Channels]] of some sort, and nearby [[Resonance Anchors]] help further the connection of [[Stable Harmonic Channels]].
entries.body: The pathways of [[Spellweaving]] for [[Frequency Harmonics]] where magic travels, any type of magic requires [[Stable Harmonic Channels]] of some sort, and nearby [[Resonance Anchors]] help further the connection of [[Stable Harmonic Channels]].
