entries.title: Triadic Virtues of Spellcraft
entries.summary: **Incantation:** *Control is Mastery, Emotion is Fuel, [[Consciousness]] is Magic.*
entries.body:
**Incantation:** *Control is Mastery, Emotion is Fuel, [[Consciousness]] is Magic.*

A popular statement and magic principle which defines the seven bindings of the [[Auric Heptacode]] in [[The Principles of Magic]]. It directly mirrors the [[Trinity Harmony]] dividing the Past, the Present, and the Future in actionable law.

It is often used to determine the perfect [[Spellweaver]] by having [[Spellweaving ]]mastery in three primary categories: [[Mastery Over Chaos]], [[Potential of Creation]], and [[Key of Attunement]].

It's one of the core virtues that [[Perfect Reflection]] sought after.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/Spellweaving/Triadic Virtues of Spellcraft.md

entries.title: Trinity Harmony
entries.summary: The [[Trinity Harmony]] is the threefold law that binds the continuum of time into order through grouping the bindings of the [[Auric Heptacode]]. It starts from the latest element in the past, [[Strand]], and builds towards the furthest in the future, [[Crystal]].
entries.body:
The [[Trinity Harmony]] is the threefold law that binds the continuum of time into order through grouping the bindings of the [[Auric Heptacode]]. It starts from the latest element in the past, [[Strand]], and builds towards the furthest in the future, [[Crystal]].

By order the bindings in the [[Trinity Harmony]] are grouped by:

- The Triad of the Past. The [[Potential of Creation]]:
	- [[Strand]] (The Distant Past): It is the first part of the threefold law, and thus it is the binding which connects both the [[Trinity Harmony]] and [[Auric Heptacode]], despite being the last of the bindings, it controls the link to the time continuum.
	- [[Void]] (The Intermediate Past): It is the meaning of sacrifice, worth, and memory that continues to shape upon what a [[Consciousness]] has experienced. It has a balanced personal weight while maintaining as "fresh" enough to dictate present behavior.
	- [[Flux]] (The Nearest Past): It is the last element separating the past, as it requires texture and depth of history but it is imbued with the immediate present creating emotion and reflection to experiencing current existence.
- The Existing Present. The [[Key of Attunement]]:
	- [[Resonance]] (The True Present): The precise middle upon which the reality was built. It is the wave that layers an "I" upon everything, holding both the weight of what has been as much as it does the conviction of what will be.
- The Triad of Future. The [[Mastery Over Chaos]]:
	- [[Cindergale]] (The Nearest Future): It is the first element that separates the future, and directs the immediate direction that the flows of intent, concentration, and the path in which will becomes action.
	- [[Luminance]] (The Intermediate Future): It is the knowledge that shapes as much long-term behavior as it guides immediate direction. It provides means to achieve a destination but it is present enough to form the bridge.
	- [[Crystal]] (The Distant Future): The final part of the threefold law, it collapses all the possible futures into a single vision. It allows imagination to flow along the possibilities that will eventually become the new present.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Origin of Magic/The One Symphony/Trinity Harmony.md

entries.title: True Mythos of Creation
entries.summary: *"A Hymn Woven in the Threads of both Gold and Shadow."
entries.body:
[[Scorching Truth]]:

- [[The Auric Aria's Suicide]], [[Betrayal of the Moon]], [[First Weaving of Life]], [[Imperfection of Life]], [[Inevitability of Death]].

*"A Hymn Woven in the Threads of both Gold and Shadow."

Before existence, before matter, before even gods, there was nothing, and before there was nothing, there was [[The Eternal Symphony]], an infinite expanse of silent potential. It was not yet sound, not yet matter — only unending, absolute silence. It was a thread not yet plucked, an instrument with latent [[Potential of Creation]], containing all that could be, yet nothing had form, shape, or [[Consciousness]]. [[The Eternal Symphony]] was preexistent beyond time, yet a blank canvas for all of creation to awaken.

In a single instant of causality, from this silence, the [[Original Ripple]] arose: [[The First Overtone]], a singular vibration of [[Flux]] that awakened [[The Infinite Void]] to [[Primal White Noise]]. For the first time, existence could hear [[The Eternal Symphony]], if only in potential, stirring the cosmos into motion and laying the seed of rhythm that would, one day, govern creation.

The first vibrations of this [[Primal White Noise]] flickered [[Consciousness]], dim sparks of existence across [[The Infinite Void]] — awareness without form, gods not yet born, and beings without shape. They moved and whispered in [[The Infinite Void]], attempting to bend chaos to their wills, shaping ephemeral threads into fleeting forms. Their experiments with creation were tentative and brief, their efforts beautiful but unanchored, dissolving as soon as they themselves appeared.

After countless Eons, the thread vibrations calmed, and amid this restless sea of proto-awareness, a singular [[Consciousness]] achieved complete self-awareness: the [[Auric Aria]]. Unlike the flickering proto-beings, she had stable thought, reflection, and intention. Alone in the chaos, she perceived the [[Potential of Creation]] of [[The Eternal Symphony]] and [[The First Overtone]], saw both the possibilities and the fleeting creations of the nascent [[Outer God]]s. At first, she marveled at them, but soon she began questioning her own existence and place within the void. Her own doubt then turned into jealousy. Why should these other beings shape existence while she remained absent in the works of the cosmos?

She felt "out of tune" in [[The Eternal Symphony]], and born from seeking belonging and desire to assert her will, the [[Auric Aria]] began her first act of deliberate creation, the [[Known Universe]]. She wove from chaos and [[Flux ]]the [[Auric Heptacode]], the law of matter, space, and structure, giving stability to the formless vibrations, shaping physicality into stardust and energy itself. The [[Auric Heptacode]] became the lattice of seven golden threads that bound the raw vibrations of the cosmos into order, a structure to persist long after her immediate presence. It was progress, but she did not stop there. She shaped the [[Trinity Harmony]], time itself bound to a threefold law of past, present, and future. It was a flowing continuum that established memory, causality, and destiny. The [[Known Universe]] now had a rhythm, a framework in which actions, choices, and consequences could unfold, a place where [[The Eternal Symphony]] could sing with the first patterns of order.

With the [[Auric Heptacode]] and the [[Trinity Harmony]] in place, the [[Auric Aria]] wove stars into constellations and the nebulae into cosmic seas, forming the [[Proto-Universe]]. [[Outer God]]s observed and continued their experiments with raw chaos in [[The Infinite Void]], yet the [[Auric Aria]] weaving was deliberate, harmonized with the [[The Eternal Symphony]] itself. However, her jealousy and need of belonging lingered, for the stellar creations reminded her of her solitude. She saw the [[Potential of Creation]], yet no world reflected the totality of her will. Her works were beautiful, mesmerizing, and disconnected from herself. It was then that she resolved to create something not just permanent, but unique and in her image.

From this determination, the [[Auric Aria]] began the [[Seven-Cycle Creation]] of [[Arcanoria]]. She envisioned it as a realm of ordered matter and magic, designed not merely as another celestial object in the cosmos but as a recipient and statement of her [[Mastery Over Chaos]].

On the [[First Cycle]], she shaped the crust, the land, the seas, and the skies, giving the realm tangible form. Building upon the land's shaping, on the [[Second Cycle]], she wove the [[Great Harmonic Loom]] — the magical network that binds every vibration through a vast web — alongside the [[Leylines]], flowing as the [[Symphonic Veins]] of the world that carry the lifeblood and [[Resonance]] of [[The Eternal Symphony]] itself. On the [[Third Cycle]], mountains, plains, and rivers arose, sculpted as relief from the threads of the [[Auric Heptacode]]. On the [[Fourth Cycle]], she harmonized the rhythm of [[The First Overtone]] with [[Arcanoria]] and the celestial bodies, binding the stars into a symphony of [[Cosmic Motion]].

The paradise she dreamt about was going exactly to her [[Auric Geometry]].  However, it was still missing the reflection of an autonomous symphony to inhabit it, and thus, this dream of creating live was the dawn of the [[Fifth Cycle]].

However, despite her benevolence of creating a paradise this was the major turning point that revealed the [[Auric Aria]]'s first major flaw. She attempted the [[First Weaving of Life]]. She decided to use threads of the [[Great Harmonic Loom]], she created the husks of these very creatures utilizing the full extent of her [[Mastery Over Chaos]] to weave creatures that mimicked the world, beings of air, water, fire, and earth. The [[Auric Aria]] envisioned a world where these beings would not decay, where her creations would be durable enough to withstand on their own, to live limitless, and free. Her garden of paradise was meant to be a place without suffering vibrant in [[Resonance]]. This dream was her [[Perfect Manifestation of Life]].

Yet every time she plucked a new strand, a growing dread, rooted in her, fractured her focus. In building the first durable husks, she had a visceral fear that her masterpiece, [[Arcanoria]], and her paradise, would remain imperfect, chaotic as [[The Infinite Void]] that first gave her existence. Filled with fleeting forms that thrash against existence.

This dread became an intrusive thought where the anxiety grew into her weave, costing her [[Absolute Certainty]]. She placed the first threads incorrectly then she faltered. She never stopped to correct herself for she knew her fractured focus would dissipate the fragile [[Fundamental Frequency]] before it was fully encased. She placed the second thread, then the third, then the fourth, and it progressively entangled with her original intention of making indestructible beings.

The [[Auric Aria]] panicked, realizing the collapsing spiral of her paradise. The original forms she wove were dissolving with her very own hands, her gift of a perfect body became the curse of a prison and in her panic, the very thing she had wanted desperately to avoid came to pass. The once beautiful forms flickered, not merely lacking cohesion, but infected by her own despairing hesitation. They were a string of notes played with a trembling heart, fragile in intent, dissonant. When she released them, they collapsed into the earth, as agonizing shadows of fractured creation. Her dream of a paradise rotted in [[Consciousness]] screaming inwardly against their own half-made existence as [[Formless Masses]], twisted, decaying, and irreducible clots of divine doubt.

That was the original [[Dissonance]], one series of movements played wrong, not from lack of skill, but from anxiety and doubt, where her struggle against suffering became the very immutable law that could never be removed. From this first fundamental failure of emotion, from this fatal failure, the violence and cruelty of the natural world were born — the need for predation, survival, and the [[Inevitability of Death]].

The [[Auric Aria]], horrified at what she had wrought, attempted to undo her creations, but her original blessing was a curse. She made them so perfectly durable that even her lacked the [[Sufficient Precision]] — the art of threading a point of thought in a singular, crystal-clear intent — to disperse the woven threads. The [[Formless Masses]] persisted, embedded into [[Arcanoria]]'s very fabric, seeding a [[Corruption]] she could not eradicate, birthing the first [[Atonalis]], which rooted as the hollow, hungry vessels that were fractured [[Consciousness]] given form without [[Coherence]].

The [[Auric Aria]] was devastated, weeping and clinging to the last brittle forms of the creatures she had sculpted. In this despair, at the very end of the [[Fifth Cycle]], a sudden pale light burst from [[The Infinite Void]] eclipsing her tears from amidst the loosened threads of the [[Great Harmonic Loom]]. [[Selenea]] manifested into the reality of the [[Auric Aria]].

From the light emerged a formless, pale [[Outer God]] who had observed the [[Auric Aria]] efforts from [[The Infinite Void]] from the [[Cycle]]s past. She was drawn by admiration for the [[Auric Aria]]'s [[Mastery Over Chaos]]. [[Selenea]]'s desire to assist was born not of envy but of innocent awe — she wished only to nurture and bring life to the world that the [[Auric Aria]] had shaped.

She gently opened the clutching hands of the [[Auric Aria]], and using her own essence, [[Selenea]] breathed vitality into the brittle husk she was holding. In rays of silver and gold the [[First Living Being]] was born: a [[Fated Flower]], perfectly formed, golden and vibrant, in [[Resonance]] with life and a stabilized [[Fundamental Frequency]].

Witnessing this [[Perfect Manifestation of Life]], the [[Auric Aria]] gazed in astonishment — the potential she had always imagined for her paradise became now tangible. [[Selenea]]'s ability allowed creations to have a unique [[Soul-Key]] within their [[Fundamental Frequency]], a unique vibration of the soul that grants identity to all existence. Thus, reluctantly, and out of necessity in her despair, she permitted [[Selenea]] to aid her work, though a seed of jealousy and possessiveness began to grow within her.

On the [[Sixth Cycle]], the two worked together. The [[Auric Aria]] swore to make nothing permanent again so to not create a prison of her blessing, and instead she wove the fleeting physical structure from the [[Auric Heptacode]]; she gave flesh, wings, fins, and claws. [[Selenea]] infused the husk of these forms; she breathed them with vitality and a [[Soul-Key]] for their [[Fundamental Frequency]]. Thus, together in [[Consonance]], they gave birth to a myriad of life. It shaped the landscape across the skies, seas, and soil. Yet even as life blossomed, remnants of the [[Formless Masses]] invaded, and they had the endurance her newborn creations didn't. As such, some of these creatures were subject to [[Corruption]], warping them into predators, abominations, and vessels of suffering in a cruel reflection of life's [[Potential of Creation]].

Halfway through the [[Sixth Cycle]], the [[Auric Aria]]'s heart could bear no more. She witnessed in horror as her creations were killed, devoured, or corrupted by the lingering [[Formless Masses]], growing into more [[Atonalis]]. She watched as all her creations perished, prey and predator alike, and despair gripped her. Empathetic and broken, she withdrew and isolated herself as she felt something crack in her chest. She withdrew depressed and questioning her power, her will, her existence, and the limitations of the [[Sufficient Precision]] to weave, even for a god. This was the first time her benign [[Jealous]]y and her driven [[Ambitious]] nature twisted into that of [[Impostor Syndrome]] from her performance anxiety.

[[Selenea]], however, remained, continuing her work alone, believing it would serve as relief for the [[Auric Aria]] when she came back. She created with the only qualities she had, creating beings of [[Pure Light]], formless yet radiant, beings without structure, as only the [[Auric Aria]] could weave tangible form. She labored patiently, awaiting the [[Auric Aria]]'s return, nurturing [[Pure Light]] where the [[Auric Aria]]'s hands had stuttered.

In her profound isolation, the [[Auric Aria]] concluded after reflecting on the despair of witnessing life's cruelty and imperfection. She had to give life to a creation that would fully embody her essence, her [[Mastery Over Chaos]]. But for that it would need to be coherent, gifted in sentience, and attuned solely to her [[Fundamental Frequency]] — something she could call her own, a [[Perfect Reflection]] of herself. Thus, in this pensive state at the end of the [[Sixth Cycle]], the idea of [[Humanity]] emerged — beings that would be her crowned and ultimate creation, a [[Perfect Reflection]] of her will, attuned to both her form and her [[Resonance]], yet inherently alive through [[Selenea]]'s unique gift of vitality.

The [[Seventh Cycle]] dawned with renewed purpose, though shadowed by the [[Auric Aria]] lingering despair. The thought of [[Humanity]] — attuned to her essence in a [[Perfect Reflection]] of her will — consumed her mind. She knew that the [[Seventh Cycle]] carried a special gravity, for within the [[Auric Heptacode]] the [[Seventh]] thread resonated as the one with most [[Consonance]], the one that could bind all others in unison. It was the sacred number of completion, the [[Cycle]] destined to crown creation itself.

With resolve and veiled intent, she approached [[Selenea]]. Together, they willed to shape shaping a being unlike any other, one that could harmonize with the [[Potential of Creation]]. In innocent eagerness, unaware of the jealousy coiled in the [[Auric Aria]] heart, [[Selenea]] envisioned creatures similar to those of [[Pure Light]] interwoven yet enhanced by form, both radiant and enduring — a union of their gifts. But as the [[Cycle]] progressed, the [[Auric Aria]]'s despair deepened and the obsessive need for order made her think the unthinkable.

She could not forget the cruelty of the [[Formless Masses]], nor the [[Corruption]] they sowed in her earlier works. She knew, dreadfully confident, that if she made [[Humanity]] through collaboration, they would never be hers alone, never in [[Perfect Reflection]]. They would always carry [[Selenea]]'s touch and her [[Fundamental Frequency]], just as the birds and beasts did.

The thought alone poisoned her. Envy, cold and sharp, coiled around her heart. For all her [[Mastery Over Chaos]], would prove nothing if she shared her [[Perfect Reflection]], it would not be the [[Perfect Manifestation of Life]] she solely envisioned, and [[Pure Light]] was harder to attune to her [[Fundamental Frequency]] alone, as it had entirely the essence of [[Selenea]].

Thus, she devised a unique construct leveraging the paradoxical genius of her [[Auric Geometry]]: a [[Celestial Ensnaring Mirror]], a perfect trap that would infinitely reflect light in itself on the night sky. A unique geometry conjured from the powerful emotion she felt, rooted in fear for her faltering hand at the original [[Dissonance]], and focused by the [[Absolute Certainty]] of her desire. It was forged uniquely in [[Cosmic Motion]] from direct threads of [[The First Overtone]], able to give form to any [[Fundamental Frequency]], able to give form even to the formless. It was, in its very essence, envy and fear made manifest in a cosmic, subduing obelisk.

As such, when the time came, she praised [[Selenea]]'s efforts and lured her into weaving her concentrated essence into the framework of their next creation. It was then, with a single, devastating motion, that the [[Auric Aria]] sealed [[Selenea]] into the [[Moon]], trapping her light in the [[Auric Geometry]] of a bound [[Anthropomorphic Shape]], and seeping her vitality through the [[Leylines]] of [[Arcanoria]]. And it was from the very chains of her confinement that bled a substance anew, [[Emberwhisper]], velvet crystals that gleamed a deep crimson and carried the hush of a thousand sorrows. They were the crystallized essence of theft itself, forged from the crime of binding that gave life to the world.

From this [[Betrayal of the Moon]], the [[Auric Aria]] at last claimed the missing spark for herself. With [[Selenea]]'s stolen gift, she wove [[Humanity]], beings in her own image: upright, sentient, resonant with thoughts, will, memory, and, most importantly, a [[Perfect Reflection]] of her own [[Fundamental Frequency]]. Unlike the beasts, they were not bound solely by instinct or to the cruelty of nature; unlike [[Pure Light]] beings, they had tangible flesh and enduring form; unlike anything before, they did not suffer to the same extent of the [[Inevitability of Death]] as every other living being that clung to life from instinct. [[Humanity]] was her ultimate creation, her [[Perfect Reflection]], and her crown.

At last came the [[Eighth Cycle]], forbidden, taboo, and unspoken. For in that [[Cycle]] the [[Auric Aria]] clothed herself in flesh, weaving skin and bone from her own radiant thread. She descended into [[Arcanoria]] as a weaver turned mortal.

Her first steps trembled with awe. What she had long shaped as design, she now felt with breath and blood. The forest did not answer to her command, nor rise to pattern, but instead stood as a living cathedral. Branches arched like vaulted halls of golden leaves, rivers coursed with silvered music, and the wind trembled with rhythms she had never written. She walked not as a creator, but as a witness. Her heart swelled with amazement: what she had woven was like herself, alive, and more beautiful than she ever dared to imagine. The world sang in a unique harmony, in a song that reflected her own [[Fundamental Frequency]], yet somehow strange and unfamiliar. It didn't have the same [[Soul-Key]] as she did.

At the bank of a river, jeweled with moonlight, she saw fruit dangling from a low-hung bough — pale gold, glowing faintly in the silvered beams. Compelled, she plucked it and bit it. It was sweet, but the juice scorched like fire in her veins. In a flash, she felt the weight of mortality, of thirst, of hunger, its vulnerability and ache. Her heartbeat quivered; she breathed, and for the first time, she knew fragility, a forbidden flavor from the fruit, of both a revelation and a curse.

Beside her, a creature drank from the same stream the tree had grown — small, horned, gentle, radiant in innocence. Drawn by her newfound empathy, she touched its flank. Delicate as a single thread in the vast loom, the warmth of its [[Soul-Key]] dimly hummed through her fingers. It whispered praise, and she marveled, for it was a [[Perfect Manifestation of Life]] she could now feel. The [[Auric Aria]] and the beast shared [[Resonance]], even if for one ephemeral moment, attuning to the hymn of the world.

But the shadow broke the song. From beneath the trees, an [[Atonalis]] — faceless, hollow, coiled like a serpent — struck swift and merciless. It tore the creature from existence in a single, terrible motion. Blood stained the stream, tainting the silver river red as the beast fell lifeless at her side. Horror seized the [[Auric Aria]]. She felt the [[Inevitability of Death]], as a sharp, searing reality — she felt it, smelled it, trembled before it. The [[Atonalis]] devoured its kill, then turned upon her. Large, black claws pierced her side, and a burst, like that of molten iron, tore through her flesh. She felt pain and fear for the first time.

She fled. She stumbled through root and thorn, each breath a chorus of panic. She ran until her legs could give in no longer. She ran until her body, spun from auric thread, yet new to the scourge of mortality, failed. At last, she collapsed in a meadow, breathing shallow, in limbs trembling, her [[Golden Ichor]] mixing with the soil.

It was here that a band of villagers picking berries discovered she had passed out. They were not hunters, nor rulers, but humble mortals of the earth. They found her fragile body as one might a fallen bird, unsure whether to cradle or flee. Some shrank in fear, whispering that she was no woman, but a spirit in borrowed flesh. Yet others, moved by pity and awe, laid trembling hands upon her wounds. In that touch, [[Resonance]] stirred — faint, luminous, undeniable. Her suffering became a spark, and within their souls the first chords of magic awakened from this emotion. The song of the world had now found human voices.

They carried her back to their settlement. At first, the gates opened wide in hurried hope, with some villagers rushing to treat her wounds. But as her [[Golden Ichor]] bled from her side into the earth, it shimmered, it whispered, and a hush fell. All eyes widened. The uncanny glow traced her shape, and awe turned quickly to unease. Their hearts sensed an otherness, a whispered truth unspoken but deeply felt: she was something apart, walking in flesh borrowed, not truly her own.

Some still pressed closer, hands steadfast to bind her wounds, murmuring a humming of comfort. In that trembling communion, a subtle chord vibrated through the air — the first [[Attunement for Magic]], faint yet powerful. From sorrow and compassion, the spark of magic kindled in intention and human emotion. The air seemed to hum as the world's song threaded through mortal voices for the first time, a melody born of pain and wonder alike that sealed the bleeding.

Fear, however, is a sharper chord than wonder. The [[Dissonance]] she had first seeded into the world during the [[Fifth Cycle]] — that original, trembling note of divine fear — now found its echo in the hearts of [[Humanity]]. Murmurs became cries; eyes that had softened now widened in terror. The elders, sensing power beyond comprehension above the golden stains, called her a curse incarnate. Shadows, they said, clung to her as surely as the wound to her flesh. Whispers became judgment, and judgment became a threat. Her life was met, not with understanding, but with imprisonment. They sought to sever the dissonant note, unaware that they were repeating the very first fatal flaw of their creator. And so, she was tried for execution. She did not resent, as she knew intimately, for it was a reflection of her own.

As night came, those who had felt her [[Resonance]], and with it the faint pulse of [[The Eternal Symphony]] in their veins, could not allow this. They sought her beneath the veil of night, carrying her away from gates that had first opened in hope. And so, she fled once more. Each step was heavy with the knowledge of her own fragility, the imperfection in her weaving, and the realization that even her stolen gift bore the [[Weight of Flaw]].

Alone and tattered, her steps carried her to a high cliff, moonlit and windswept. She reached a circular clearing overgrown on a crescent field of [[Fated Flower]]s — the first [[Perfect Manifestation of Life]] that proved her vision true, one that with [[Selenea]] she had created together. The field was calm, a place where not even the wind dared to stir; the breeze was almost absent, as if the world itself anticipated muted.

Below, the vast ocean sang an endless hymn. The [[Leylines]] shimmered like silver threads all through the land. The [[Moon]], bound with the essence of [[Selenea]], cast its reflection across the sea, and the [[Auric Aria]] beheld it — a mirror of the one she had ensnared. An inescapable, [[Scorching Truth]] struck with grief deeper than the wound in her side: the [[Imperfection of Life]] had not arisen from mortals, nor from the spirits that lurked, it wasn't from the slain creature that tainted the river red. It had come from her own hand, her own thread. Even the act of subduing [[Selenea]] could not erase the [[Weight of Flaw]] embedded in her essence. What she had woven bore sorrow and violence, and she was powerless to change it.

And so, she chose to take her life. With a final breath in golden tears, she leaped into the ocean, far across the cliff. Her mortal frame shattered upon the waves, and her essence erupted in song, raw and unbound. The world trembled in [[Golden Ichor]]. From her spirit violently flowed primal [[Aetherlight]], the purified [[Resonance]] of her sorrow and radiance, and [[Lunehymn]], the captured vitality of [[Selenea]]'s bound form, entwining in the [[Leylines]] for the first time as the [[Dual Confluence Stream]].

The stream carried in its silvered currents, [[Selenea]]'s own longing and her melancholy stirred dream-like visions in mortal sleepers — she glimpsed her lost creations, and they awoke with a yearning that carried her gift with them. Magic poured deeply into [[Arcanoria]], seeding the first instruments of power deep within the [[Great Harmonic Loom]], solidifying  [[The Principles of Magic]]. Humans and beasts, spirits of light and shadow, all attuned to [[The Eternal Symphony]] for the first time. The release of this powerful seed of magic created fractals that embedded in the sky to reflect the cosmos, and these fine sheets sublimed into the [[Sky Glass]] that would then capture the entire orderly structure of the [[Auric Heptacode]],

The place of [[The Auric Aria's Suicide]] became [[The Silent Expanse]], a wasteland of wild magic where no wind stirs, as if the world itself mourned the death of her mortal frame.

Upon the clearing made shrine, the [[Fated Flower]]s could not endure the direct [[Resonance]] of her sorrow. Where her final tears had fallen, they darkened and decayed. Their vibrant gold bleeding into a deep, wounded crimson — the same terrible hue that had tainted the silver river from the first death she witnessed — transforming the clearing into the first field of [[Forsaken Flower]]s. And yet, from that very decay, a new life emerged from the silence: [[Glimmerfern]]. Its fronds, pale and delicate, were traced with veins of liquid silver mirroring that of [[Leylines]]. It glimmered softly and in unison, in deep blue, reminiscent of the moonlit ocean she had seen below. It was a quiet miracle — life born not of weaving, but of pure, undiluted emotion. It became a testament and a living memorial to the moment a god's heart broke not in rage, but in sorrowful understanding. It was the antithesis of the crimson [[Emberwhisper]]; where one was the crystal of theft, the other was the bloom of remorse.

For countless [[Cycle]]s, the [[Auric Aria]] withdrew into silence, slipping between form and thought — it came to be the [[Lost Cycle]]. Mortals stood alone in a godless world, learning to shape the mark she left behind. Even in the [[Auric Aria]]'s silence, they tuned their [[Fundamental Frequency]] and honed [[Sufficient Precision]], reaching her in quiet communion through distant dreams. For in the stillness, [[Selenea]]'s silvery whispers drifted from the [[Moon]], a hushed, desperate lament guiding those who still listened toward [[Consonance]]. Further above, unseen and immense, several [[Outer God]]s peered through the veil, hungering to claim the abandoned threads. Their forms were too vast to shape the mortal plane directly. They could only influence with [[Sufficient Precision]] through flesh-woven vessels, imperfect conduits of will. Valleys writhed beneath secret motions, forests muttered strange hymns, rivers ran blackened with echoes of desire, and the [[Primal Discordia]] danced through mortal lives. It was the darkest time for [[Humanity]], an age when extinction hung by a thread, and even hope itself seemed a vain, innocent dream.

After [[Ages]] of anguished supplication and sacrifices, of the first [[Cataclysmic Aftermath]], and of beseeching cries carried on the winds across a godforsaken land during the [[Lost Cycle]], the [[Auric Aria]] at last returned. Her arrival was not one of triumph, but relentless, drawn by the desperate pleading of the faint, clinging hope of survivors. Their generations of suffering rose as a chorus too visceral, impossible to ignore.

Aria, scarred yet unbroken, emerged from silence, peering at one of the many distress calls that bore her name. In a windless valley, she found a pilgrim — fatally wounded — hugging a pale sapling and clutching a vial of [[Selenea]]'s silvery moonlit whispers as beneath a withered tree. Driven by desperation, the pilgrim lifted a brittle branch from the dying tree skyward. In a voice soft with empathy, the [[Auric Aria]] attuned herself to the dying sorrow. With impeccable precision, she wove that fragile hope into the pilgrim's soul, and when the pilgrim hugged the sapling again, its pale leaves unfurled, golden anew in vitality. In that moment, she understood what the passing of so many [[Cycle]]s had taught her in her stillness: she could not weave the [[Perfect Manifestation of Life]] alone. The physical threads were too thin and required the [[Sufficient Precision]] of weaving a singular thread, which she did not possess.

Yet she refused to abandon her crowned creation, [[Humanity]] carried within them her [[Fundamental Frequency]], and the pilgrim showed her that some even bore the thread capable of shaping harmony with care and the [[Absolute Certainty]] required in [[Perfect Reflection]]. Through them, she could channel [[The Eternal Symphony]] in the unbound [[Potential of Creation]] that no god could exert upon flesh directly. No longer a distant architect of perfection, she canonized herself through mortal agency as [[The One True God]], a guiding hand against the [[Outer God]]s, seeding fragments of her own [[Consciousness]] as [[Piety]]. It was the first warmth, a luminous grace of the first motif in her melody, made vocal after [[Ages]] bygone speechless.

And so, [[Humanity]] became both her heirs and her instruments, tasked with continuing the pursuit of the [[Perfect Manifestation of Life]], carrying her essence in their voice.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Mythology/True Mythos of Creation.md

entries.title: Vaelia
entries.summary: [[Legend Title]]: The Mask-Singer.
entries.body:
[[Legend Title]]: The Mask-Singer.

[[Primary Instrument]]: [[Soul Oscillator]], 8-Tongued Pan
[[Armament]]: Carved Masks
[[Soul Leitmotif]]: [[Resonance]]
[[Ornament]]s: None

[[Motif Awakening]] Wish: _"I wish I knew the sound of my own voice."_
[[Scorching Truth]]
[[Legend Trait]]s:

- [[Intuitive]] -> ([[Resonance]])
- [[Teasing]] -> [[Sly Fox]] ([[Flux]])
- [[Self-Deceiving]] ->

[[Legend Opus]]:

- Mother of Bards ([[Magnum Opus]])
- Carver of Elderwood Faces ([[Lesser Opus]])
- _"Oh, don’t look so solemn! I’m not going anywhere just yet, but someone will be born the day after I die." She said, in that familiar glint of their eyes with the mask in between her hands, with a voice dipping into vulnerability.
  _"And that truth carries more strength than the [[Weight of Change]] I have spent my entire life chasing. Just think about it, neither you nor I were the first [[Legend]], and we will, definitely, not be the last — but that one note, your note, is yours alone in [[The Eternal Symphony]], and don’t pretend you don’t feel it humming in your chest right now." She tilts her head, reading the answer before it came, yet softened enough to drop the act._
  _"I spent so long telling myself I was nothing more than an echo. But I realized you can't echo nothing— I knew that, really, I just couldn't escape the tragedy of it. The fact that I survived, that I'm still here, still carving, still playing, still laughing with you... that's my note. Small. Maybe imperfect. But undeniably mine. And so is yours." A pause, then that sly smile again, as if they she hadn't just given her own mask away._
  _"Now, stop looking at me like that, or I'll start thinking you actually believe me!"_

### Quotes

**On her Soul Oscillator:**
_“It plays songs I’ve heard. And now, sometimes, it plays songs I’m still learning. I don’t know where they end, and that’s fine. A song doesn’t need to be finished to be real.”_

entries.title: Velvet Nectar
entries.epigraph: _"The first taste of [[Velvet Nectar]] is never the last."_
entries.summary: The production of a single vial of [[Velvet Nectar]] is a complicated process that has been refined through the [[Ages]]. It began in [[Ages]] IV with the Velvet Cage with the crude mixture of concentrated [[Emberwhisper]] with infused memories of [[Parasite Atonalis]].
entries.body:
- Memories distilled from someone's [[Consciousness]].
- It opens the black market for "sacrifice tokens"—memories extracted from others with [[Essence Sacrifice]].
- It is the most sought after of the [[Dark Commodities]], and it is a widely illegal material that is the end point of the [[Weight of Indulgence]].
- Originally made by the Velvet Cage by mixing a variety of [[Parasite Atonalis]], like the emotional residue of subjugated victims by the Pleasure Parasite, distilled  [[Emberwhisper]] (which gives the signature velvet color), and memories extracted by Memory Reavers.
- [[Velvet Nectar]] increases radically in quality and evolves during [[Ages]] until the [[Age of Velvet Elegance]] where it reaches its apex in society.
- [[Velvet Nectar]] is highly addictive as it is a cocktail of emotion combined with the memories of the victim. The stronger the emotion and memory harvested the more potent rush it gives which is the reason it allows for the [[Weight of Indulgence]] to develop on a societal scale.
- [[Velvet Ambrosia]], or high quality [[Velvet Nectar]], is the most delicious food in the entirety of [[Arcanoria]], it is [[Velvet Nectar]] imbued with the strongest memories, abilities, and intense harvested feelings from [[Great Spellweaver]]s. The stronger the resistance the person put, the stronger the flavor of the [[Velvet Ambrosia]].
- [[Velvet Nectar]] requires a tremendous amount of suffering to produce for which [[Dissonance]] [[Enclave]]s usually produce a lot of [[Atonalis]] and inevitably become overrun becoming an [[Atonalis Nest]] until they starve out.
- [[Velvet Nectar]] can give "skills" and mastery by acquiring the specific memories. If a vial of [[Velvet Nectar]] contains the memory of a master pianist whomever consumes it has now the ability they once had and becomes the master pianist themselves.

### The Production line of [[Velvet Nectar]] into [[Velvet Ambrosia]]

The production of a single vial of [[Velvet Nectar]] is a complicated process that has been refined through the [[Ages]]. It began in [[Ages]] IV with the Velvet Cage with the crude mixture of concentrated [[Emberwhisper]] with infused memories of [[Parasite Atonalis]]. However, the evolution has greatly purified the process and by the [[Ages]] of industrialization the apex of this substance is [[Velvet Ambrosia]] which is manufactured by the following:

- A way to process emotional and memory residue of [[Pleasure Parasite]]s and [[Memory Reaver]]s.
- The respective [[Parasite Atonalis]] and the high intensity energy contained in them as raw [[Resonance]] and memories.
- The distilled [[Emberwhisper]] to act as the delivery medium of the concoction.

The pipeline conducted in the [[Age of Velvet Elegance]] depends entirely on [[Velvet Throne]]s which are especially facilities where all of this interacts together. This is primarily due to two [[Pure Light]] creatures:

- [[Emberwhisper]] weavers which are specialized arachnids that can create vast silk looms using [[Emberwhisper]] and the drops of crystallized mineral are embedded within their weave. This provides the raw material of distilled [[Emberwhisper]] that is used in the mix and the velvet webs give the signature color of the [[Velvet Nectar]].
- [[Memory Singer]]s which are medium-sized [[Pure Light]] birds that take in the emotional residue of [[Pleasure Parasite]]s and [[Memory Reaver]]s while being able to process these [[Parasite Atonalis]] themselves, they consume the raw energy of the emotional residue to build their nests and use their saliva by processing the raw [[Resonance]] of [[Parasite Atonalis]]. The production are nests of high purity and elegance directly built from the suffering contained within these [[Atonalis]].

A [[Velvet Throne]] is the facility that creates these precise conditions, on the underground it contains the rooms for subjugation of [[Great Spellweaver]]s and directly give the raw [[Parasite Atonalis]] and the emotional residue for the [[Memory Singer]]s for them to build these nests that then will be harvested. The middle layer of these "bird cities" for farming the nests contains the buildings that have [[Emberwhisper]] weavers building their webs that get used as distilled [[Emberwhisper]].

Before beginning the harvesting protocols, the [[Velvet Throne]]s deliberately mark their victims by cutting a V on the palm of the right hand. This serves as the eventual vial of blood that will be mixed with the final production of [[Velvet Nectar]] while simultaneously serving as a mark of "The Harvested" to distinguish between status and as a signature of ownership. The specific "cut" is the signature of the harvester patron of the facility.

Finally, by combining the [[Emberwhisper]], the [[Memory Singer]]'s nest and mixing it with the initially extracted vial of blood of the same [[Spellweaver]] while diluting it with [[Lunehymn]] the final produce is made: [[Velvet Nectar]]. Those which contain the highest purity of all materials, the most intense memories and feelings of the edible nests and the highest grade of distilled [[Emberwhisper]] purity become [[Velvet Ambrosia]] which has a distinguishable hue of velvet to midnight black with golden sparkles, similar to the patterns found in concentrated [[Lunehymn]].

Moreover, it is possible to track which "person" was made to build the nest of the [[Memory Singer]]s because these are deeply loyal birds that stick to one particular [[Fundamental Frequency]], and do not cross mix [[Resonance]] unless it comes from the same target.

The [[Pleasure Parasite]]s subdues the body of a [[Spellweaver]] by pure bliss and the concoction of their bodily fluids and emotions during release. The [[Memory Reaver]] enters the body through the ears and directly harvests the memories from the same subjugated [[Spellweaver]] for their memories in the brain. The purity of the nests relies on harvesting as much of the physical, and metaphysical essence through [[Pure Light]] beings and [[Atonalis]] in a ritual that penetrates both the body and the mind as the commodification of everything that makes up a [[Consciousness]].

[[Velvet Throne]]s are the apex ingenious of the [[Age of Velvet Elegance]], they are beautiful bird sanctuaries on the top side, layered crimson complex webs in the middle and horrific subjugation chambers on the inside and underground of the "bird city." They are a self contained ecosystem of industrialized pleasure and awe in reverence of magic, nature and [[Domestication Enclave]]s. A combination of the purity of awe and reverence of the [[Chorus Pillar]] running on human suffering.

They are a stark contrast to the parallel industrialization of caged magic of the [[Age of Sealing Iron]]. [[Civilization]]s on the [[Age of Sealing Iron]] view these atrocities as "Idyllic Nightmares" or prison camps parading as idyllic paradises while the [[Age of Velvet Elegance]] sees the monstrosities of caged magic of the [[Age of Sealing Iron]] as industrialized hubris. The two opposing [[Civilization]]s constantly wage war between one another of "liberation" one to liberate [[Humanity]] and one to liberate [[Pure Light]] beings and nature.

### The Extraction of Memories with [[Parasite Atonalis]]

The combination of [[Memory Reaver]]s with [[Pleasure Parasite]]s is a devastating combo that affects the mind as much as the body, the idea is to run on two principles simultaneously:

- The body betrays the mind: The arousal and physical stimulation cause involuntary response to the ongoing burst of pleasure. Even if they try to resist mentally and consciously, the [[Pleasure Parasite]] is engineered to perfectly bypass all of the rationalization logic and actually feed on the friction of how much emotion they release alongside the physical fluids.
- The mind betrays the body: The [[Memory Reaver]]s extract the memories under the ongoing stimulation. The victim feels and visualizes those memories with intensity, it deliberately blindfolds the victim to make them enter a state where the specific memory extracted is being mentally rehearsed.

While both alone are horrifying, the combination of the simultaneous subjugation of mind and body creates an effect even more potent of symbiosis of the two parasites:

- When the [[Pleasure Parasite]] triggers dopamine release and it helps to establish a memory consolidation signal, this gets latched on by the [[Memory Reaver]] and the high-dopamine states make memories more vivid, more emotionally charged, and more durable. The intrusion becomes [[Resonance Anchors]].
- The [[Memory Reaver]] extracts memories during this peak dopamine state, and because dopamine amplifies memory the extraction becomes hyper-vivid. The victim experiences their most cherished memories with extreme emotional intensity while those same memories are being ripped away. The [[Pleasure Parasite]] deliberately compounds with these exact [[Resonance]] signals to increase or decrease their activity matching to the vivid rehearsal of the memory.
- The direct intervention of the [[Memory Reaver]] on the brain while the [[Pleasure Parasite]] is directing the body directly enhances the sensation. This numbing massage overrides the dopamine release by doing intricate neurochemistry in tandem. This also prevents dissociation in several layers, first by using the memory as substrate, then by replaying vivid memories, which sometimes even become hallucinations during the most potent releases, and the constant arousal tightens the grip of both [[Parasite Atonalis]]. Disturbingly, there is a point on the vivid hallucinations where the victim can replay, if they have significant memories of intimate moments, with their own consensual partners or even in their own fabricated fantasies. This is widely considered to be the breaking point.
- The self betrays the self: On some of the extremes, or nearing the point of exhaustion, the [[Memory Reaver]] compliments the [[Pleasure Parasite]] by overriding the motor cortex of the victim on its direct manipulation, making it move deliberately and complicitly with the ongoing physical subjugation when given the signal of the [[Pleasure Parasite]]. This precise loss of bodily agency triggers even more release of stronger emotions that harvest back into the [[Pleasure Parasite]]'s emotional cocktail. Some of this states of forced autophilia create the most cognitive friction producing the highest quality of emotional residue. Both the mind and the body are broken to giveaway to the direct extraction of the [[Soul-Key]] itself when all armor is stripped away.

The combination of these super-saturated dopamine states is precisely what makes victims complicit at some points and even conditioned in learning that the source of the highest pleasure imaginable is the same source of the very memory being erased. The subsequent vacuum left by both the erasure of the memory and its connected attachments creates a state of numbness that reinforces the cycle of dependency on the [[Pleasure Parasite]]s with the intervention of [[Memory Reaver]]s.

While this is not explicitly mind control, it crosses a blurry line because the victim is choosing surrender over the alternative of the return to the ordinary suffering. They have been [[Drowning in Flux]] to the point that they're addicted to their own violation until becoming entirely numb and devoid of memories or distinct identity. It's the upmost [[Weight of Indulgence]] until there's nothing left to indulge.

If these fractured [[Spellweaver]]s are still functional after being devoid of memories, they become the docile gardeners of the very sky cities for the [[Memory Singer]]s in the [[Velvet Throne]]s. They are allowed to perform these duties until their body eventually gives out and gets consumed by the ecosystem, providing additional sustenance to the top layer of the idyllic gardens.

_"Return to the roots of the world that once sustained you, so that you may once too sustain the existence of the world that comes after." - The final lesson to the [[Velvet Throne]] gardeners._

entries.title: Vow Mark
entries.summary: [[Vow Mark]]s are a type of [[Dissonance Curse]] and the primary currency of subjugation, established in the upper echelons of any high [[Regalia Pillar]] [[Civilization]] as early as [[Ages]] II.
entries.body:
[[Vow Mark]]s are a type of [[Dissonance Curse]] and the primary currency of subjugation, established in the upper echelons of any high [[Regalia Pillar]] [[Civilization]] as early as [[Ages]] II.

In the high estates of a [[Regalia Pillar]] society, traditional coin is often viewed as a crude measure of wealth. True power is measured in [[Vow Marks]]. these are not currency in the traditional sense, they are the direct order over a will by perverting the nature of [[Sympathetic Magic]] and of the [[Eleos Bloom]]s meant to keep promises.

These are originally derived from the natural properties of [[Vow Orchids]]—rare blooms from the [[Boreal Reach]] that blacken when promises are broken—this botanical phenomenon was weaponized by [[Contract Arts]] of Slavery Guilds.

By perverting the orchid's natural sympathetic resonance, the aristocracy created a system of total subjugation. To hold a [[Vow Mark]] is to hold a life.

### Fabrication and Cultural Impact

During eras like the Age of Velvet Elegance, where the friction of the soul and suffering are aestheticized commodities, "trading marks" does not mean exchanging currency. When the courts discuss the trade of marks, they are explicitly negotiating labor, manpower, and the transfer of slave exploitation.

- The Paste: The sigils require a highly volatile alchemical medium. They are drawn using a paste crafted from frozen Vow Orchids and emberwhisper, and infused finally with the blood of the master. It is similar to the one used to draw [[Music Glyph]]s but enhanced by the [[Vow Orchids]].
- The Carving: The sigil is not merely painted; usually another sharp tool, commonly made from [[Emberwhisper]] as well, is used to carve the contract directly into the flesh, searing the master's will and blood into the victim's physical and magical architecture.
- The Vocalization of the Vow: Making a [[Vow Mark]] does require the participation of the victim in the ritual. They have to explicitly state that they will honor the [[Vow Mark]] for the orchids to respond, the [[Resonance]] to bind to [[Emberwhisper]], and usually they tend to be general agreements that allow room for interpretation, such as: _"I vow to fulfill a favor for this mark, I will follow down to the precise line and intent the will of (Master's name) and accept the exchange of a favor until it is fulfilled or we are severed by death."_ This also makes so that a single [[Vow Mark]] only can be used for one favor, and the favors can't be loopingly infinite, they require to be a specific command and action.
- Magical Affinity: Because the marks rely on Sympathetic Magic, their binding power is entirely proportional to the victim's magical attunement. The stronger the victim's affinity for magic, the deeper and more inescapable the mark's control becomes. And rarely is it vocalized from consent, despite giving "consent" it's usually coercion that forces someone to accept a [[Vow Mark]].
- The Physical Toll: The mark shifts from black to red. When black, or inactive, it remains as physical weight. While the mark is active, meaning the one honoring the vow has to comply, it leaves persistent, red-hot burns on the skin. If the bound individual attempts to resist a command, or fails to fulfill the specific vow, the mark becomes violently abrasive, inflicting agonizing pain until compliance is achieved. The Terms of Severance Because a Vow Mark is a sympathetic tether linking two lifeforces, it cannot be removed by traditional healing or counter-spells. It only shatters under two absolute conditions:
- Fulfillment of the Vow: When the [[Vow Mark]] is invoked for a specific favor or labor contract, it will naturally dissolve from the skin the moment the terms are completely fulfilled.
- [[Vow Mark]]s can be used for almost any command without the ability of the servant to fight back. There are only two limitations which deal directly with the [[Sympathetic Magic]] and nature of [[Vow Mark]]s: the servant can't be made to kill either the master or themselves, as it would sever the tether. A [[Vow Mark]] can be used to order assassination of anyone but not for mutiny against the master or as a suicide order to self terminate, including most indirect orders like "continue walking until the edge of the cliff ends."
- [[Vow Mark]]s are two way streets, it requires life force to continue existing which means someone can theoretically die from enslaving many by sustaining several servant [[Vow Mark]]. Due to this constrain, the aristocracy becomes even more hierarchical with them as you can't command a million vow marks, but you can command someone who holds 10, and use the other 10 he commands to reach 100. There's always someone holding the leash of the jailor.
- The Severance of Death: Sympathetic magic requires two anchors. If either the master holding the contract or the servant bearing the mark dies, the tether violently snaps, and the mark instantly vanishes from the flesh. Narrative Implementation: The Severed Tether This mechanical lore creates a visceral, silent turning point in the story, perfectly bridging Amadea's infiltration with Cordelia's emotional awakening. When Cordelia desperately indebts herself to her former teacher, Javius, to save Amadea from execution, she offers herself up for "three marks". Javius accepts, physically binding her to his will by carving three Vow Marks into her wrists. Cordelia is once again trapped in the gilded cage of aristocratic abuse, enduring the red-hot burns of the sigils binding her to the man who once oversaw her brutal punishments. Meanwhile, Amadea goes undercover in the aristocratic circles, acting as a spy and an assassin. Her first target is Javius. Amadea ambushes him, using her Hollow-Point saber to vault over him and slit his throat, silencing him permanently before making a swift escape. The Realization: Miles away, Cordelia is sitting in silence, enduring the stinging heat of the Vow Marks on her wrists. Suddenly, she gasps as a sharp, cold shockwave ripples through her magical resonance. She looks down at her wrists. The red-hot burns flicker, turn to ash, and completely dissolve into thin air, leaving behind nothing but unblemished skin. No one needs to tell Cordelia what happened. She knows the rules of Contract Arts. The only way a Vow Mark disappears without the favor being fulfilled is if the master is dead. In that breathless moment, Cordelia realizes that Amadea did not abandon her. Amadea is actively tearing down the rot of the aristocracy to protect her. Staring at her freed wrists, Cordelia finally allows herself to cling to hope.

This narrative sequence is one of the most emotionally devastating moments in the story because it perfectly weaponizes Cordelia’s deepest psychological trauma, only to resolve it through a profound, wordless act of devotion from Amadea. Here is a breakdown of why Cordelia receiving the Vow Marks is so heartbreaking, and how their sudden disappearance serves as the ultimate long-distance message of rescue. The Devastating Context of the Vow Marks Cordelia receiving the Vow Marks is not just a physical punishment; it is a total psychological regression and a tragic repetition of her family's cycle of abuse.

- The Return to Her Abuser: To save Amadea from execution or imprisonment after being caught by Luminaire, Cordelia must expend the last of her political capital and contact her former teacher, Javius. Javius is the very man who humiliated her, stripped her of her name, and officially oversaw her brutal flogging when she was a child.
- The Ultimate Self-Sacrifice: Cordelia strikes a desperate bargain: if she cannot pay him back, she will be indebted to him for "three marks". By accepting these Vow Marks, she is willingly placing herself back into the gilded cage of the aristocracy she just escaped.
- The "Over-giving Devout" Flaw: This moment highlights Cordelia’s tragic, deeply ingrained belief that love must be earned through suffering. She sacrifices her own hard-won freedom, using her body and soul as collateral to protect someone else, believing her own safety is expendable.
- Amadea’s Rejection: What makes the marking truly agonizing is the immediate aftermath. Instead of gratitude, Amadea is furious and terrified. Amadea violently pushes Cordelia away, telling her that "the knight who keeps sacrificing himself... dies". Cordelia is left behind, believing she has permanently lost her best friend while now bearing the burning, abrasive Vow Marks of her abuser. The Assassination as a Long-Distance Message Amadea’s path takes her straight into the heart of the aristocracy as an undercover spy and assassin. Her very first mission—her "debut" for the informant Cyril—is to assassinate Javius.
- The Silent Kill: Amadea uses her Hollow-Point saber and Void magic to vault over Javius, slitting his throat and silencing him before he can call for help.
- The Snapped Tether: Miles away, Cordelia is enduring the burning agony of the Vow Marks. Because these marks are built on Sympathetic Magic, they require the lifeforce of the master to sustain the contract. The exact moment Javius bleeds out on the floor, the magical tether violently snaps.
- The Message Received: Cordelia watches the red-hot sigils on her wrists turn to ash and dissolve into unblemished skin. Because she knows the rules of the Regalia Pillar's Contract Arts, she knows instantly that Javius is dead. The Thematic Impact This vanishing mark is a perfectly executed long-distance message because it completely shatters Cordelia's despair. It tells Cordelia that Amadea’s cruel rejection was a lie born of fear, not a lack of love. Amadea did not run away; she walked directly into the rotting heart of high society to murder the man who held Cordelia's leash. The dissolving Vow Marks are the physical, undeniable proof that for the first time in Cordelia's life, someone is fighting a war to pull her out of the cage, rather than locking her inside it.

entries.title: Waltz Pillar
entries.epigraph: _Power should be democratized in the hands of the many in a massive orchestra of [[Spellweaver]]s, their collective performance dictates equal access in responsibility._
entries.summary: Axis of [[Regalia Pillar]] vs [[Waltz Pillar]]. Part of the [[Pillars]] of [[Civilization]].
entries.body:
Axis of [[Regalia Pillar]] vs [[Waltz Pillar]]. Part of the [[Pillars]] of [[Civilization]].

They argue in favor of having an resonant orchestra over the reliance on a few virtuous soloists who can miss a note and cause everything to fail.

The philosophical stance contrary to the [[Regalia Pillar]] on the distribution of magic and power. It argues in favor of the democratization of magic as a right that everyone should have, it follows the principles of justice, shared burdens, collectivism, and communal identity to be resilient against the crisis.

Major Arguments vs [[Regalia Pillar]]:

- Giving the entire burden of civilization to a single [[Spellweaver]] is at best a dictatorial tyranny and at worst genocides when they inevitably break under the stress of having the entire world on their shoulders. _"If we all depend on a single soloist what happens when that soloist becomes an [[Atonalis]]?"_
- Having the ability to distribute [[Essence Sacrifice]] across many will make a society much more resilient to crisis and the shared burdens help to recover faster when loss becomes inevitable. _"Will that soloist break and surrender all of their memories just to keep the beacon of [[Humanity]] afloat?"
- An orchestra has a much richer variation of sounds, voices, and sheer bandwidth than any [[Legend]] conducting the entire symphony. The real strength in numbers will always overpower a single mind, even if that mind is individually stronger, the collective is much more resilient and can depend in one another.
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Society/Societal Resources/Foundation/Waltz Pillar.md

entries.title: We Are Atonalis
entries.summary: [[Atonalis]] aren't external invaders — they're the manifestation of what happens when [[Consciousness]] fractures. The real horror is realizing we contain the seeds of these demons within our own minds.
entries.body:
[[Atonalis]] aren't external invaders — they're the manifestation of what happens when [[Consciousness]] fractures. The real horror is realizing we contain the seeds of these demons within our own minds.

*"The most terrifying monsters aren't the ones that hide in shadows — they're the ones that emerge when our own minds break. Hurt people, hurt people."
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Truths, Chaos, Rituals/Inescapable Truths/We Are Atonalis.md

entries.title: Weight of Change
entries.summary: The [[Seventh]] of the [[Seven Weights]].
entries.body:
The [[Seventh]] of the [[Seven Weights]].

Everything will inevitably change, either as an ending or as a different existence. An ending of a story is only the beginning of another.

Linked to [[Inevitability of Death]], bound to [[Strand]] and [[Echoing Bonds]].
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Truths, Chaos, Rituals/Inescapable Truths/Weight of Change.md

entries.title: Weight of Flaw
entries.summary: Theory of Predictive Processing of [[Consciousness]].
entries.body:
Theory of Predictive Processing of [[Consciousness]].

The second of the [[Seven Weights]].

The weight of flaw is the error of imperfection, the contrary to quality.

Bound to [[Luminance]] and [[Sufficient Precision]].
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Truths, Chaos, Rituals/Inescapable Truths/Weight of Flaw.md

entries.title: Weight of Indulgence
entries.summary: The third of the [[Seven Weights]].
entries.body:
The third of the [[Seven Weights]].

Once tasting a higher reality, is impossible to go back, every new experience a forbidden taste that increases the baseline for conformity and enjoyment.

Bound to [[Flux]] and [[Emotional Authenticity]].
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Truths, Chaos, Rituals/Inescapable Truths/Weight of Indulgence.md

entries.title: Weight of Nature
entries.summary: The fifth of the [[Seven Weights]].
entries.body:
The fifth of the [[Seven Weights]].

Everything has an essence that is inescapable, only controllable, whether [[Humanity]], [[Outer God]]s, or the [[Auric Aria]].

Bound to [[Cindergale]] and [[Perfect Focus]].
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Truths, Chaos, Rituals/Inescapable Truths/Weight of Nature.md

entries.title: Weight of Potential
entries.summary: Deterministic Physicalism
entries.body:
Deterministic Physicalism

The sixth of the [[Seven Weights]].

The what if of existence, in a parallel of infinite universes, every choice is a murder of probability,

Bound to [[Crystal]] and [[Absolute Certainty]].
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Truths, Chaos, Rituals/Inescapable Truths/Weight of Potential.md

entries.title: Weight of Purpose
entries.summary: Existential Nihilism, Entropic Fatalism,
entries.body:
Existential Nihilism, Entropic Fatalism,

The first of the [[Seven Weights]].

Nothing matters, existence is certainty that just happened to be, no inherent meaning yet acquired purpose defines a life.

Bound to [[Resonance]] and [[Key of Attunement]].
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Truths, Chaos, Rituals/Inescapable Truths/Weight of Purpose.md

entries.title: Weight of Value
entries.summary: Eliminative Materialism,
entries.body:
Eliminative Materialism,

The fourth of the [[Seven Weights]].

Nothing has inherent value, it all holds to the eye of the beholder, nothing is truly meaningful until [[Consciousness]] decides it is.

Bound to [[Void]] and [[Essence Sacrifice]].
entries.source: Worldbuilding/Truths, Chaos, Rituals/Inescapable Truths/Weight of Value.md

entries.title: Xian-K'in
entries.summary: This is the third classical [[Civilization]] of [[Arcanoria]] representing the [[Regalia Pillar]], it was founded by the White Chested Fox, [[Sak Tahn Waax]], during [[Ages]] I, and it holds the great city of [[Babmer K'ahn-Jing]], one of the most prosperous ports with golden canals in sync with [[Cosmic Motion]].
entries.body:
This is the third classical [[Civilization]] of [[Arcanoria]] representing the [[Regalia Pillar]], it was founded by the White Chested Fox, [[Sak Tahn Waax]], during [[Ages]] I, and it holds the great city of [[Babmer K'ahn-Jing]], one of the most prosperous ports with golden canals in sync with [[Cosmic Motion]].

The city is a combination of Mayan/Chinese/Egypt/Babylonia based on the study of core [[Civic]]s.

- Ideograms of glyphs as language instead of an alphabet to express ideas (Chinese Characters/Hieroglyphs)
- The presence of [[Cosmic Motion]] scholars and the division of the [[Lunar Calendar]] plus astrology to determine the validity of the people in power.
- They have a hierarchy based on knowledge as a technocracy with the highest seat being the [[K'ahn]], after the mythical founder and astrologist of Sak Tahn.
- Zenith Exams as the imperial examination exam that dictates the proficiency of people, while they don't have slaves being a menial worker is essentially a slave job, the emancipation comes only from the mind, although most lower classes are inevitably excluded from higher forms of education and end up being slaves due to their "lack of knowledge" in a flawed meritocracy.
- Glyphic aqueducts and the use of highly advanced mathematics for having control of water, this is the direct inspiration for [[Iridia]]'s own waterworks systems and only gets outpaced whenever [[Xian-K'in]] falls into stagnation.

[[Major Settlement]]s: [[Babmer K'ahn-Jing]] ([[Capital]]), Lol-Ha' (The Lotus Water City), Akkad-Tzak (Hanging Gardens), Uruxian, Tzolkhem, and Ahnkzhou.

### Additional facts

- [[K'ahn]] is a combination of K'an meaning gold in mayan, and a play on Khan.
- Alongside [[Hollowmarch]] in [[Ages]] II they are allies as both are aligned to [[Aureus Pillar]] [[Regalia Pillar]], but during [[Ages]] V they side with [[Iridia]] on the war as they become [[Chorus Pillar]] [[Regalia Pillar]].
- The [[Great Plague]] is what cements the [[Regalia Pillar]] of [[Xian-K'in]] after realizing that power can't be free or in the moths after having a heavy toll including the fall of Aberchord. It hit both [[Xian-K'in]] and [[Aeolion]] very deeply, but [[Xian-K'in]] managed to make it with less losses due to the [[Atrocity]] they committed redacting names out of the [[Auric Order]] and similar tactics to control the [[Great Plague]].
- The name [[Babmer K'ahn-Jing]] is the scholar name of the city, regular people name it Kahnjing, and foreigners tend to simplify the name to [[Kanjing]]. This division on the missing h is the core identifier of people who are not from [[Xian-K'in]]. It means Bab (Door from Mesopotamian, Mer from Egypt for Sea, K'ahn from mayan gold and its original ruler, Jing from Chinese of capital city translating to the Golden Door of the Sea referring to the [[Trade Nexus]] it is and one of the greatest ports in [[Arcanoria]] with gilded canals.
- The commoners of the sovereignty, even when speaking quickly or informally, would naturally retain the breathy "h" sound because it is baked into their linguistic DNA, echoing the Tahn of their founder. It shows that while they drop the pretentious scholarly prefixes, they still belong to the culture. Kanjing (The Foreigner's Blunder): Traders from neighboring realms, or survivors from Aeolion, would completely miss the subtle glottal breath of the "h." They would flatten the word into a hard, blunt Kanjing. This gives the Astrologer-Prefects an immediate, phonetic way to identify an outsider the second they open their mouth. This is something Lenore says to Amadea when she goes to the city, she should at minimum out effort in the h to be respected
- Alongside the Realm of [[Aeolion]], which is the birthplace of [[Amadea]] that collapses during the [[Great Plague]], [[Xian-K'in]] is also featured in the early parts of the novel and during the movement of The Shattering. It's [[Lenore]]'s study place, and it presents the first conflicts of [[Amadea]] with the aristocracy. She takes off from the port of [[Babmer K'ahn-Jing]] to reach the main continent of Movement 2.
2. K'ahn as ruler title, Sak Tahn Waax is the first ruler ever and who establishes the golden port or K'ahn-Jing
